LLM performance is strongly task-dependent, ranging from moderate to high, and no single model consistently outperformed the others, indicating that effective adoption depends on selecting models and prompting strategies per task. Our contributions are: (i) the first cross-task empirical evaluation of LLMs spanning five RE-related activities, (ii) replication materials supporting reproducibility, and (iii) a broader understanding of the capabilities, limitations, and practical readiness of current LLMs for RE.

</details>


### [178] [ExploreAI: Agentic Exploration Knowledge Bases for Reproducible Observable-Regression Testing of Black-Box VR and 3D Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21628)
*Jiajie Wang,Kebin Peng,Wei Wang,Xiaoyin Wang,Sen He,Xue Qin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出ExploreAI框架，通过LLM驱动的智能体在黑盒VR/3D应用中自动构建"探索知识库"(EKB)，以支持可复现的"可观察回归测试"。EKB为每个对象记录扫描证据、目标选择、导航路径、多视角捕获和自验证结果，作为跨版本比较的可重用测试制品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒VR/3D应用的回归测试困难，因为可观察故障取决于测试者的位置、可见对象和捕获的视角。手动探索测试证据难以复现，系统化扫描缺乏语义引导且在低价值视角上浪费预算。现有VR测试与探索方法未将发现的证据保存为可重用测试制品，难以跨版本进行可复现的回归比较。

Method: ExploreAI采用LLM驱动的智能体框架，将重复的感知、导航、多视角捕获执行和日志记录委托给专门模块（YOLO感知、确定性远/近视图控制器），而LLM负责高层规划、证据记录、捕获策略决策和自验证决策。核心算法包括ConstructEKB主循环、RecoverMissingTrace恢复缺失轨迹、DiffEKBs跨版本差异比较。支持完整探索（记录所有可观察对象）和目标探索（针对特定对象类别）两种模式。EKB采用对象轨迹元组结构&lt;id, c, p̂, D, S, N, V, R, F&gt;存储每个对象的扫描证据、目标、导航路径、多视角捕获和自验证结果。

Result: 在Unity、AI2-THOR和BeamNG六个室内外场景的评估中：完整探索达到0.979对象完整度和0.971视图完整度（宏观平均），目标探索完成所有查询相关目标；六种LLM配置均达到相同的高聚合完整度（确定性感知/导航层决定了上限）；模块消融显示移除LLM规划使Urban Cabin对象/视图完整度从0.871/0.825降至0.323/0.209，移除自验证使完整探索聚合分降至0.666；复现研究表明有EKB上下文时人类和自动化复现者均比无EKB时更有效率地复现对象-视图证据；DiffEKBs在注入的36处变更中检测出35处（仅漏检1处资产替换误判），无假阳性。

Conclusion: ExploreAI成功构建了一个智能体框架，可为黑盒VR/3D回归测试生成高完整度的EKB。EKB不仅保存所见内容，还保存如何发现、捕获、验证和比较的过程，支持跨版本的可复现可观察回归测试。该工作将可观察回归测试定位为可复现性问题，提出的对象中心测试制品可服务于VR/3D应用版本间的重放和比较。

Abstract: Black-box VR and 3D applications are difficult to regression test because observable failures depend on where a tester moves, what objects are visible, and which views are captured. Manual exploratory testing can find such failures, but its evidence is time-consuming to reproduce; systematic sweeps are reproducible, but they lack semantic guidance and spend exploration budget on low-value viewpoints. We observe that an LLM can make the high-level decisions a human tester makes during exploration: interpreting a task, choosing which objects to inspect, grouping related objects, recording what it saw, and deciding when missing evidence should trigger another attempt. Based on this observation, we present ExploreAI, an LLM-driven agentic framework that offloads repeated perception, navigation, multi-view capture execution, and logging to specialized modules while using the LLM for planning, evidence recording, capture-policy decisions, and verification decisions. ExploreAI constructs an Exploration Knowledge Base (EKB): a structured, per-object record of one exploration run. For each object the agent finds, the EKB stores the scan evidence that exposed it, the selected target, the navigation path, the multi-view capture, and the self-verification result. The EKB is a reusable testing artifact that supports reproducible observable-regression checking across versions of a VR or 3D application. Across six indoor and outdoor scenes in Unity, AI2-THOR, and BeamNG, ExploreAI constructs high-completeness EKBs under both complete and target exploration, and an LLM-module ablation shows where semantic planning, capture policy, evidence recording, and self-verification contribute. Reproduction pilots further show that EKB-guided traces help both humans and LLM-based reproducers reproduce exact object-view evidence more effectively than conditions without EKB context.

</details>


### [179] [XRFix: Exploring Performance Bug Repair of Extended Reality Applications with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21718)
*Jingwen Wu,Hanyang Guo,Hong-Ning Dai,Xiapu Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: XRFix 是首个面向开源 XR（扩展现实）应用的、基于大语言模型（LLM）的性能缺陷自动修复框架。作者构建了包含 23 个开源 XR 项目和 104 个真实性能缺陷的数据集，对 UnityLint 和 CodeQL 进行定制以同时支持 C# 脚本与资产文件的缺陷检测，并针对单行级、函数级、类级三类场景设计差异化提示词模板，在 GPT-4o、GPT-3.5、Code Llama、Deepseek-Coder、StarChat-β 五种 LLM 上验证，并通过静态分析、参考答案比对（CodeBLEU）与人工审查三种手段评估。实验结果显示 XRFix 修复率达 67.3%，较最优基线（Self-Repair/GPT-4o）提升 7.7%，显著优于 AlphaRepair 与 Fine-tuned CodeT5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XR 应用涉及 3D 场景渲染、实时动画、过程模拟等高计算复杂度操作，性能缺陷（如帧率下降、动画卡顿）会显著降低沉浸感甚至引发眩晕，但现有自动化程序修复（APR）工具主要面向传统软件，缺乏 XR 性能缺陷专用的代码库、缺陷检测工具与修复手段。

Method: 1. 数据集构建：从 SideQuest 与 GitHub 收集 25+72 个 Unity XR 仓库，结合论坛、CWE 与文献总结 10 类 XR 性能缺陷（RWT、RCC、RLC、RD、SORL、AOBL、RHA、RS、IDU、NAU），筛选后保留 23 个项目共 104 个缺陷。2. 缺陷检测：复用并扩展 CodeQL（针对 C# 脚本，支持全局数据流分析）与 UnityLint（针对 .unity/.mat/.shader 等资产文件）两类静态分析工具，新增针对 RWT、IDU、NAU 的查询规则。3. 修复生成：将缺陷按调用复杂度分为单行级（direct call）、函数级（cross-function call）、类级（cross-class call，含 GetComponent 跨组件调用），并设计 5 种提示词模板（a–e），分别组合基本指令、缺陷说明（Bug Instruction）、修复说明（Fix Instruction）、替代注释风格与代码示例。4. 评估：采用修复率（FR）、合理补丁占比（PPF）、CodeBLEU 三指标，并通过整体编译运行进行人工审查。5. 对比基线：AlphaRepair、Fine-tuned CodeT5、Self-Repair（GPT-4o）。

Result: - 缺陷检测：自定义静态分析工具精度 90.4%，双人 Cohen's Kappa 一致性 0.83。- 整体修复率：GPT-4o（prompt c）达 67.31%，GPT-3.5-Turbo 63.46%，Code Llama 45.19%，Deepseek-Coder 42.31%，StarChat-β 23.08%；合理补丁占比 GPT-4o 为 45%。- 提示词模板效果：prompt c（基本+缺陷+修复说明）在大多数 LLM 上达到最佳；prompt d（替代注释风格 /* */）能提升 GPT-4o 的 CodeBLEU（0.700 vs 0.664）；消融实验显示"缺陷说明"贡献最大（FR +19.6%，PPF +11.8%）。- 不同缺陷类型表现差异显著：RHA（需删除多余分配行）最困难，修补率仅 52.17%；NAU 在 CodeBLEU 上最差，因 LLM 常引入与参考答案不同的变量。- 与 SOTA APR 对比：XRFix(GPT-4o) FR=67.3%、PPF=45.0%、CodeBLEU=0.664，分别高于 Self-Repair 7.7%、3.5% 和略低 0.003（无统计显著差异），显著优于 AlphaRepair（5.77%）与 CodeT5（6.73%）。- 案例验证：修复 SORL 后 Unity Editor 渲染帧时由 2.4ms 降至 1.8ms（-33%）。

Conclusion: XRFix 验证了 LLM（尤其是通用 LLM GPT-4o）通过精心设计的零样本提示词即可在 XR 性能缺陷修复上显著超越传统 APR 方法；通用 LLM 优于代码专用 LLM；缺陷级上下文（特别是缺陷说明）对修复效果贡献最大。然而仍存在局限：仅覆盖 Unity 框架与 10 种缺陷类型，尚无法处理视觉/非视觉类（如立体视觉不一致）缺陷，未来工作将引入多模态 LLM 与智能体以扩展能力。

Abstract: As an emerging technology, Extended Reality provides end-users with an immersive experience of interacting with virtual and physical environments. Unlike traditional software, the execution of XR applications involves more computationally complex operations, such as 3D scene rendering, real-time animation, and process simulations. Inefficient coding practices during the software development of XR applications may cause various performance bugs, degrading user experience and even causing motion sickness. Thus, it is an urgent need to develop an automated program repair framework for fixing performance bugs in complex XR programs. However, it is non-trivial to achieve this goal due to several technical challenges: (1) a lack of a real-world XR codebase and bug dataset, (2) no accurate bug detection tool, and (3) no effective bug-fixing tool designed for XR performance bugs. To tackle these challenges, we present a novel large language model-based framework, namely XRFix, to repair performance bugs for open-source XR programs. We first construct a corpus of domain-specific performance bugs built with a codebase from 23 open-source XR projects and a dataset of XR-related bugs containing 104 real-world bugs. Then, we tailor two static analysis tools for accurately detecting bugs in both C# scripts and asset files. Last, we design different prompts to instruct LLMs to fix XR bugs in three types of bug scenarios with different complexities, i.e., single-line level, function level, and class level. We conduct extensive experiments on five off-the-shelf LLMs to evaluate the bug-fixing performance of XRFix. We also compare our XRFix with three SOTA APR approaches. Through static analysis, reference answer comparison, and manual inspection, we demonstrate that our XRFix can effectively fix XR bugs, outperforming SOTA APR methods.

</details>


### [180] [Loop Engineering: Building Blocks, Adoption, and Impact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21884)
*Jai Lal Lulla,Vahram Nersesyan,Seyedmoein Mohsenimofidi,Christoph Treude,Sebastian Baltes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对2026年6月兴起的"循环工程"(loop engineering)实践进行了探索性研究。通过对灰色文献的综述和对36,710个软件仓库的挖掘研究，作者将该术语确立为软件工程领域的实证研究对象，识别出其构成要素，并在217个仓库中确认了自主智能体循环的实际运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环工程这一术语在从业者中迅速传播并伴随大胆声明与强烈质疑，但其在软件项目中的实际采用情况尚未被测量。作者希望将这一实践从从业者术语转变为基于实证的研究对象。

Method: 采用三阶段研究方法：(1) 探索性灰色文献综述，整合出循环工程的工作定义和六大观察(O1-O6)；(2) 基于现有AI配置数据集对36,710个软件仓库进行挖掘研究，使用基于文件和内容的启发式方法扫描循环相关构件，并从Git历史中提取行为信号，通过LLM辅助标注与人工裁决验证；(3) 设计对照实验，比较交互式(C1)、目标驱动(C2)和定时循环(C3)三种自主水平条件的效果。

Result: 在256个启发式匹配的仓库中确认217个运行自主智能体循环(占扫描仓库的0.59%)，其中Claude Code占主导(189个)；启发式精确度为0.868 (95% CI [0.820, 0.907])。研究发现：循环的配置部分(触发器)留下提交痕迹，但运行时状态几乎不在版本控制中——文献规定的状态文件提交实践几乎未被采用，停止条件、预算文件、验证子代理均未在提交构件中检测到。Claude Code在确认的工具归属中占主导(189/217)。循环的主要用例是PR审查(180个)和定期问题分类(21个)。

Conclusion: 循环工程作为新学科还是新标签仍有争议，但"用验证机制、预算和升级策略约束非确定性工作者"这一设计问题不会消失。研究揭示了可观测性差距：挖掘研究能观察配置侧但低估运行时侧。未来的工作将重新运行更大规模的挖掘研究，并执行自主水平对照实验。"图工程"作为循环之上的新概念被提及，但其研究应建立在理解单个循环的基础之上。

Abstract: Over the past months, the way developers direct agentic AI coding tools has moved up several levels of abstraction, from phrasing prompts to engineering context to configuring the harness around the model. In June 2026, practitioners began to describe a further level called loop engineering: Instead of prompting an agent interactively, developers design systems that prompt agents for them. These systems start agent runs on a schedule or on repository events and stop them when a machine-checkable condition holds. The term spread rapidly, accompanied by bold claims and vocal skepticism, but its adoption in software projects has not been measured. We present an exploratory review of the emerging gray literature, which largely agrees on what a well-engineered loop contains: triggered agent runs bounded by machine-checkable stop conditions, persistent state files, verifier sub-agents, token budgets, and defined points of escalation to humans. From this review, we derive a research agenda for the empirical study of loop engineering in open-source projects, analyze which of its aspects are traceable from repository data, and report an exploratory mining study of 36,710 software repositories. We confirmed the operation of autonomous agent loops in 217 of the 256 repositories our heuristics matched. The repositories commit the configuration around these loops, but almost none commits the state files the discourse prescribes, and the loops' runtime state remains outside version control. We conclude by outlining a planned controlled study of agent autonomy levels and their effect on effort and outcomes.

</details>


### [181] [Ontology-based Requirements Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21945)
*Jan Novacek,Alexander Viehl,Oliver Bringmann,Wolfgang Rosenstiel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于本体的方法，用于在供应链感知下转换由任务剖面（Mission Profiles, MPs）给出的功能和环境负载需求。该方法采用OWL和SWRL语义Web技术构建模型，支持多种模型到模型（M2M）转换方法，并通过两个工业用例（技术失效模型应用和子组件MP推导）验证了方法的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂系统设计中，任务剖面（MPs）作为功能和环境负载需求沿供应链逐级分解传递。不同层级的供应链参与方需要MP数据的不同子集，但当前MP数据多以非标准化方式（如Excel、Word）存储和交换，缺乏自动化转换工具支持，导致：①转换过程繁琐易错，②通信开销大，③知识产权保护不足，④知识难以跨项目重用。因此需要一种能感知供应链、基于标准化语义的自动化MP转换方法。

Method: 1. 基于三个假设（供应链感知、通用负载规范、可变细节层级）提炼出五条关键需求（参数维护机制、通用处理能力、可扩展处理能力、可定制操作、可扩展性）及五条对应评估准则。2. 持续使用OWL作为统一建模语言，将MPFO格式的MP文档通过Semantic MPAD Platform（Scala/Play Framework实现）提升（lifting）为OWL本体。3. 构建失效模型与转换本体，通过OWL公理和SWRL规则推理识别需维护的MP参数。4. 系统架构基于Scala trait设计，提供MPOTransformation抽象，支持直接操作（OWL API）和基于规则（SWRL API）两种M2M转换方法，通过插件机制实现可扩展性。5. 用户通过重写apply方法定制转换行为，支持一对一、一对多、多对一、多对多映射。

Result: 1. 技术失效模型应用用例：基于MPFO v0.2.1文档（含7个参数和8个温度区间），利用本体推理识别出温度、电压和失效率参数需在OEM层级转换中维护，通过Scala实现IncreaseTemperatureCycleRange转换类，输入本体（3874条公理）经转换后输出本体（3633条公理），对象属性和数据属性断言得到保留。2. 子组件MP推导用例：以汽车ECU到IC子组件为例，依据JEDEC JESD51-2标准的热阻方程（TJ = TA + P×θJA，θJA = θJC + θCA），从ECU基础MP推导出Tier-3技术级MP，同时保护知识产权。3. 验证了语义Web技术可用于MP转换，证实了文献中关于简化系统设计可有效实现MP转换系统的结论。

Conclusion: 本文提出的基于本体的MP转换系统能够感知供应链（针对高层和技术层失效模型），其可扩展设计允许集成多种转换方法。局限性包括：SWRL仅支持单调推理，无法修改或删除已有事实（可通过前后处理缓解）；当前MP到本体的映射组件采用内存构建，不适合超大规模MP。未来改进方向包括：M2M转换的重用与验证、集成基于模式的转换、以及利用SWRL Built-In扩展直接进行失效模型评估。相比Eclipse Modeling Framework、Epsilon或ATL等替代方案，本方法通过标准化语言（OWL/SWRL）和简化的系统设计实现了实用的MP转换系统。

Abstract: This paper presents an ontology-based approach to the supply chain-aware transformation of functional and environmental load requirements given by so-called Mission Profiles (MPs). The approach aims at improving the efficiency of the engineering process through supporting the transformation process and enabling a better integration of the transformation into existing Model-based Systems Engineering (MBSE) processes. We propose a methodology and a supporting system which aids in the transformation process while the latter feature is obtained by constructing and working on models. Consequent utilization of the standardized language OWL to express model representations further enables better knowledge integration and transfer among hetero-geneous systems. In addition to that, this favors knowledge reuse across projects which can reduce overall costs. Moreover, the system enables stripping off irrelevant information from MPs, thus improving protection of intellectual property.

</details>


### [182] [Ontology-supported Design Parameter Management for Change Impact Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21949)
*Jan Novacek,Ali Ahari,Alessandro Cornaglia,Frederik Haxel,Alexander Viehl,Oliver Bringmann,Wolfgang Rosenstiel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于本体的设计参数管理方法，通过本体集成异构数据源，建立需求与设计参数之间的追踪链接，利用专家知识库中的可操作关系，支持工程领域的变更影响分析（CIA），适用于软硬件设计，并以两个实例验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂工程（尤其是汽车和航空电子领域）中，需求频繁变更且难以预见其影响，现有变更影响分析多依赖人工、聚焦源代码、工具集成度低，导致系统影响被低估或忽略，且 ISO 26262 等安全标准对需求可追溯性提出了强制要求。

Method: 1. 基于 OWL 本体的系统模型，统一表达组件、功能、设计参数、任务剖面（MP）及需求之间的关系；2. 利用 CTEF 协作式技术评估框架捕获并存储专家关于设计参数间"可操作关系"的知识，形成依赖匹配图（DMG）并导出为 RDF/XML；3. 采用语义化任务剖面感知设计（MPAD）平台（Scala 实现，提供 RESTful API），将需求文档（ReqIF）和知识库提升至本体；4. 使用 Stanford CoreNLP 和 WordNet 对自然语言描述进行分词、词性标注、名词提取与同义词匹配，半自动生成需求—设计参数链接建议（算法 1）；5. 通过标准图分析从根节点到叶节点的路径确定受变更影响的设计参数。

Result: 1. 成功建立了基于本体的系统模型，整合了异构系统模型、需求规范、专家知识与任务剖面数据；2. 在功耗用例（基于 TAMTAMS 工具的逻辑门与寄存器功耗分析）中，当系统频率需求变更时，系统自动识别出 frequency、ibtb、ion、mobility、vth、sce、qme、pde、dibl、capacitance、resistance 等受影响的设计参数；3. 在实时应用用例（交通标志识别系统，基于 Xilinx Zedboard Zynq-7000）中将 24fps（每帧 42ms）的实时需求映射到主存写延迟不超过 31 个周期，并将其链接到对应设计参数；4. 验证了基于图遍历进行变更影响分析的可行性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法通过本体建模实现异构系统模型的有效集成，结合专家知识库与需求可追溯性，有效支持变更影响分析，弥补了现有方法在多作用域、非源代码、非功能需求及任务剖面集成方面的不足。未来工作包括：利用仓库挖掘考虑变更历史、采用模型替代自然语言以简化链接、应用本体映射/实体匹配方法提升链接质量、利用推理检查一致性并辅助识别链接、将自然语言需求提升为形式化规范、并将方法集成到更广泛的 RE 活动中以提升需求完备性。

Abstract: This paper presents an ontology-supported approach to the management of design parameters in engineering. This approach aims specifically at enabling Change Impact Analysis through Requirements Traceability and acquainted expert knowledge of design parameters. The approach is suitable for both software and hardware designs. The activities and features are mainly obtained by (1) the application of an ontology-based universal system modeling procedure proposal for model integration, (2) the utilization of a knowledge base for capturing expert knowledge and (3) a semantic Mission Profile Aware Design platform. OWL is used to represent information and the underlying data model can improve knowledge transfer among heterogeneous systems which are common in complex engineering projects. At the same time, effort to perform reasoning on such models can be reduced. A demonstration and hands-on description of two illustrative use cases complements the paper.

</details>


### [183] [LLM-Enhanced Commit Message Generation via Issue Information: An Exploratory Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22004)
*Zongen Ren,Wei Shi,Bo Xiong,Chong Wang,Peng Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出ISAC框架，将代码diff与issue信息结合用于LLM提交信息生成（CMG），并构建了ApacheCM-Issue数据集（47,664条commit-issue对齐样本）。实验表明，加入issue信息在BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr、SBERT-Cos五项指标上平均提升23.60%、20.48%、25.21%、30.70%、8.70%，并超越四种SOTA基线。加入相似历史commit可进一步提升，而用结构化issue摘要替换原始issue则会降低自动指标得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-CM研究主要利用代码diff、代码上下文或仓库内部历史，而对外部信息（如issue报告）的作用缺乏系统研究。Issue信息能提供代码diff难以推断的任务背景、问题描述和修改动机。

Method: 1) 构建ApacheCM-Issue数据集：基于ApacheCM，通过GitHub与Apache Jira链接commit与issue，应用4条过滤规则（含目标泄漏控制，相似度阈值0.8），最终获得47,664条样本；2) 提出ISAC三阶段框架（Issue检索→Issue感知增强→提交生成），设计3种增强策略：issue-only、相似历史commit增强、结构化issue摘要；3) 采用4种LLM配置（GPT-5.5 effort=none/high、DeepSeek-V4-Flash chat/reasoner）；4) 用5项自动指标+50样本人工评估（清晰度、完整性、正确性）评估。

Result: 1) RQ1：加入issue信息在所有LLM配置和指标上均稳定提升，CIDEr提升最大（30.70%）；2) RQ2：ISAC超越CCT5、NNGen、RACE、CoRec四种基线；3) RQ3：加入相似历史commit可再获29.49%（BLEU）、41.08%（CIDEr）的提升；4) RQ4：结构化issue摘要替换原始issue使指标下降3.46%-10.65%；5) 人工评估显示原始issue提升清晰度与完整性，历史commit可能引入噪声，结构化摘要在完整性上得分最高。

Conclusion: Issue信息对LLM-based CMG具有显著价值，能帮助捕获代码变更意图；上下文的选择和呈现方式影响生成质量。未来工作包括细粒度上下文选择、改进结构化表示、扩大人工评估规模。

Abstract: Commit messages help developers understand code changes, support collaboration, and improve long-term maintenance. However, the use of issue information alone as the external context for LLM-based CMG has not been systematically studied. We propose an ISsue-Augmented framework for Commit message generation (ISAC) by combining code diffs with issue information as LLM input. To support the evaluation, we construct ApacheCM-Issue, a commit-issue aligned dataset built upon ApacheCM by linking commits with issues from GitHub and Apache Jira. Using samples from Scala, Java, and C++ projects, we evaluate four input configurations using two representative LLMs, GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash in different reasoning configurations. The results show that incorporating issue information consistently improves LLM-based CMG across all evaluated model configurations and metrics, with the largest gains observed for CIDEr. Incorporating a similar historical commit further improves automatic metric scores, while replacing full issue information with a structured issue summary decreases them. ISAC also outperforms the four reproduced state-of-the-art (SOTA) CMG baselines across all five automatic metrics on the experimental dataset. The human evaluation further shows that structured issue summaries may improve perceived completeness, although replacing the original issue information can sacrifice contextual details and lead to worse results on automatic metrics.

</details>


### [184] [W-RAG: Source-Aware Retrieval for Enterprise Document Generation from Heterogeneous Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22081)
*Hridya Dhulipala,Rajesh Ombase,Michael Wang,Tien N. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出W-RAG框架，针对企业文档生成中多源异构知识库的检索问题，通过本体引导检索、各知识库局部排序和源级加权分配上下文，解决全局排序导致的证据来源失衡问题。同时发布了覆盖多种企业文档类型和行业领域的新基准数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG管道假设来自多个知识库的证据可通过单一相似度函数进行全局排序，这适用于开放域检索，但在企业文档生成中会失败：异构知识库（政策、法规、技术文档、部门指南）具有不同功能和权威性，全局排序往往使上下文被某一类来源主导，导致生成文档不完整。

Method: W-RAG是一个源感知检索框架，包含三阶段：(1) 本体引导的候选检索：利用LLM从输入中提取主题并映射到本体类别，使用混合评分函数 R(c) = f_sim(q,c) + λ·f_ont(T,c) 进行检索；(2) 源权重估计：基于主题重叠、文档可用性先验和类别奖励计算每个KB的源权重 S_final = 0.7·S_topic + 0.1·S_doc + 0.2·S_cat；(3) 加权上下文构建：将KB权重转化为各知识库的token预算，从局部排序候选中选取块构建单一上下文窗口。

Result: 在包含100个需求文档、4种企业文档类型（政策、产品发布、M&A尽职调查、学术项目）、4个领域（AI技术、医疗、气候、财经）、4个异构知识库（约2000份文档）的新基准上：W-RAG相比Vanilla RAG在Requirement Satisfaction上提升109.2%、Context Relevancy提升96.4%；相比OG-RAG分别提升58.1%和39.1%。JS散度分析显示预设权重与实际归因分布之间存在中等至强一致性（0.60-0.74）。所有16个设置中W-RAG均显著优于基线。

Conclusion: 在企业多源文档生成场景中，显式管理检索上下文在不同知识库间的分布对生成完整、忠实的文档至关重要。W-RAG通过结合本体引导的主题提取和源感知上下文分配，相比标准RAG管道在需求满足度和上下文相关性上均有显著提升，验证了"相关检索不等于高质量文档"的核心论点。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to incorporate external knowledge during generation, improving factual grounding and domain adaptability. However, existing RAG pipelines assume that evidence retrieved from multiple repositories can be ranked globally using a single similarity function. While suitable for open-domain retrieval, this assumption breaks down in enterprise document generation, where heterogeneous knowledge bases (such as policies, regulations, technical documentation, and departmental guidelines) serve distinct roles and must be jointly represented in the generated document. As a result, global ranking often produces unbalanced context dominated by a subset of sources, leading to incomplete enterprise drafts. To address this limitation, we propose W-RAG, a source-aware retrieval framework that performs ontology-guided retrieval, local ranking within each knowledge base, and source-level weighting to regulate evidence composition. We further introduce a new dataset for retrieval-grounded enterprise document generation spanning multiple document types and industry domains. Experiments show that standard RAG pipelines struggle on this task, while W-RAG significantly improves document coverage and generation quality.

</details>


### [185] [Constraint-Driven Modeling Enabling Dual Model Checking and Simulation for Discrete Event Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22095)
*Soroosh Gholami,Hessam S. Sarjoughian*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Constraint-DEVS方法，将Parallel DEVS扩展为可同时支持仿真和模型检测的有界形式化方法，并通过扩展DEVS-Suite框架实现这一双重能力。以Network-on-Chip（NoC）为案例，与UPPAAL进行对比，展示了其在复杂数据传输、选择性状态探索和性能属性验证方面的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Parallel DEVS虽然擅长模块化分层建模与仿真，但其连续时间特性和无界状态空间使其难以直接用于模型检测。现有DEVS模型检测方法（如FD-DEVS、RTA-DEVS）需要模型转换，丧失了DEVS的结构建模和复杂数据处理能力，且依赖LTL/CTL，无法表达复杂的QoS属性。作者旨在弥合仿真与验证之间的鸿沟，提供一个统一框架。

Method: 1. **Constraint-DEVS形式化**：在PDEVS基础上施加四项约束——有界状态变量（用正则表达式定义）、有界输入端口值、有限内部/外部事件数（离散时间基底）、以及状态探索协议。2. **状态探索协议**：基于"未访问Q/已访问V/不安全U"三集合的算法，包裹在仿真协议之上，每次单周期调用simulate()执行模型。3. **选择性状态探索**：状态变量可标记为explorable/unexplorable，灵活控制状态空间规模。4. **Experimental Frame（EF）扩展**：将原本用于仿真的生成器-转换器对复用于验证，支持超越LTL/CTL的复杂性能属性。5. **DEVS-Suite框架扩展**：新增VerifiableAtomic、StateVar、PortState、VerificationEngine等类，保持原有仿真功能完整。

Result: 1. **循环缓冲区验证**：用Constraint-DEVS建模8/16/32大小的FIFO缓冲区，验证同时事件处理等正确性，发现并修复了一个易被忽略的并发事件bug。2. **NoC模型对比**：在UPPAAL中用时间自动机建模单节点NoC；在DEVS-Suite中用Constraint-DEVS建立4节点NoC模型。3. **PE利用率实验**：对比轮询与自适应任务分配策略的负载均衡效果，自适应策略使最大/最小利用率差距从0.1-0.9缩小到0.09-0.56，但状态空间扩大15倍，验证时间从15.78s增至245.20s。4. **可扩展性测试**：4×3网络验证耗时约11小时，4×4网络无法完成，证实状态爆炸问题。5. **框架对比**：DEVS-Suite在复杂数据传输、选择性状态探索、结构建模方面优于UPPAAL，但执行速度较慢。

Conclusion: Constraint-DEVS成功将DEVS的仿真优势与模型检测相结合，无需模型转换即可实现验证与验证双重能力。其独特价值在于：支持复杂数据类型和结构建模、选择性状态探索降低状态空间、通过Experimental Frame表达复杂QoS属性。局限性在于面对大规模系统时的状态爆炸问题，可通过部分验证、多分辨率建模、验证与仿真结合等策略缓解。未来工作包括flit级NoC模型、公平性和死锁避免等属性的验证。

Abstract: Verification and validation (V&V) are crucial methods for evaluating the requirements and specifications of dynamical models that fulfill their intended purposes. Parallel Discrete EVent System Specification (PDEVS) is a system-theoretic modeling approach for creating modular, hierarchical component-based simulation models. In this paper, we introduce Constraint-DEVS, a method for creating bounded Parallel DEVS models that lend themselves, in addition to simulation, to model checking. We extend the DEVS-Suite framework to create Constraint-DEVS specifications which can then be model checked using a proposed state exploration protocol with the Parallel DEVS abstract simulator protocol. These capabilities, along with the support for non-determinism, complex data transfer, and performance-related property checking, make Constraint-DEVS and its accompanying DEVS-Suite a unique framework for the development, verification, and validation of discrete-event systems. In order to demonstrate this work, we developed and verified models of Network-on-Chip. Also, we detail behavioral design artifacts for the DEVS-Suite framework's hybrid model-checking and simulation engine.

</details>


### [186] [Towards Actionable Visualization: Ten Years Later, What Generative AI Changes and What It Cannot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22151)
*Leonel Merino,Mohammad Ghafari,Oscar Nierstrasz*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是对作者2016年软件可视化综述研究的回顾性反思，探讨生成式AI如何改变了该领域的核心瓶颈——从"匹配开发者需求与技术"转向"降低可视化生产成本"，同时提出了以人类感知与判断能力为核心的新研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2016年的研究假设软件可视化采用的瓶颈在于将开发者需求与可视化技术进行匹配。十年后，生成式AI已将可视化生产成本降至接近零，使该假设过时。作者旨在重新审视其原始分类数据，识别哪些发现被AI改变、哪些保持不变，并据此提出新的研究方向。

Method: 作者采用自我批判性的回顾方法：(1) 重新检视2016年对86项设计研究的七维分类结果（任务、需求、受众、数据源、表征、媒介、工具）；(2) 对2017-2025年VISSOFT所有论文标题进行扫描，统计沉浸式环境媒介的增长情况；(3) 通过推理分析AI对三个具体领域（被忽视的领域、工具寿命问题、交付媒介）的影响；(4) 提出三个研究重心转移方向并讨论风险。

Result: 三项主要发现：(1) 2016年标记为被忽视的领域（如设计依据rationale、契约contracts、策略policies）正是AI现在使之变得可处理的领域，因为AI消除了异构数据准备的成本障碍；(2) 工具寿命问题（平均3.7年，仅26%开源）可能因AI的非确定性而恶化——可丢弃的生成式工件数量可能增长数个数量级；(3) 沉浸式环境媒介论文占比从约1/100增长到约1/7（约15倍增长），但仍是少数。提出三个研究重心转移：从技术目录转向感知能力培养；从单一工具转向可丢弃的持续观察；从代码可视化转向AI推理过程本身的可视化。

Conclusion: 软件可视化的未来研究应聚焦于帮助人类理解大型复杂软件系统，包括AI智能体生成的推理过程。核心论点：生成变得廉价，但人类对所看到内容的感知与判断能力不可被AI替代。行动可视化（actionable visualization）不再是遥远的愿景，而是该领域现在可以达成的标准。然而，AI生成的可靠性风险、与机器在其擅长领域竞争的风险、以及缺乏审视的信任风险，均要求领域明确强化评估与可追溯性原则，建立相应的基准与激励结构。

Abstract: Ten years ago, we surveyed software visualization research under the assumption that the challenge for adoption was matching developers' needs with techniques. Generative AI might have made that assumption obsolete by driving the cost of producing a visualization on demand toward zero. We argue that this mirrors a broader inversion already underway in software engineering: as AI devalues the production of artifacts, it elevates the human work of perceiving and directing them. Looking back at our 2016 research, we found that domains we flagged as neglected, such as rationale, are exactly the ones AI now makes tractable, and a tool-sustainability problem we diagnosed then is one generative AI may worsen before it helps solve. One finding shifted outright: the share of studies delivered through immersive environments grew roughly fifteen-fold, though it remains a small minority of the field. We argue that future research should focus on helping people understand large and complex software systems, including the reasoning processes generated by AI agents alongside the code itself. Humans have always been accountable for what they trust, but AI may lead them to trust without enough scrutiny. We confront the risks that follow, from the reliability of AI-generated visualization itself to the temptation of competing with machines on their own terrain, and conclude that actionable visualization is no longer a distant destination but a standard the field can now meet.

</details>


### [187] [D-Diff: An Interactive Environment for Adjusting Commit Boundaries Based on an Editable 3-way Diff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22207)
*Daiki Muto,Takayoshi Ueno,Shinpei Hayashi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出D-Diff，一种基于可编辑3路diff的交互式提交边界调整工具，通过同时可视化两个连续提交的diff并提供直接编辑与移动操作来降低开发者的认知负荷。用户研究表明，D-Diff在效率上显著优于基线工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 版本控制最佳实践要求每个提交只包含单一任务相关的变更（TLC），但开发者常创建混合多意图的复合提交（CC）。调整提交边界需要同时比较和修改两个连续提交的diff，而现有工具要么一次只显示一个diff（依赖记忆），要么同时显示三个文件但不显示连续diff（需推导），都增加了认知负荷。因此需要专门的交互式工具来支持这一"最后一公里"的修正工作。

Method: D-Diff基于3路diff显示，以两个连续提交共享的中间版本s'为锚点，并排显示三个版本的源代码（左侧对应第一次提交的删除，中间为共享边界版本，右侧对应第二次提交的添加）。在对比层面，采用行级与字符级两级高亮和颜色编码（绿表示新增、红表示删除、对角条纹表示同时涉及两次提交的变化），消除记忆依赖。在修改层面，提供两种操作：(1)直接编辑中间源代码以任意放置边界；(2)以行级或hunk级粒度移动变更，通过中间与外侧版本之间的按钮触发。实现采用TypeScript+Nuxt.js的Web应用，行级对齐基于Myers算法（jsdiff），字符级基于diff-match-patch，编辑器使用Monaco Editor。

Result: 采用被试内设计，招募8名计算机科学专业且具两年以上Java经验的学生，与VS Code+GitLens基线工具对比，每名参与者使用两种工具各完成4个任务（共8个任务，来自UTANGO数据集中筛选的TLC对，通过随机移动20%行来构造错误的起始边界）。结果：(1)准确性：以中心源代码相对于正确答案的Levenshtein距离改进率为指标，D-Diff中位数更高但无统计学显著差异(p=0.5469)，尤其在需要行内分离的任务中表现较差；(2)效率：D-Diff中位调整时间230秒，基线530秒，减少57%（约300秒），Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=0.0078，Cliff's delta=0.8438（large），每位参与者使用D-Diff均更快；(3)可用性：Likert问卷所有项目D-Diff正面评价比例更高，参与者表示愿意使用。基线工具平均每任务需要18.6次屏幕切换，而D-Diff为单屏设计。

Conclusion: D-Diff通过将两个连续diff整合到单一3路diff视图中，显著降低了调整提交边界时的认知负荷和操作时间，效率提升约57%，可用性获得一致好评，但准确性未达显著差异。未来工作包括跨文件变更比较、扩展到更长提交序列、IDE集成、支持行内分离等细粒度修改，并将核心交互范式扩展到单一提交拆分、自动解缠输出整理等场景。主要局限：参与者少（8人）、仅Java语言、任务为人造修改而非真实纠缠提交、注入错误为行级（偏向基于移动的修正）、未单独隔离3路显示的独立效应。

Abstract: In version control, it is recommended that each commit include only changes related to one task. To follow this recommendation, developers may need to adjust commit boundaries, that is, to compare and modify the diffs between two consecutive commits. Existing tools either display only a single diff at a time, forcing developers to rely on their memory when comparing diffs, or display three files simultaneously without showing the two consecutive diffs, forcing developers to infer them; both increase their cognitive load and hamper the adjustment. As a first step toward supporting this process, we propose D-Diff, an interactive diff adjustment environment for two consecutive commits that each involve the same single file. Based on a 3-way diff display, D-Diff integrates the two diffs into a single compact view, which also provides a way to modify them. A within-subjects user study with 8 participants showed that D-Diff significantly outperforms a baseline tool in terms of efficiency, reducing the median adjustment time from 530 seconds to 230 seconds (approximately 57%). D-Diff also received a higher percentage of positive responses across all usability questionnaire items, while no statistically significant difference was found in accuracy.

</details>


### [188] [CodeMechanic: Bug-Property-Guided Program Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22275)
*Han Zheng,Rafaila Galanopoulou,Ilia Shumailov,Tianqi Fan,Aiden Hall,Dominik Maier,Mathias Payer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CodeMechanic是一个针对空间内存破坏的bug属性引导缓解系统,利用LLM重构被违反的边界属性,在危险访问前插入本地fail-stop守卫,以可控终止换取安全,与PatchAgent和San2Patch相比在101个ARVO真实漏洞上生成更多合理补丁且成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自动化漏洞修复(AVR)流程中,LLM生成的开放性补丁仅通过PoC重放验证,容易被"沉默崩溃"的错误补丁通过;同时LLM缺乏重建边界属性所需的代码与运行时上下文,以及有效调用调试工具的领域知识,导致漏洞修复速度跟不上fuzzer发现速度。

Method: 三大核心组件:(1)二维上下文提取器——通过代码视图(代码探索、宏解析、缓冲区推断)和数据视图(借助/不借助ASan元数据的指针与缓冲区验证、指针类型分析)恢复ptr、buf_begin、buf_end等关键变量;(2)提示中嵌入的人类调试知识——通过少样本提示指导工具调用顺序与错误处理;(3)Bug属性引导缓解——两阶段LLM代理,先实例化边界条件再插入可编译的守卫,采用基于错误信息的定向补丁修正与按需重试机制,同时通过Clang包装器强制-O0 -g并自建GDB 12.1以保证跨环境兼容性。

Result: 在101个ARVO真实漏洞上,CodeMechanic首次尝试即比最佳基线多生成47.6%的合理补丁(plausible patch)且仅消耗9%的token;五次尝试下多生成13.3%合理补丁,成本仅为十分之一;手工审计显示其生成的与开发者补丁语义等价的补丁是PatchAgent的3.4倍、San2Patch的4.3倍;主要失效模式为过度限制的边界(含绝对地址常量)。

Conclusion: 将补丁生成约束为本地边界守卫而非开放式LLM修复,在降低副作用的同时能够高效生成可部署的临时缓解,以可控终止换取安全性,可作为开发者准备永久修复期间的快速保护手段。

Abstract: Automated testing discovers vulnerabilities faster than developers can investigate and repair them, leaving an interval in which known memory corruptions remain exploitable. End- to-end LLM repair agents can shorten this interval, but they synthesize open-ended code changes and commonly validate them only by replaying a proof of concept (PoC). This weak oracle accepts patches that silence the observed crash by changing unrelated behavior, making unintended deployment risky. We present CodeMechanic, a bug-property-guided system for generating constrained mit- igations for spatial memory corruption. Instead of asking an LLM to generate a permanent repair, CodeMechanic reconstructs the violated memory-safety property from the crash, validates the dereferenced pointer and its buffer range, and inserts a local fail-stop guard before the dangerous access. The guard terminates execution when the boundary check fails. The resulting mitigation deliberately trades availability for security: it can convert potential remote code execution into controlled termination while developers investigate the root cause and prepare a permanent repair. CodeMechanic combines a two-dimensional static and dynamic context extractor with in-prompt debugging knowledge and stepwise val- idation to limit the effect of LLM errors. On 101 real-world ARVO bugs, the first attempt of CodeMechanic produces 47.6% more plausible patches (i.e., patches that pass PoC- replay validation) than the best baseline while using 91% fewer tokens. Manual audit further shows that CodeMechanic produces 3.4x - 4.3x more patches semantically equivalent to developer-written repairs.

</details>


### [189] [Learning Spectral Representations of Code through Latent Graph Learning for Generalizable Cross-Language Code Clone Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22383)
*Mohsen Hesamolhokama,Ali Sadeghi,Kousha Moeini,Behnam Rohani,Mohammadamin Fazli,Jafar Habibi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出SPECTRA-Siam模型，通过潜在图学习和谱表示实现跨语言代码克隆检测，在BigCloneBench、AtCoder和四语言CodeNet基准上显著优于固定图谱方法，且在跨语言迁移中表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码克隆检测方法依赖固定的、语言特定的图表示（如AST、PDG），由于功能相同但结构不同的代码片段会产生非判别性的谱特征，性能接近随机水平。需要在共享潜在空间中学习图结构，使谱签名能跨语言反映功能等价性。

Method: 提出SPECTRA-Siam，一种暹罗潜在图学习网络：(1) 输入归一化阶段使用AST+DDG关系，映射到24种规范化节点类型与哈希词法特征；(2) 关系感知结构编码使用关系型GNN；(3) 潜在图归纳通过软槽分配（32个潜在节点，3次迭代）与多头注意力，结合输入结构先验生成加权潜在邻接矩阵；(4) 多尺度谱表示从归一化Laplacian提取特征值密度、热迹与Chebyshev图信号能量（共152维）；(5) 训练目标结合分类损失、谱对比损失、AUC排序损失、难负样本分离、节点与拓扑重构、谱方差保持与图正则化（共8项损失）。

Result: 在BigCloneBench上从固定图的F1=0.37提升至0.67；在AtCoder上准确率从0.60提升至0.71；在四语言CodeNet基准上4个epoch达0.69、30个epoch达0.79准确率；在60条桥接辅助语言迁移路径上性能仅下降0.058，远优于基线（0.112-0.228），是唯一在全部6个跨语言对上都高于随机水平的方法。训练开销中谱描述仅占5.10%、特征分解仅占1.07%，效率较高。

Conclusion: 学习图结构对于获得判别性代码谱表示至关重要；SPECTRA-Siam在单语言与跨语言场景中均具有竞争力，在语言迁移鲁棒性上显著优于现有方法，且谱引入的计算开销可控。未来可探索更大训练预算、更丰富输入表示与该潜在图在其他软件工程任务（如漏洞检测、代码搜索）中的通用性。

Abstract: Current code clone detection (CCD) methods rely on fixed, language-specific graph representations like abstract syntax trees (ASTs) or program dependency graphs (PDGs). Because functionally identical code fragments can yield wildly different structures, these rigid graphs produce non-discriminative spectra that perform close to chance. To address this, we propose SPECTRA-Siam, a Siamese latent graph learning network that learns a latent space such that the graph's spectrum serves as a discriminative signature of code functionality by optimizing downstream CCD performance. Given a fragment's AST and data-dependencies, SPECTRA-Siam induces a fixed-size weighted latent graph through soft slot assignment and multi-head attention, and extracts a multi-scale spectral representation from its normalized Laplacian. Mapping all fragments into this shared space yields comparable spectra across programming languages. Experiments on BigCloneBench, AtCoder, and a four-language CodeNet benchmark (Java, Python, C++, C#) support this design choice. Using the same downstream classifier, moving from fixed to learned latent graphs spectra jumps F1 from 0.37 to 0.67 on BigCloneBench and accuracy from 0.60 to 0.71 on AtCoder. On CodeNet, the full model reaches 0.69 accuracy in four epochs and 0.79 after thirty epochs. In bridge-assisted language transfer across 60 unseen paths, SPECTRA-Siam's performance degrades by only 0.058, versus 0.112--0.228 for baselines, showing that learned graph spectra provide a highly generalizable representation for cross-language clone detection.

</details>


### [190] [Benchmarking the Titans: A Multi-Dimensional Empirical Evaluation of LLM Code Generation Quality in the .NET Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22529)
*Seyed Mohammad Mahdi Ghalandarian,Majid Bazargani,Masoumeh Taromirad*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代码生成评估中过度依赖Pass@k单一指标及Python中心化的问题，构建了一个面向C#/.NET生态的自动化多维度评估框架，并对GPT-4、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude 3.5 Sonnet和Grok 3四种主流LLM在85个HumanEval任务上的表现进行了实证研究。核心发现是功能正确性与代码质量之间几乎正交（Pearson r=0.075），揭示了Pass@k排名系统性地误导了对LLM软件工程能力的全面评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码生成评估存在两大根本局限：(1) HumanEval、MBPP等基准以Pass@k单一指标将多维质量问题简化为二元正确性信号，掩盖了可维护性、可读性和运行时效率等工程实践关键属性；(2) 评估生态几乎完全聚焦Python，而企业级C#/.NET生态（金融、游戏、企业软件）缺乏专门的统一评估基础设施，无法得出可靠的生态特定结论。

Method: 四阶段端到端自动化管道：(1) 数据准备阶段将HumanEval的85个任务转化为Excel结构化记录，并附加solution_prompt和benchmark_prompt两个工程化提示字段（后者由独立DeepSeek生成以防止输入偏差）；(2) 并行代码生成阶段对四个LLM API以temperature=0调用，将输出组装为共享.NET 8.0项目（含Solver类、基准测试harness、测试运行器），并实现ExtractMethodBodyRobust括号计数算法处理格式不一致问题；(3) 三遍评估阶段——功能正确性（通过.NET Reflection执行HumanEval断言+CompareNetObjects深比较）、静态代码质量（Microsoft Roslyn AST分析四项指标：圈复杂度、嵌套深度、命名违规、专业度评分）、运行时性能（使用BenchmarkDotNet在N=100/1000/10000最坏输入下进行对抗性剖析，记录中位执行时间和堆内存分配）；(4) 结果聚合阶段计算综合质量评分（5个归一化子分量加权平均，复杂度与嵌套取反归一化）。所有340个解决方案-模型对（85任务×4模型）合并至结构化数据集进行跨维度Pearson相关分析。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 功能正确性——Gemini领先（98.53%，仅2个失败），Claude（98.32%）、Grok（97.98%）次之，GPT最低（96.37%）且方差最高（SD=15.37），呈双峰失败模式；两任务（csharp_57、csharp_64）所有模型表现一致，暗示训练数据重叠。(2) 代码质量——Claude生成结构最简单代码（圈复杂度2.47、嵌套1.13）；跨模型相同任务的复杂度Pearson相关系数r=0.63–0.69，表明任务固有难度是结构复杂性的主要驱动因素。(3) 运行时性能——GPT执行最快（中位4823ns）；内存分配Grok（6.0MB）＜GPT（11.7MB）＜Gemini（28.9MB）＜Claude（156.6MB），Claude在csharp_12任务执行时间达2.56×10¹¹ns、csharp_16任务分配3.94GB堆内存，存在异常算法策略。(4) 核心发现——正确性与综合质量评分的Pearson r=0.075，所有非对角元|r|＜0.18，表明功能正确性与代码质量在经验上正交，正确性排名系统性地误判了模型的质量排序。(5) GPT失败任务时质量评分从39.51骤降至22.44，呈系统性而非边缘性退化。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于：构建了首个面向C#/.NET生态的整合功能正确性、静态质量与运行时效率的自动化多维度评估框架；通过340个解决方案的实证分析证实功能正确性与结构代码质量在经验上正交（r=0.075），直接挑战了Pass@k作为软件工程场景下LLM唯一评估标准的充分性。四个模型呈现差异化特征：Gemini最可靠、Grok综合最均衡、Claude结构最简但内存最高、GPT速度最快但结构最复杂且存在严重双峰失败。框架为数据集无关设计，可扩展至企业级.NET模式（异步编程、LINQ管道）；未来工作将包括：通过专家研究校准质量评分权重、研究显式风格注入提示、多运行方差分析以及使用排除正确性的四分量评分验证正交性发现。复现包已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) code generation quality requires examining not just whether the generated code is correct, but whether it is maintainable, efficient, and stylistically sound, all of which are qualities of direct importance to software engineering practitioners. Existing benchmarks reduce evaluation to a single Pass@k metric, which obscures critical trade-offs between functional correctness and structural quality. A further limitation is the near-exclusive focus on Python, leaving enterprise-relevant ecosystems such as C# and .NET without dedicated evaluation. This paper presents an automated, multi-dimensional evaluation framework for C# code generation, applying it to four state-of-the-art LLMs: GPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok. We conduct a controlled experiment across 85 algorithmic tasks derived from HumanEval, generating and evaluating 340 solutions in total, in which each solution is assessed across three independent dimensions: functional correctness via automated unit testing, static code quality via Roslyn AST analysis, and runtime efficiency via adversarial BenchmarkDotNet profiling. Our central finding reveals a substantial gap between correctness and quality attributes (Pearson r = 0.075), demonstrating that Pass@k rankings systematically misrepresent the full LLM performance profile in software engineering contexts. We further characterize GPT's bimodal failure behavior.

</details>


### [191] [Execution-Anchored Hallucination Calibration Reranking for Verilog Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22938)
*Guang Yang,Xing Hu,Xiang Chen,Terry Yue Zhuo,Xin Xia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 针对低资源Verilog代码生成任务，提出EAHC双通道重排序框架：独立获取执行信号（自生成测试台）与推理信号（微调的4B判别器），仅在决策阶段融合，通过执行等效聚类为推理锚定执行行为，缓解领域迁移性差与推理幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在Verilog等低资源HDL上Pass@1远低于Pass@10，现有重排序方法存在两个关键缺陷：基于执行的方法因自生成测试台质量差而领域迁移性差；LLM-as-a-Judge对执行等价代码产生推理幻觉，给出不一致判断。两种信号误差正交，理论上可互补，但让推理器直接观察执行结果会引发锚定偏置。

Method: EAHC双通道重排序框架：(1) EAHC-T：通过RAG+多教师蒸馏构建的53K测试台生成器，仅从需求生成测试台，不观察候选代码，独立获取执行信号；(2) EAHC-R：在47K编译器验证推理轨迹上微调Qwen3-4B的判别器，仅从(需求,代码)推理正确性，不观察执行结果，通过多数投票聚合；(3) 按执行向量聚类形成执行等效簇，仅在决策阶段以α=0.6线性融合执行通过率与簇级推理置信度，最后在最优簇内选推理分最高者。信息论分析（基于DPI的定理1）证明独立获取的事后交互式融合不优于原始两信号联合信息量。

Result: 在VerilogEval-v2和ResBench上跨9个模型（商用GPT-5/DeepSeek-V3/GLM-4.6、通用Qwen2.5-Coder/OpenCoder/Seed-Coder、Verilog专用HaVen/VeriPrefer/CodeV-R1）的18种配置中15种取得最佳：平均Pass@1从53.99%提升至65.10%（VerilogEval-v2）和53.18%至68.25%（ResBench），分别超越最强基线+5.91%和+4.96%，恢复超过60%的Pass@1到Pass@10差距。消融显示EAHC-R贡献+7.12%、EAHC-T贡献+5.75%；独立融合在全部配置上优于交互式融合（+4.49%/+4.56%）；与SFT/RL训练正交（各阶段提升+8.93%到+19.64%）。生成测试台存在6.6%-12.8%误接受、47.3%-49.6%误拒绝，约25%簇仍混合正误样例。执行等价代码间推理不一致率仍有4.8%-7.1%。

Conclusion: 独立获取两通道信号再于决策阶段融合是Verilog重排序的有效设计原则，执行锚定解决了推理对执行等价代码的不一致评分问题。该框架与训练优化正交，可在推理时进一步提升LLM的Verilog生成质量；未来工作包括扩展至其他低资源HDL、工业级基准验证，以及引入形式化验证作为互补信号。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation, yet their performance degrades significantly on low-resource Hardware Description Languages such as Verilog. While multi-candidate sampling improves the likelihood of generating correct solutions, au-tomatically selecting the optimal candidate remains an open challenge. Through a systematic empirical study across nine models and two benchmarks, we identify two critical limitations:(1) existing execution-based reranking methods, which rely on testbench pass/fail outcomes, exhibit poor domain transferability due to low-quality generated testbenches; and (2) LLM-as-a-Judge suffers from reasoning hallucination, producing incon-sistent judgments for execution-equivalent code. These findings reveal two signal types with orthogonal errors: execution signals(deterministic but testbench coverage limited)and reasoning signals (semantically rich but hallucination-prone). Their orthog-onality suggests combining the two signals, yet in our experiments letting the reasoner directly observe execution results merely anchors its judgments on test outcomes; we therefore acquire the two signals independently and fuse them only at the decision stage. Based on these insights, we propose EAHC, an Execution-Anchored Hallucination Calibration reranking framework that anchors reasoning judgments to execution behavior so that execution-equivalent candidates receive consistent scores, which implements a dual-channel architecture: EAHC-R, a 4B reasoning discriminator; and EAHC-T, a testbench generator leveraging RAG for execution verification.

</details>


### [192] [Fairness Hazard Analysis for Socio-Technical Processes: A Multiple-Case Study in Bias-sensitive Organisational Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22978)
*Giovanna Broccia,Lucio Lelii,Roberto Cirillo,Dario Di Nucci,Samuel Fricker,Fabio Palomba,Giorgio O. Spagnolo,Alessio Ferrari*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Fairness Hazard Analysis (FHA)方法，用于在需求工程阶段系统性地识别、分析和缓解社会技术过程中的公平性风险。通过两个真实组织的招聘流程多案例研究，将FHA从TRL 3推进到TRL 5验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在社会技术过程中，人、组织流程、软件系统及AI技术的交互可能导致不公平决策结果。如果不及时处理，公平性危害会累积并强化系统性偏见。然而，现有的公平性研究主要聚焦于AI模型层面的度量与缓解技术，缺乏面向社会技术过程的需求级系统化方法。

Method: FHA借鉴安全工程中的Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA)框架，通过四步流程运作：A. 系统定义（建模社会技术过程）；B. 公平性危害识别；C. 危害评估（后果、传播、影响、可能性、风险）；D. 缓解规划。在多案例研究中，采用五阶段操作化：探索性焦点小组与流程获取、流程重建与建模、流程验证、应用FHA、反馈与评估会话。研究采用整体性多案例设计，选取两家差异显著的组织（一家跨国制造企业、一家高等教育机构），通过主题分析进行跨案例综合。

Result: 组织A识别15项公平性危害（涉及约27%的流程元素），组织B识别14项危害（涉及约17%）。跨案例综合归纳出8类反复出现的危害类别（流程治理缺口、不平等机会获取、机会规范偏见、AI中介内容偏见、信息不对等优势、主观或亲和性评估、程序性评估不一致、认知负荷与顺序效应）和3类情境特定类别。缓解策略归纳为7类（治理与问责、独立审查、透明与平等机会、标准化与结构化评估、AI监督与多元化、集体决策保护、工作负荷管理）。实践者总体认可危害的现实性和缓解措施的可行性，但指出可行性取决于组织契合度、资源和成本。FHA在两家组织中均促进了反思，揭示了此前未充分关注的公平性问题，并使已有实践的公平性功能得到显性化。

Conclusion: FHA提供了一种结构化、经过经验验证的方法，将公平性整合到需求工程中，预防社会技术过程中的系统性偏见。该方法应通过结合公平性、需求工程和应用领域专业知识的跨学科团队协作迭代应用。研究将FHA从TRL 3推进到TRL 5。未来工作应在更多组织、领域和监管环境中纵向实施和评估FHA衍生的缓解措施，发展危害与缓解方案库，并强化影响与可能性评估的指导。

Abstract: Fairness is increasingly recognised as a first-class requirement in socio-technical processes, where interactions among human actors, software systems, and AI technologies may lead to unfair outcomes in decision-making workflows. If left unaddressed, fairness hazards may accumulate and reinforce systemic bias, highlighting the need to engineer fairness proactively. Despite growing interest in fairness-aware systems, systematic methods for identifying fairness hazards in socio-technical processes and deriving requirements-level mitigations remain limited. To support fairness-by-design during requirements engineering (RE), Fairness Hazard Analysis (FHA) is introduced as a methodology for systematically identifying, analysing, and mitigating fairness hazards. FHA is first assessed through a proof-of-concept validation conducted via two focus groups. Then, a qualitative multiple-case study involving two organisations examines its applicability in real-world settings. The proof-of-concept validation highlighted the benefits derived from the structured nature of the method, and suggested the need to include iterative, dialogic reflection with domain experts. In the multiple case-study where FHA was applied, the practitioners involved were positively impressed by the results and confirmed the relevance of the identified fairness hazards (spanning up to 27% of the process elements), as well as the appropriateness of most of the proposed mitigations, while noting that contextual factors might hinder their implementation. The evaluation also highlighted mitigation patterns, such as independent review and collective decision-making, which can be transferred to different organisations. This paper contributes a structured and empirically validated methodology for integrating fairness considerations in RE and preventing systemic bias in socio-technical processes.

</details>


### [193] [ARGUS: MCP-Grounded Root Cause Analysis for Kubernetes Incidents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23084)
*Ergi Senja,Seyed Mohammad Reza Razavi Zadegan,Philipp Leitner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ARGUS 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的 Kubernetes 事故根因分析助手，通过标准化 MCP 服务器连接商业 LLM 与实时可观测数据，在 10 个故障注入场景中均正确识别了根因，但用户对其推荐的修复措施普遍持怀疑态度，揭示了诊断能力与处方能力之间的不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kubernetes 事故诊断需要在多个监控工具之间关联指标、日志、容器状态和消息系统，这种碎片化工作流减慢了诊断速度并导致告警疲劳。现有的基于 LLM 的 RCA 系统依赖定制的、针对特定系统的数据访问层，无法跨组织复用，限制了其在不同部署环境中的可移植性。

Method: ARGUS 采用两组件架构，通过 NATS JetStream 异步消息总线连接 Slack 应用和 AI 诊断代理。AI 代理使用四个只读 MCP 服务器（Kubernetes 状态、Prometheus 指标、Loki 日志、NATS 消息）访问可观测数据，结合 ReAct 循环、eARCO 八阶段诊断框架、检索增强生成（RAG）和上下文文件层进行诊断。系统使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 作为底层 LLM，输出结构化的 OperatorBrief 格式，包含事件解释、根因、证据、推荐修复和确定性置信度标签。评估采用三种互补方法：在 10 个 Kubernetes 故障注入场景中进行受控测试、对 RCA 摘要进行三维度（正确性、证据支撑、可操作性）的评分量表评估，以及对 6 名值班工程师进行半结构化访谈。

Result: 在 10 个故障注入场景中，ARGUS 均正确识别了根本原因，MCP 工具调用的总体成功率为 0.91（82 次调用中 75 次成功）。8 个场景实现了完整证据覆盖，2 个场景因 RBAC 限制和凭证缺失而部分覆盖。RQ2 评分显示正确性 8/10 完全满足、证据支撑 7/10 完全满足、可操作性 7/10 完全满足（2 个未满足均出现在可操作性维度）。RQ3 访谈揭示了核心发现——诊断/处方不对称性：所有 6 名受访者都信任诊断输出，但都对推荐修复措施表示怀疑。

Conclusion: ARGUS 证明了协议介导的 grounding 能够在无需模型微调或定制数据访问层的情况下实现可靠的证据检索和根因识别，但推荐修复措施是输出中最不可靠、最不被信任的部分。核心限制在于 MCP 服务器覆盖范围而非模型推理能力。该研究对未来自主代理式事故处理系统具有重要启示：应将命令提议能力作为单独授权的功能，并遵循诊断优先、处方谨慎的设计原则。

Abstract: Kubernetes incident triage requires correlating signals from metrics, logs, container state, and messaging systems across multiple monitoring tools, a fragmented workflow that slows diagnosis and contributes to alert fatigue. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for automated root cause analysis (RCA), but existing systems rely on custom, system-specific data access layers that cannot be reused across organisations. We present ARGUS, an MCP-grounded RCA assistant that connects a commercial LLM to live Kubernetes observability data through standardised MCP servers covering Kubernetes state, Prometheus metrics, Loki logs, and NATS messaging, and delivers structured diagnostic summaries inside the Slack incident channel where on-call engineers already work. We conduct a preliminary evaluation of ARGUS using three complementary methods: controlled fault injection across ten Kubernetes incident scenarios, rubric-based scoring of the resulting RCA summaries on three dimensions, and semi-structured interviews with six on-call engineers at an industrial partner. ARGUS named the correct root cause in all ten scenarios with an aggregate MCP success ratio of 0.91. Practitioners trusted the diagnostic output but consistently expressed scepticism toward the recommended fixes. Our central finding is a diagnostic/prescriptive asymmetry: ARGUS reliably identifies what went wrong, but is perceived as less reliable or trustworthy at specifying what to do next. This pattern can be observed across all three evaluation methods, and has important implications for future autonomous agentic incident handling systems.

</details>


### [194] [A Multi-Viewpoint Modeling Framework for Digital Twin Integration and Reuse with LLM-Assisted Compatibility Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23115)
*Nafiseh Soveizi,Milan Kopp,Parinaz Rashidi,Qing Shan,Geerten M. Hengeveld,Ioannis N. Athanasiadis,Zhiming Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于RM-ODP的多视角建模框架，用于数字孪生生态系统中的异构模型集成与复用，结合LLM辅助的兼容性分析，实现设计阶段的系统性可行性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字生需要整合异构计算模型，但现有模型在语义意图、数据结构、行为接口和执行环境方面存在异质性，导致集成成为难以预测、量化和比较的跨视图一致性问题。现有标准和集成平台对结构化、目的感知的兼容性评估及早期可行性分析支持有限，兼容性评估主要依赖专家经验而非机器可解释的建模构造。

Method: 基于RM-ODP的五个视角（领域、信息、计算、工程、技术）构建：(1) 视角结构化的Model Metamodel，用于系统性模型描述与发现；(2) 模式感知的Mismatch Detector，通过混合机制结合确定性规则生成与LLM辅助推理，操作化跨视图兼容性约束。形式化定义集成模式为一流建模构件，并将不匹配分为模式无关和模式特定（信息级与运行时级）两类。在环境建模领域通过四阶段模式工程过程（标准分析→利益相关者细化→专家验证→实证应用）进行实例化。

Result: 基于44个模型、11个集成配置的实证评估显示：纯规则基线方法F1为0.35（高召回但极低精度），LLM辅助方法显著提升性能，GPT-OSS-120B达到F1=0.86。技术视图表现最佳（F1达1.00），信息视图也接近完美（0.99），领域视图最具挑战性（0.38-0.54）。Shared模式预测效果最好（0.96），One-Way模式因元数据不完整表现最差。检测到的不匹配类型中，软件环境不匹配占29.2%为最大类别。专家验证证实信息视图的元数据最重要且最完整，领域视图存在学科差异。

Conclusion: 框架通过将集成假设提升为一流的机器可操作建模构件，实现了超越执行中心互操作性解决方案的设计阶段兼容性评估，使DT生态系统中的系统性模型发现、可行性评估和集成分析成为可能。未来工作将聚焦于形式化中介构件用于不匹配解决，以及自动化元数据生成和语义对齐支持。

Abstract: Digital Twin (DT) ecosystems integrate heterogeneous computational models to represent complex systems under evolving, purpose-specific objectives. Systematic reuse of existing high-quality models and datasets is essential for scalable DT development, yet is constrained by heterogeneity in semantic intent, data structures, behavioral interfaces, and execution environments. As a result, integration becomes a cross-model, cross-view consistency problem that is hard to predict, quantify, and compare across design choices. Existing standards and integration platforms address these concerns separately, offering limited support for structured, purpose-aware compatibility assessment and early feasibility analysis when models are reused under new DT objectives. This paper introduces a multi-viewpoint integration modeling framework grounded in the Reference Model of Open Distributed Processing (RM-ODP). The framework structures integration-relevant knowledge across domain, information, computational, engineering, and technology viewpoints, representing cross-view dependencies as explicit, machine-actionable metadata. It comprises (i) a viewpoint-structured Model Metamodel for systematic model description and discovery, and (ii) a pattern-aware Mismatch Detector that operationalizes cross-view compatibility constraints via integration patterns, combining deterministic rule generation with Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted reasoning. This enables systematic identification of semantic, informational, and runtime inconsistencies and supports reasoning about integration feasibility and effort before implementation. Expert validation and an environmental modeling case study show that the approach enables structured compatibility reasoning, improves transparency of integration assumptions, strengthens cross-view interoperability, and supports scalable reuse in heterogeneous DT ecosystems.

</details>


### [195] [From Metrics to Improvement: A Lifecycle-Aware LLM Feedback Framework for Research Software Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23118)
*Nafis Tanveer Islam,Nafiseh Soveizi,Yutong Li,Zhiming Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向研究软件的生命周期感知框架，将定量软件质量评估与基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码优化相结合，通过质量模型诊断指标驱动LLM迭代改代码，以提升研究软件的可维护性、可复用性与可持续性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究软件（尤其是Jupyter Notebook类）常由非软件工程背景的研究者开发，存在可维护性、可复现性和可持续性方面的质量问题。现有静态分析工具输出难以解读，且缺乏将质量评估转化为可操作改进的机制。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 基于软件质量标准与实践者需求构建生命周期感知的质量模型，定义5个质量维度与25个候选指标，其中14个通过现有工具与自定义测量进行操作化；(2) 将质量诊断结果作为结构化反馈驱动LLM迭代优化代码，并反复重新评估质量。在Notebook类研究软件上对比多种LLM，测试迭代结构化反馈 vs. 单步反馈 vs. 非结构化提示的效果。

Result: 部分质量属性得到改善，尤其在代码重复与结构质量方面提升显著；同时也暴现在可维护性、代码体积、文档与复杂度之间存在权衡，体现出该任务的多目标特性。

Conclusion: 基于指标驱动的LLM反馈机制具备提升研究软件质量的潜力，但其实质是一个多目标优化问题，需在多个相互制约的质量维度间进行权衡。

Abstract: Research software is increasingly central to scientific workflows, yet it is often developed by researchers with limited software engineering expertise. This can lead to quality issues that hinder maintainability, reproducibility, reuse, and sustainability. Existing static analysis tools can identify such issues, but their outputs often require expert interpretation and provide limited support for translating quality assessments into actionable improvements. To address this gap, we propose a lifecycle-aware framework that integrates quantitative software quality assessment with Large Language Model (LLM)-based code refinement. The framework comprises two stages. First, a lifecycle-aware Quality Model is developed from established software quality standards and practitioner requirements. The model defines five quality dimensions and 25 candidate metrics, of which 14 are operationalized using existing analysis tools and custom measurements. Second, the resulting quality diagnostics are used as structured feedback within an iterative LLM-based refinement process, enabling generated improvements to be repeatedly reassessed against the Quality Model. We evaluate the framework on notebook-centric research software using multiple LLMs and compare iterative structured feedback with single-step feedback and unstructured prompting. The results show improvements in specific quality attributes, particularly code duplication and structural quality, while also revealing trade-offs among maintainability, code size, documentation, and complexity. These findings demonstrate the potential of metric-driven LLM feedback for research software quality improvement while highlighting its inherently multi-objective nature \footnote{The source code and experimental data are publicly available at this https URL . }

</details>


### [196] [An AI-Assisted Migration Framework for Transforming Legacy Scientific Applications into Reusable Cloud-Based Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23146)
*Nafiseh Soveizi,Sven Tesselaar,Hero Robinson Brouwer,Zhiming Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种AI辅助的遗留科学应用迁移框架，通过集成RM-ODP架构分析、LLM工作流分解和DSM质量评估，将遗留科学软件自动转化为可在云原生VRE中复用的可执行工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗留科学应用通常与特定执行环境紧耦合，难以复用和复现；现有迁移方法主要针对单一制品（如Notebook或容器），缺乏对异构遗留应用进行系统化工作流分解的完整支持。

Method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) RM-ODP引导的LLM工作流分解器，将五个RM-ODP视角嵌入LLM提示以识别工作流组件、接口和执行依赖；(2) DSM质量评估器，通过设计结构矩阵分析评估耦合度、内聚性和循环依赖等问题；(3) LLM工作流生成器，根据验证后的工作流模式生成容器化组件和可执行工作流定义。两个专家验证检查点支持迭代精炼。

Result: 在两个不同领域的遗留应用（BGIS城市数字孪生Python脚本和FreVA食品资源优化Jupyter Notebook）上评估，框架分别经过2轮和3轮迭代精炼后成功迁移为与参考工作流语义等效的可复用云原生工作流，输出结果与原始应用完全一致，可复用性指标（IC、UC、RCC、R）与参考工作流接近。

Conclusion: 结合架构引导、LLM生成与客观结构质量评估的迭代迁移框架能够有效将异构遗留科学软件转化为可复用的云原生工作流。未来工作将扩展更多案例、减少对专家反馈的依赖，并支持更丰富的工作流结构与跨平台互操作性。

Abstract: Legacy scientific applications remain valuable research assets but are often tightly coupled to project-specific execution environments, limiting their reuse, reproducibility, and deployment within modern scientific workflow systems and cloud-native Virtual Research Environments (VREs). Existing migration approaches primarily target individual artifacts, such as notebooks or containers, and provide limited support for systematically transforming heterogeneous legacy applications into reusable cloud-native workflows. This paper presents an AI-assisted migration framework that combines the Reference Model of Open Distributed Processing (RM-ODP)-guided architectural analysis, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Design Structure Matrix (DSM) analysis. The framework first uses RM-ODP to guide an LLM in identifying reusable workflow components, their interfaces, and execution dependencies from heterogeneous legacy applications. The resulting workflow structure is then iteratively evaluated and refined using DSM analysis. Finally, an LLM-based workflow generator implements the validated workflow components and produces containerized execution environments and executable workflow definitions for deployment in cloud-native workflow systems, including VREs. The framework was evaluated on two legacy scientific applications from different scientific domains. In both cases, the applications were successfully transformed into reusable cloud-native workflows while preserving their original functionality, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed approach for modernizing legacy scientific software.

</details>


### [197] [LLMCrater: Lifecycle-Aware FAIR Metadata Generation using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23158)
*Dani Termaat,Nafiseh Soveizi,Zhiming Zhao,Marios Avgeris*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LLMCrater是一个生命周期感知的FAIR元数据自动生成框架，结合大语言模型与阶段特定的RO-Crate元数据配置文件，在研究生命周期的四个阶段（设计、开发、部署、执行与溯源）中逐步丰富元数据，生成符合RO-Crate 1.1规范的机器可操作研究对象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的FAIR元数据发布工作流通常仅在项目完成后的发布阶段生成元数据，导致研究生命周期早期阶段的上下文和溯源信息丢失，无法支持渐进式FAIR化、早期共享和协作。此外，遵循RO-Crate和EOSC标准创建合规元数据仍是一项劳动密集型工作。

Method: LLMCrater基于检索增强生成（RAG）工作流（使用LangChain实现），将生命周期配置文件和RO-Crate 1.1规范文档通过nomic-embed-text-v1.5嵌入并索引到Chroma向量数据库；生成阶段，结合研究资产和检索到的指南，由本地通过Ollama运行的Qwen3-30B模型生成符合规范的JSON-LD元数据；最后使用RO-Crate Python库验证并打包为RO-Crate，支持发布至Zenodo获取DOI。

Result: 通过SLICES-RI 5G实验环境和GreenDIGIT的EcoJupyter平台两个异构用例的验证，LLMCrater成功在四个生命周期阶段提取并丰富元数据，生成的RO-Crate均通过RO-Crate 1.1规范验证。研究对象的实体与关系数量从设计阶段的20个/5种元数据类型逐步增长至执行与溯源阶段的70个/14种元数据类型。

Conclusion: LLMCrater实现了在整个研究生命周期中渐进式丰富FAIR元数据，生成符合RO-Crate 1.1规范的机器可操作研究对象，支持发布到FAIR存储库。该框架具有基础设施无关性，可被其他管理异构研究资产的研究基础设施（如LifeWatch）采用。

Abstract: FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) metadata is essential for the discovery, interoperability, and reuse of scientific research assets. However, creating and maintaining FAIR metadata remains largely manual, making the process time-consuming for heterogeneous research artifacts generated throughout the research lifecycle. Existing approaches primarily generate metadata at publication time, missing opportunities to capture contextual information as it becomes available. To address this limitation, we present \emph{LLMCrater}, a lifecycle-aware metadata generation framework that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with stage-specific RO-Crate metadata profiles. The framework progressively enriches metadata across four research lifecycle stages (Design, Development, Deployment, and Execution \& Provenance) while remaining compatible with RO-Crate~1.1 and EOSC metadata recommendations. It automatically extracts metadata from heterogeneous artifacts, generates and validates machine-actionable RO-Crates, and supports publication to FAIR repositories and PID services (e.g., Zenodo). We demonstrate the approach using two representative use cases: a 5G experimentation environment within SLICES-RI and an experiment on GreenDIGIT's EcoJupyter platform. Results show that LLMCrater progressively enriches metadata throughout the research lifecycle and generates valid RO-Crates conforming to the RO-Crate~1.1 specification.

</details>


### [198] [TianoForge: An Automated Bug Triage Approach for the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Community](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23259)
*Nazanin Siavash,Terrance E. Boult,Armin Moin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TianoForge是面向TianoCore EDK II开源UEFI固件项目的自动化Bug分诊框架,通过GPT系列大语言模型结合检索增强生成(RAG)技术,集成了无效报告检测、重复报告检测、优先级预测和开发者分配四项任务。相比人工分诊平均耗时约11天,TianoForge将分诊时间缩短至约7分钟,降低99.95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TianoCore EDK II作为主流开源UEFI固件项目积累了海量未分诊的Issue,传统人工分诊效率低、耗时长且易出错;同时社区中已出现LLM辅助生成的低质量报告问题,亟需领域感知的自动化分诊工具替代纯人工流程。

Method: 1) 基于GitHub API与历史Bugzilla语料构建数据集(75条GitHub原生Issue + 2,535条迁移Issue);2) 提出统一的LLM分诊脚本,集成四项任务(无效检测、重复检测、优先级分类、开发者分配);3) 检索层采用BGE-base-en-v1.5稠密检索+BM25稀疏检索,经RRF(k₀=60)融合;4) 对比System A(留一法/固定少样本提示)与System B(RAG增强)两种配置;5) 评估10个OpenAI/Anthropic LLM,在Google Colab上运行3次取均值。

Result: Bug分配:gpt-5.5 (System A) 准确率0.973,Macro-F1 0.977;重复检测:claude-sonnet-4-6在零重复与2对重复基准下均达到P+=1.000且零误报;优先级分类:claude-sonnet-4-6 (System A) Macro-F1 0.620,gpt-5.4-mini准确率0.671;无效检测:claude-sonnet-4-6 (System A) Macro-F1 0.653;集成流水线在37个标注Issue上总耗时424.61秒(7.08分钟),较手工分诊260.57小时(10.86天)降低99.95%。同时人工复核发现3条原未标注的无效Issue和2对重复对,提升了仓库数据质量。

Conclusion: TianoForge证明了LLM可有效支持多任务端到端分诊,但RAG并非普适增益——System A在优先级分类与开发者分配上稳定优于System B,说明从GitHub原生Issue获得的留一法上下文示例比历史Bugzilla信息更有效;RAG收益呈模型与任务依赖性,可能引入跨域噪声。优先级判定受报告人身份、里程碑紧迫性等隐式因素制约,仅靠显式启发式不够。未来工作将扩展至更多开源仓库、研究高级检索策略并引入置信度感知以标识需人工复核的低置信预测。

Abstract: We propose a novel approach to bug triage in the TianoCore open-source UEFI firmware development ecosystem. This integrated approach, called TianoForge, deploys the state of the art in artificial intelligence, specifically machine learning, to enable automated bug triage. This includes invalid bug report detection, duplicate bug report detection, bug report prioritization, and bug report assignment. We use various Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) Large Language Models (LLMs) with and without Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to automate these tasks. Given the crucial role of bug triage in software maintenance and the huge number of untriaged issues in the TianoCore community, in particular, their primary project, EDK II, we expect a significant impact on the efficiency of TianoCore software maintenance processes, primarily bug triage and resolution. Our experimental study shows that TianoForge reduces the average bug triage time from around 11 days to approximately 7 minutes, which is a 99.95% reduction.

</details>


### [199] [An Empirical Study of the TianoCore Community](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23280)
*Nazanin Siavash,Connor Glosner,Ayushi Sharma,Bianca Trinkenreich,Terrance E. Boult,Aravind Machiry,Armin Moin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文针对维护UEFI固件核心参考实现的开源社区TianoCore，通过对13位利益相关者的问卷调查和2位后续访谈，从8个研究问题出发,系统调查了其软件安全与维护实践现状,识别出在自动化、安全工具集成、内存安全语言(Rust)采用、DevSecOps以及供应链验证等方面存在的显著改进空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TianoCore社区维护的UEFI固件核心代码广泛应用于全球众多设备,其固件安全至关重要。然而,该社区的安全工程实践和维护工作流的成熟度尚未得到系统性研究。作者旨在通过实证研究填补这一空白,识别现状中的关键差距,为提升UEFI固件的维护性与安全性提供改进方向。

Method: 采用基于问卷的实证研究方法(ACM 2025规范),辅以有限的深度访谈。受访者涵盖独立固件供应商(IBV)、原始设备制造商(OEM)、安全专家、固件开发者和学术研究人员。研究围绕8个研究问题(RQ1-RQ8),涵盖缺陷管理、补丁管理、验证与确认、威胁优先级、内存安全语言采用、DevSecOps实践以及供应链完整性验证等维度。问卷数据与材料已公开发布。

Result: 1.缺陷跟踪中等程度结构化但异质化严重,GitHub Issues为主但无统一标准,权限访问受限(RQ1);2.安全漏洞被视为最高优先级,但分诊严重依赖人工,AI辅助采用率极低(RQ2);3.补丁传播与上游同步基本为手工流程,语义补丁和自动补丁技术尚未采用(RQ3);4.模糊测试和系统测试较成熟,但形式化验证和高级静态分析工具(如CodeQL、HBFA)实际采用率非常有限(RQ4);5.引导加载程序漏洞被视为最高威胁,大型组织安全投入较大,但尚无正式漏洞赏金计划(RQ5);6.对Rust等内存安全方案有较高兴趣,但因工具链成熟度、与遗留C代码集成及内部人才匮乏而落地有限(RQ6);7.DevSecOps整体采用率低,反而在资历较浅的从业者中较常见,可能反映代际培训差异(RQ7);8.供应链验证以人工为主,主要依赖代码审查、漏洞源监控和内部依赖文档,缺乏标准化元数据和工具支持(RQ8)。成熟度与组织规模的相关性强于与个人经验的相关性。

Conclusion: 研究显示TianoCore社区对安全具有强烈意识,但在自动化、验证基础设施、漏洞管理流程、DevSecOps整合以及内存安全开发支持等方面存在大量改进机会。未来工作可深入探索这些问题的解决方案。研究局限在于样本量相对较小(13位问卷+2位访谈),结果普适性需谨慎解读。该研究得到了美国国家科学基金会(NSF)第2534021号资助支持。

Abstract: We investigate the software security and maintenance practices adopted by stakeholders in the TianoCore community and identify opportunities to improve firmware development workflows. We conduct a survey and a limited interview study with participants representing independent firmware vendors, original equipment manufacturers, security experts, firmware developers, and academic researchers. This open-source development community maintains a reference implementation for the core of the UEFI firmware. We highlight important gaps in the current state of firmware development within the TianoCore ecosystem and identify key areas in which improved security practices, greater adoption of memory-safe technologies, and increased automation of manual processes could strengthen the maintenance and security of the UEFI firmware.

</details>


### [200] [From Natural Language Policies to Executable Obligations: A Verification Harness for Dependable In-Car LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23282)
*Radouane Bouchekir,Damir Safin,Tomas Bueno Momcilovic*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgentGuardUtil 是 CAR-bench Track 1 的参赛作品,通过将自然语言策略编译为可执行规则、确定性义务引擎与 25 个确定性门控,配合 LLM 评论员与有界修订循环,在车内 LLM 代理的每一轮动作上执行"verify-and-revise"验证,以满足安全策略、防止标识符幻觉并强制执行副作用义务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在车载场景中,LLM 代理控制的物理操作(车窗、空调、充电、导航等)直接关系到驾驶安全,任何一个幻觉标识符、遗漏的强制副作用或过早的完成声明都可能导致任务失败甚至安全事故。现有代理在部署条件(请求不完整、工具不可用、策略约束)下的可靠性不足,需要一个可在运行时将自然语言策略转化为机器可检查规则的验证框架。

Method: 1) 学生-教师分解:LLM 仅提案,验证框架(教师)审查每个草稿;2) 运行时策略编译器:每个会话首次将自然语言策略 Π 编译为类型化规则集 R(包含 precondition、auto-action、confirmation 等 7 种类型),部分规则进一步翻译为可执行形式 e_r=⟨g, φ, ⊲, v, ω⟩;3) 确定性义务引擎:三步估计后动作环境状态(σ̂),激活相关规则,计算仍需执行的补救动作 Ω;4) 25 个确定性门控(包括标识符来源、模式/枚举有效性、gather-before-act、确认协议、未来时间协议等),与 LLM 评论员协作产生分层发现 F = F_hard ∪ Critic(F_adv);5) 有界修订循环(最多 R 轮)+ 模态投票 + 振荡阀与升级修订 Revise_esc;6) 基于 assume-guarantee 的组合验证纪律。

Result: 在 CAR-bench Track 1 隐藏集(30 任务 × 3 次试验,学生模型 Claude Opus 4.8)上,Pass^3=53.3%, Pass^1=80.0%, Pass@3=66.7%, 全面超越组织者基线(50.0/66.7/60.0),排名 21 队中 9–11 位。其中幻觉类表现最佳(70/100/90),消歧类最差(40/80/50);但单次尝试成本 362k token/19.2s,显著高于基线(82k/3.2s),且字段内 token 消耗与分数相关性弱(r=0.435)。

Conclusion: AgentGuardUtil 通过将策略合规性、标识符接地与副作用执行等决定性检查从模型移至不可被幻觉的代码中,有效提升了车内 LLM 代理在部署条件下的可靠性,在三类挑战(幻觉、歧义、遗漏副作用)上均有改进;但 Pass^3 与 Pass@3 之间存在显著差距,表明编译覆盖范围与学生稳定性是未来提升的关键,需将更多策略条款转化为可执行规则以缩小试验间方差。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) agents deployed in vehicles must satisfy a written operating policy on every turn: a single hallucinated identifier, omitted mandatory side-effect, or premature completion claim fails the task. We present AgentGuardUtil, our entry to CAR-bench Track~1, which treats the AI planer (LLM) as a fallible proposer inside a grounded verify-and-revise loop. Its core novelty is a runtime policy compiler: the natural-language policy shipped with each conversation is compiled, once per policy, into typed machine-checkable rules, a subset of which receive an executable form. A deterministic obligation engine interprets these rules against live tool results and the simulated post-write state of the draft itself, emitting the exact remedial calls with computed arguments rather than natural-language reminders. Around this engine, 25 deterministic gates (identifier provenance, schema and enum validity, gather-before-act, confirmation and future-time protocols) and an LLM critic produce tiered findings that drive a bounded revision loop tuned for the pass k metric.

</details>


### [201] [DPIAgent: Divide, Protocol, Isolate for Agentic Reproduction Test Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23341)
*Hao Liu,Steven Liu,Xin Zhang,Jane Luo,Yu Kang,Jie Wu,Fangkai Yang,Yangyu Huang,Pengfei Gao,Scarlett Li,Yan Lu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DPIAgent 是一个用于自动化复现测试生成的结构化智能体框架，基于 Divide（划分）、Protocol（协议）、Isolate（隔离）三大原则，将任务分解为缺陷探索和测试生成两个阶段，在 SWT-Bench Verified 上以 GPT-5 达到 81.76% 的开源方法最优成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体方法将复现测试生成视为单一整体循环，但该任务天然包含根因诊断和编写 fail-to-pass 测试两个不同性质的子任务，缺乏显式分离导致复合目标模糊和目标漂移（goal drift）。开发者实际工作遵循"先定位根因，再编写测试"的两阶段流程，而现有智能体缺乏代码结构与依赖感知，依赖基础文本匹配工具，在大型仓库中需要大量往复操作。

Method: DPIAgent 遵循三大原则：(D)ivide 将整体循环拆分为缺陷探索和测试生成两个顺序阶段，每阶段有单一目标；(P)rotocol 要求智能体在阶段切换前必须显式生成包含 bug 位置、根因、预期/实际行为、复现策略、参考测试和测试计划六字段的结构化交接摘要；(I)solate 为每阶段定制工具集（探索阶段使用基于代码图的 search_code、文件查看和 bash 工具；生成阶段仅保留 edit 和 bash 工具），防止无关工具误导执行。此外引入 e-Otter++ 测试选择机制：对原问题生成 5 个风格化改写，共得 6 个候选测试补丁，利用 SWE-Agent 生成 3 个代理补丁，按 F2P 命中数和覆盖率进行排序。

Result: 在 SWT-Bench Verified 433 个实例上，DPIAgent 使用 DPI 即可在 GPT-5 上达到 81.76% 成功率（开源方法最优），在 GPT-5-Mini 上较最强基线 OpenHands 提升 11.88 点；加入测试选择后进一步提升至 86.17%。消融实验表明三原则互补：移除 Protocol 使 S 在 Claude-Opus-4.5 上从 78.98% 降至 75.51%；移除 Isolate 使 ΔC 在 GPT-5-Mini 上下降 6.11 点；移除 Divide 使 S 下降最多 9.93 点。结构化设计带来的增益在弱模型上更显著（GPT-5-Mini +14.16 S，GPT-5 +9.24，Claude-Opus-4.5 +2.07），且步数减少约 29%。函数级定位 Acc@5 在 Claude-Opus-4.5 上提升 24.75 点至 76.27%，GPT-5-Mini 上提升 25.67 点至 77.80%。

Conclusion: DPIAgent 证明仅在阶段边界施加最小结构约束即可获得超过单纯扩展模型能力的收益，为软件工程中结构化智能体推理提供了设计蓝图。架构结构与骨干模型能力是互补而非替代关系，结构性干预可以弥补模型规模的不足。

Abstract: Reproduction test generation, producing a failing-then-passing test that captures a reported bug, is a critical step in automated software engineering. Existing agentic methods treat this as a monolithic loop, despite the task inherently comprising two subtasks of distinct nature: diagnosing the root cause and writing a fail-to-pass test. Without explicit separation, the agent faces a compound objective with underspecified intermediate goals, leading to goal drift. We propose DPIAgent, a structured agentic framework built on three principles, Divide, Protocol, Isolate (DPI), that mitigates compound-objective ambiguity and goal drift: it Divides the task into single-objective phases of defect exploration and test generation; enforces a handoff Protocol that records the diagnosis and test plan, preventing context loss; and Isolates each phase's action space by tailoring the toolset to its task, preventing irrelevant tools from misleading execution. On SWT-Bench Verified, DPIAgent outperforms seven baselines across three backbone LLMs. With DPI alone it reaches 81.76% success rate on GPT-5, the highest reported among open-source methods, gaining up to 11.88 points over the strongest baseline on GPT-5-Mini; adding test selection further raises it to 86.17%. Our analysis shows that architectural structure and backbone capability are complementary axes rather than substitutes, demonstrating DPI's generalizability across model classes.

</details>


### [202] [Formalizing and Automating Fine-Grained Move Refactorings Across Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23377)
*Kota Yasuhara,Shinpei Hayashi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文形式化并实现了Java中跨方法的细粒度Move重构(语句级和表达式级),通过四个基本条件(数据可达性、执行次数、副作用、语法约束)定义前置条件,在mockito项目上迭代精化得出20条额外规则,在10个Defects4J项目上验证:93.3-97.0%编译通过,行为偏差均由副作用重排序引起而非静态检查缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Fowler目录中的语句级Move重构缺乏精确前置条件,无法自动化执行;现有方法(如Sasaki等)仅支持方法内Slide Statements,无法跨方法移动语句或表达式,而真实项目中此类重构(如Localize Parameter)频繁发生,亟需自动化支持。

Method: 提出四个基本条件BC1-BC4(数据可达性、执行次数、副作用、语法约束),形式化5种Move Statement变体和3种Move Expression变体,采用静态分析检查BC1/BC2/BC4,BC3交由开发者判断;在mockito上迭代精化得出20条新规则;实现为IntelliJ IDEA插件,支持拖拽调用。

Result: 在10个Defects4J项目上适用性达2654-13825实例/操作;编译成功率93.3-97.0%;commons-cli案例研究显示所有行为偏差均源于副作用重排序(BC3设计决策),而非BC1/BC2/BC4静态检查缺陷;Move with Holes在MS→适用实例中覆盖72.6%。

Conclusion: 细粒度跨方法Move重构可基于四个基本条件实现自动化,主要残留失败集中于BC1(数据可达性),副作用顺序问题应留给开发者判断;未来工作包括多调用点支持、LLM推荐集成、更多项目验证及拖拽界面可用性研究。

Abstract: Developers use automated Move refactorings to improve the modular structure of source code and the assignment of responsibilities. Class- and method-level Move refactorings are automated in modern IDEs, but statement- and expression-level moves that adjust method boundaries remain largely unautomated. We formalize five variants of Move Statement refactoring as preconditions and steps grounded in four basic conditions covering data reachability, execution count, side effects, and syntactic constraints required for compilation, of which all but the side-effect condition are checked statically. Combined with existing techniques, this also yields finer-grained moves of expressions and partial expressions. We further refine the formalization iteratively against a real project, deriving twenty additional preconditions and steps that handle Java syntactic diversity in practice. We evaluate applicability and compilability on ten projects, and behavior preservation in a case study on one of them: Move Statement refactorings yield compilable code in 93.3-97.0% of applicable cases, and the case study shows that the observed behavioral changes stem from side-effect reordering left to developer judgment, not from defects in the statically checked conditions.

</details>


### [203] [An Interactive Agent for Requirement-Driven Candidate Sourcing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23501)
*Yuanpeng He,Fangjing Li,Xiangyu Ru,Kexin Sun,Kun Yang,Lijian Li,Chi-Man Pun,Qingsong Wen,Wenpin Jiao,Mingkai Guo,Yirong Feng,Daiheng Gao,Zhi Jin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出DINQ TalentScout（首个交互式、需求驱动的候选人挖掘智能体）和TalentTrace基准，将"从自然语言描述中找人"重新定义为需求工程任务而非信息检索任务，通过有界访谈提取约束、工作流模板、两阶段提交协议和双向终止守卫实现需求生命周期的elicitation→validation→retrieval→verification；在691个需求和21个系统上的实验表明其召回率是最强基线的1.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体处理"找出某类人"的任务时，将其简单视为信息检索问题，但实际这类请求是欠确定的需求（约束隐含、多有效答案、无验收标准），基线系统因缺乏需求引导而产生大量无证据支撑的候选和违反约束的匹配，真正瓶颈在于需求工程而非检索。

Method: 核心方法是将候选人挖掘重构为需求工程问题：(1) DINQ TalentScout采用"一个原则、四个约束"——有界澄清访谈（≤4个问题，七维约束逐一提取）解决输入欠确定；固定工作流模板（检索启动配方+五步技能）解决过程不可重现；两阶段提交协议（draft+refine解耦速度与质量）解决输出冲突；双向终止守卫（全覆盖+调用阈值）解决终止无界。(2) TalentTrace基准使用CADA（Criteria-Anchored Debate Adjudication）多LLM辩论进行需求质量准入和开放/封闭分类，多模型证据锚定oracle构建真实人员池，CGPS（Commit-Gated People Scoring）通过相关门+成本感知委派验证候选。

Result: 在21个系统、691个开放需求上：DINQ TalentScout达到100%覆盖率（49.9候选/需求），90%返回的候选不被任何20个强LLM+网络基线覆盖（近正交性，Jaccard≈0.01），相关真实人员召回率达0.241（占93444人联合池），是次优系统的1.9倍，500次bootstrap 95%CI与所有基线不相交；30名专业猎头盲评中25/30首选其结果；有界澄清访谈比单轮阅读恢复隐含约束提升4.9倍（13.8%→67.5%，33/40提升）。

Conclusion: 将候选人挖掘定位为需求工程问题而非检索问题具有理论和实践价值：DINQ TalentScout是最强的深度sourcing引擎（召回为王），而精度型LLM充当互补的verifier；其"四约束"设计原则和generate-validate-oracle-verify评估框架可推广至任何欠确定的智能体任务（如文献发现、供应商选择、合规证据）；未来工作包括用户研究验证交互式elicitation UX、严格事实爬取评分器、评估闭集场景。

Abstract: Finding people from a natural-language description (``ML engineers transitioning to research roles in biotech'') is increasingly delegated to LLM agents and framed as information retrieval. We argue that it is fundamentally a requirements engineering task: such a request is an under-determined requirement with implicit constraints, many valid answers, and no acceptance criterion, so useful answers require eliciting, validating, and verifying the requirement before search can matter. We present \sys{}, to our knowledge the first interactive, requirements-driven candidate-sourcing agent (it elicits, validates, retrieves, and verifies a vague people-request into a justified slate through bounded elicitation, workflow templates, a two-stage commit protocol, and bidirectional termination guards) and \bench{}, a benchmark that runs the requirements lifecycle (criteria-anchored validation, multi-model evidence-grounded oracle construction, and cost-aware verification). Across $21$ systems and all $691$ requirements, \sys{} dominates breadth ($100%$ coverage at $2.5\times$ the yield) and is \emph{near-orthogonal} to the field, with $90%$ of the people it returns are surfaced by \emph{none} of $20$ strong LLM-plus-web baselines combined. Beyond breadth, an evidence-grounded judging of every system shows \sys{} \emph{recalls} the most relevant real people: $0.241$ of the union pool, $1.9\times$ the next system, with a bootstrap $95%$ interval disjoint from every baseline. \sys{} is thus the strongest \emph{sourcing} engine (the deepest real, reachable candidate pool), while precision-ranking LLMs serve as~complementary verifiers.

</details>
