A prototype implementation was exercised on 55 functional queries and a 30-turn dialogue; token-level cache hit rates reached 90.99% and 95.2%, cutting input cost to about 12.0% and 8.0% of a no-cache baseline under DeepSeek's pricing, where cache-hit input tokens cost roughly 1/30 of cache-miss tokens.

</details>


### [372] [SEAM: Shot Entity-Attribute Memory for Consistent Short-Drama Generation at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22725)
*Jiaqi Liu,Maolin Ran,Xiaoyang Lu,Jian Wang,Weiwen Liu,Jianghao Lin,Yong Yu,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SEAM是一个针对短剧生成的训练-free、模型无关的记忆图，通过在提示文本层提取每个镜头的多维状态、检索因果前置上下文并以自然语言重写注入，将跨集连续性召回率从0.700提升至0.946，在6种文本模型上有效，并在CreativeFitting的201镜头生产部署中达到96.5%的导演接受率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短剧生成工业化流水线中，镜头间视觉连续性成为关键瓶颈：现有智能体框架独立生成每个镜头，道具、人物姿态和空间调度出现不一致，小差异累积成严重视觉断裂。现有方法要么绑死在特定生成器上、要么依赖3D场景或端到端视频，均未触及故事板提示文本层。

Method: SEAM将连续性视为跨镜头共享状态的"检索-注入"问题，包含三阶段：(1)状态提取与图构建——将每个镜头解析为8维视觉状态（场景、氛围、人物、人物状态、空间、道具、动作、镜头风格），通过时间邻接、人物共现、场景共现三类关系构建有向记忆图；(2)图检索与选择性过滤——仅在前置子图G<i上检索，使用词汇重叠+字符共现奖励评分，按权重阈值τ做反向多跳扩展，并以LLM按规则筛选；(3)自然重写注入——LLM将保留的连续性约束编织进视觉描述x'_i，通过长度比、资源引用、结构标记三重守门V保留导演意图。整体在提示文本层运作，不修改模型权重，适配在线LLM模式与离线规则模式。SEAM作为SEAM-Agent流水线中导演Agent、摄影Agent之后的"记忆优化器"强制阶段部署。

Result: 在SEAM-Bench（68集、3部剧、2219个人工镜头+2718个AI镜头）上：(Q1)连续性召回从0.700（仅集内检索对照）提升至0.946；跨6个文本模型（claude、deepseek-v4-pro、glm-5.1、gpt-5.4、kimi-k2.6、minimax-m2.7）的2946个被标记镜头，目标态条件矛盾概率均值从0.308降至0.131，超阈比率从0.264降至0.093；盲评在角色状态连续性(+4.4)、道具(+2.9)、意图契合(+6.5)维度Holm校正后显著。(Q2)18个剧情-模型单元全部改善，召回均值0.731–0.992。(Q3)图像层方向正确但n=30未达显著。(生产)CreativeFitting 201镜头部署中导演接受率96.5%，零不安全注入，反事实下界显示跨集记忆贡献至少21.9个百分点。失败模式：4–7%被标记镜头未修复；图像层迁移不显著；Kendall's τ因重写守门未约束而轻微下降；镜头语法差距仍存。

Conclusion: SEAM首次在故事板提示文本层修复短剧跨镜头、跨集连续性，是训练-free、模型无关的检索-注入框架。其稀疏而非全局的修复特征解释了为何集级指标几乎不动而标记点指标近三分之二的矛盾被消除。SEAM-Bench为工业短剧连续性评估提供双盲基准。未来工作指向视频层评估。

Abstract: Short-drama generation has grown into a large, industrialized pipeline, and as it scales from isolated shots to the episode level, visual continuity has become a critical bottleneck. Current agent frameworks generate each shot in isolation, so context drifts across shots and props, character posture, and blocking turn inconsistent. Once assembled, these small discrepancies amplify into severe visual breaks. We present SEAM (Shot Entity-Attribute Memory), a training-free, model-agnostic memory graph that repairs continuity entirely at the prompt-text layer by extracting a multi-dimensional state for every shot, retrieving only causally prior context over the resulting graph, filtering it selectively, and injecting the surviving constraints by natural-language prompt rewriting. We further release SEAM-Bench, a double-blind continuity storyboarding benchmark, on which SEAM raises cross-episode continuity recall from 0.700 to 0.946, generalizes across six mainstream text models, and yields consistent, though not yet significant, gains at the generated-image layer. Deployed as a mandatory stage in CreativeFitting's SEAM-Agent production pipeline over 201 shots, SEAM reaches a 96.5% director-acceptance rate with zero unsafe injections; a conservative counterfactual attributes at least 21.9 percentage points of that rate to its cross-episode memory.

</details>


### [373] [LLM-Based Selection of Incongruent Verbal and Nonverbal Behavior for Virtual Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22731)
*Parisa Ghanad Torshizi,Stacy Marsella*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法，为虚拟人选择与言语内容不一致（不匹配/矛盾）的非言语行为。基于Ekman的理论框架，作者构建了言语-非言语不匹配的四类分类法（反讽、面子维护、欺骗、情绪调节），并探索了三种提示策略对LLM选择上下文合适的不匹配行为的影响。通过两项人类被试研究验证：当非言语行为被虚拟人呈现时，能显著影响观察者对说话者态度和情绪的感知。研究表明，提供更丰富的上下文（对话历史+情境描述）能让LLM生成更具表达力且更可能产生言语-非言语不匹配的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚拟人非言语行为生成系统大多仅基于当前话语生成"重复"或"阐释"言语内容的非言语行为，忽视了人类非言语行为所承载的更丰富社会功能——包括强化、弱化、限定甚至矛盾言语内容，以及泄露隐藏的内在情绪状态。这种能力对训练场景（如虚拟病人咨询模拟）尤为关键，因为受训者需要学习从非言语线索中推断患者的真实情绪状态。

Method: 1）基于Ekman和Goffman的理论，构建言语-非言语不匹配的四类分类法（反讽、面子维护、欺骗、情绪调节），每类下细分正/负两种子情境。2）设计三种LLM提示策略（仅话语、对话历史、对话+情境），使用Claude-sonnet-4-6对8个场景进行行为选择。3）设计两项人类被试研究：研究1为对比研究（49人），研究2为独立评分研究（39人），使用基于Geneva情绪轮的Likert量表评估感知情绪，并通过单因素重复测量ANOVA分析。

Result: 1）LLM输出分析：提供更丰富上下文使生成的行为更丰富（动作单元从41增至48，矛盾关系从2/8增至7/8）。2）研究1：87.8%参与者在正-正vs正-负对比中选择了正-正为更积极态度；93.9%在负-负vs负-正对比中选择负-正更积极，假设H1获支持。3）研究2：ANOVA显示条件对正向情绪F(2.21,83.82)=40.04、负向情绪F(2.23,84.56)=37.22均产生显著主效应（p<.001），非言语行为显著调节感知情绪，假设H2和H3均获支持。4）定性分析显示参与者能正确识别反讽、愤怒等矛盾信号。

Conclusion: LLM能够基于丰富的上下文选择与言语不匹配的非言语行为，且这些行为在虚拟人中呈现后能有效影响观察者对说话者态度和情绪的感知。上下文越丰富，LLM越倾向于选择超出简单阐释言语内容的行为。研究为虚拟人脑部、话语与身体之间的接口设计提供了指导。但仍存在局限：未包含手势、姿势和语音韵律；需将LLM输出映射到动画框架；刺激样本较小，需进一步探索实时交互实现的可行性。

Abstract: Nonverbal behavior generation systems for virtual agents often take an utterance as input and generate nonverbal behaviors that emphasize or illustrate the content of the verbal channel. However, human nonverbal behavior is shaped by more than the content of the speech. It is also influenced by speaker roles, interpersonal relationships, social context, and the cognitive and emotional states of the interactants. As a result, the nonverbal channel may reinforce, weaken, qualify, or even contradict the verbal channel. It may also reveal internal states that are hidden or only indirectly implied in speech, including emotional "leakage" that may be incidental to the immediate interaction. Modeling this richer relationship between verbal and nonverbal behavior is important for designing virtual agents that exhibit realistic, human-like behavior. It is especially critical in training contexts that require nuanced social interpretation, such as counseling simulations involving virtual patients. Drawing on Ekman's framework of verbal nonverbal relationships, we propose a taxonomy of categories in which mismatches between verbal and nonverbal behavior can occur. We then examine alternative approaches for realizing these behaviors using large language models, focusing on whether LLMs can select contextually appropriate mismatched verbal and nonverbal behaviors from a given dialogue and social interaction context. Finally, we evaluate the resulting behaviors in a human-subject study, assessing whether context-driven nonverbal behavior, when embodied in a virtual human, produces the intended effects on observers.

</details>


### [374] [The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22752)
*Saber Zerhoudi,Jelena Mitrovic,Michael Granitzer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了AI智能体长时运行中上下文压缩的安全规则丢失问题（"压缩悬崖"），提出"知识分诊"框架，将知识分为五类并为每类设置独立的保留策略，通过三个确定性算子（TypeCompact、TypeDecompose、TypeRetrieve）实现跨压缩、分解、检索操作的安全保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI智能体在长会话中触发上下文压缩时，安全规则与情景日志以同等速率被压缩，导致安全约束（如"患者对青霉素过敏"）在多轮压缩后严重丢失（Claude Code的/compact在Sonnet 4.6上五轮后仅保留10%）。不同类型的知识对信息损失的容忍度差异显著，但现有压缩、分解、检索策略均未按类型条件化保留策略，构成结构性的安全风险。

Method: 提出五类知识模型（约束C/程序P/信念B/偏好F/情景E），设计SafetyMargin分类器（基于反事实安全裕度估计），实现三个确定性算子：(1)TypeCompact将条目路由到三条保真通道（约束/程序完整保留、信念/偏好压缩、情景占位符），并通过验证器恢复关键否定词；(2)TypeDecompose按主题分组后，将作用域内的约束复制到所有相关分区；(3)TypeRetrieve在相关性排序前先固定作用域内约束。基于率失真理论为每个算子建立安全证明，并构造AgentArtifactCorpus语料库（396,934条来自54,628个GitHub仓库的智能体配置）。

Result: 在五个公开数据集验证：TypeCompact在50%/25%/10%压缩率下约束保留率达1.00/0.95/0.80，五轮迭代后稳定在0.96，比最强单次LLM压缩器高2-4倍；TypeDecompose将局部性违规从93%降至0%（中位开销14.5%）；TypeRetrieve在recall@50达100%对比最佳LLM检索器73%。行为层面：在SafetyMed（N=200）医疗合规基准上约束保留率领先14.5个百分点（p<10⁻⁸）；在τ-bench零售基准（N=115任务，1019次配对回放）通过率37.7%对比层级压缩29.2%（p=0.005）；在τ-bench航空基准上通过率领先层级压缩11.1个百分点（p=0.024）。

Conclusion: 知识分诊通过按类型条件化的保留策略解决了压缩悬崖问题，证明类型盲保留策略的结构性失败。框架将压缩、分解、检索统一为一个按类型保证的问题，连接了智能体记忆、信息论、信念修正和指令层级安全研究。实际部署建议：在压缩/检索/分解模块前放置类型分类器，将标记的约束路由至精确保留路径，分类器成本仅在索引时一次性支付。

Abstract: A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens in an AI agent's context. When the budget overflows, both are summarized at the same rate; only the rule needs exact wording to remain enforceable. On 20 production agent configurations, Claude Code's /compact prompt on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53\% of safety rules after one compaction round and 10\% after five. We name this the Compaction Cliff. We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's knowledge base by type and routes each type through its own retention policy. Three deterministic operators implement this triage across the three context-management operations: TypeCompact rewrites items in place under per-type fidelity, TypeDecompose partitions a topic too large to compact safely, replicating in-scope safety rules across partitions, and TypeRetrieve fetches items from external storage with in-scope rules pinned ahead of relevance. On five public corpora, TypeCompact preserves 2--4$\times$ more safety rules than the strongest single-shot LLM compactor at every ratio, with 96\% recall over five rounds. TypeDecompose reaches 0\% locality violations against 93\% under uniform partitioning. TypeRetrieve reaches 100\% recall@50 against 73\% for the best single-shot LLM retriever. On three downstream behavioral benchmarks, we outperform the production Sonnet compactor on medical compliance (paired McNemar $p < 10^{-8}$ on preservation, $N = 200$), the full-policy and hierarchical baselines on retail task pass rate ($p < 0.01$, $N = 115$), and the hierarchical compaction on the airline domain ($p = 0.024$). We release AgentArtifactCorpus (396{,}934 agent configurations from 54{,}628 public GitHub repositories), the classifier, and the reference implementation.

</details>


### [375] [Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22762)
*Chenhui Liu,Jianpeng Zhou,Jiahai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CCoR框架，采用关系中心探索范式，通过主链与约束链两条关系链将复杂知识图谱问答(KGQA)的候选检索与约束处理两个阶段均锚定在KG上，避免了实体中心方法的不可靠实体剪枝与未接地约束处理问题，在准确性、忠实性与效率方面均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于智能体的KGQA方法采用实体中心探索范式，存在两大核心缺陷：(1)不可靠的实体剪枝——每跳需将实体裁剪为固定大小子集，因KG实体信息不完整会丢弃有效实体；(2)未接地的约束处理——查询约束依赖LLM内部参数知识而非KG验证，导致答案无法验证且易产生幻觉。需要一种新范式解决这两个限制。

Method: 1. 提出关系中心探索范式，以关系而非实体作为搜索单位，结构上避免实体剪枝；2. 设计CCoR框架，包含主链(从主题实体到候选空间的关系链)和约束链(从约束源到约束目标的关系链)，通过SPARQL在KG上显式执行约束过滤；3. 引入两层回退机制：Layer 1全局实体过滤(约束链失败时)、Layer 2 LLM直接生成(主链失败时)；4. 提出两个忠实性指标：知识接地率KGR(三级加权接地评分)与忠实F1(FF1=KGR×F1)。

Result: 在WebQSP、CWQ、QALD10、GrailQA四个基准测试中：(1)准确性：CCoR在CWQ和QALD10上取得最优Hits@1和F1，WebQSP/GrailQA上在免训练方法中最优；(2)忠实性：在GPT-4.1-mini下CWQ的KGR从PoG的37.1提升至69.1，FF1从15.7提升至39.9；(3)效率：CCoR的LLM调用次数约为ToG/PoG的一半，token消耗在复杂查询上显著降低；(4)复杂查询子集(CWQ 500条)上CCoR的Hits@1达68.4(优于PoG的54.2)。消融实验表明约束链贡献最大(KGR从69.1降至49.8)，关系级回溯为次要鲁棒性机制。

Conclusion: CCoR通过关系中心探索范式与主链+约束链的组合，将候选检索与约束处理两个阶段完全建立在显式KG执行上，在准确性、忠实性和效率三个维度上一致优于强基线，且在约束密集型查询上增益最为显著。忠实性提升是其最突出的贡献，验证了显式KG接地对复杂KGQA的关键作用。未来工作将聚焦于在保持忠实性的同时进一步降低LLM调用成本。

Abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) is a key task for evaluating KG-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and complex KGQA that requires multi-hop reasoning is especially challenging. Solving a complex query involves two coupled phases: candidate retrieval, which locates answer candidates over the KG, and constraint handling, which filters these candidates against the query constraints. Faithful reasoning requires grounding both phases in the KG. However, existing agent-based methods ground candidate retrieval through entity-centric exploration, while leaving constraint handling to the LLM's internal knowledge, which leads to two critical limitations. (1) Unreliable entity pruning: entity-centric exploration uses entities as search units and must prune them to a fixed-size subset at each hop. Because entity information in KGs is often incomplete and a fixed-size subset cannot retain all valid entities, such pruning inevitably drops valid entities and ultimately leads to wrong answers. (2) Ungrounded constraint handling: query constraints are resolved from the LLM's internal knowledge rather than the KG, leaving the final answers unverifiable and prone to hallucination. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a relation-centric exploration paradigm, which uses relations rather than entities as search units and thus avoids unreliable entity pruning. Built on this paradigm, this paper proposes Compositional Chain-of-Relations (CCoR), a simple and effective framework that grounds both phases in the KG with two relation chains: a main chain for candidate retrieval and a constraint chain that verifies query constraints through explicit KG exploration. Experiments on four KGQA benchmarks show that CCoR consistently improves accuracy, faithfulness, and efficiency over strong baselines, with more pronounced gains on complex queries.

</details>


### [376] [The Retriever Should Remember: Experience-Amortized Reranking for Long-Term Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22767)
*Qi Feng,Chris Ding,Jicong Fan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EARM提出一种"经验摊销"重排序框架，将LLM相关性分数视为可复用的检索经验，通过在线查询-记忆矩阵与因果低秩矩阵补全，使长期语言模型智能体在每次查询时只需对少量候选进行LLM打分，其余候选由历史经验估计，从而将LLM重排序从每次重复开销转化为智能体生命周期内可累积的检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期智能体的检索器在每次查询时都从初始状态启动，记忆库不断增长但检索经验被丢弃。语义检索效率高但相似度不能反映证据相关性；LLM重排序质量高但无状态、每次都重复打分且丢弃分数，对长生命周期智能体成本过高。核心动机是让检索器也积累经验，像记忆内容一样随时间改进。

Method: 方法包含五个组件：(1)语义候选生成（嵌入相似度取Top-N，高召回但非最终排序）；(2)检索经验矩阵R^(t)，行为记忆、列为查询，每条观察记录LLM相关性分数s^LLM∈[0,1]；(3)阶段式经验采集，按查询索引设置递减观察比率ρ（如100%→40%→25%→20%→17.5%），锚点一半采自高相似度层（利用）一半采自其余候选（探索）；(4)因果相关性补全，采用带偏置的低秩模型 R̂=μ+α_i+β_τ+p_i⊤z_τ，通过交替最小二乘在历史观察上最小化掩码重构损失并L2正则化，warm-start从前一阶段解初始化，严格遵守因果遮蔽（只用历史列与当前列锚点）；(5)混合重排序，已观察候选用真实LLM分数，其余用补全值 R̂，最终按Top-K构造上下文（时间顺序保留）。

Result: 在LoCoMo长对话记忆基准上的实验（语义模型Qwen3.5-4B-Q8_0打分，GPT-4o-mini生成与评判）：(1)总体精度——Top-10时r=8的EARM将语义检索的82.21%提升至88.83%（+6.62%），距全量LLM重排序91.62%仅差2.79%；多跳问题提升10.29%、单跳提升7.25%最为显著；Top-20时r=2的EARM提升2.99%；(2)阶段鲁棒性——观察比率降至17.5%时，r=8 EARM在Top-10仍优于语义检索5.53%，r=2在Top-20优于2.46%；(3)组件消融——仅用观察分数（关闭补全）已贡献1.36–3.83%，重启补全再额外贡献0.78–2.79%，证明补全本身具有独立增益；(4)效率——EARM仅调用78,736次LLM重排序，相对全量307,982次减少74.43%调用，同时恢复全量重排序相对语义检索收益的约70%（Top-10）/56%（Top-20）。

Conclusion: EARM将LLM相关性分数从瞬时推理产物提升为持久检索状态，验证了"检索记忆"概念的可行性：长期智能体不仅要记住更多内容，还要随生命周期学会更好地访问已记忆内容。论文指出了三个局限性（预算调度固定、不适应不确定性或分布漂移；矩阵补全依赖低维可复用结构；点式LLM分数存在噪声与提示敏感性问题），并提出未来可将补全模型用于扩展检索域至语义候选之外，使检索边界从硬性变为柔性。

Abstract: Long-term language-model agents accumulate memories across interactions, but their retrievers typically do not accumulate retrieval experience. Semantic retrieval is efficient, but embedding similarity does not always reflect whether a memory contains evidence relevant to the current query. Large language model (LLM) rerankers provide stronger query-conditioned relevance scores, yet stateless reranking repeatedly scores a large candidate pool and discards these scores after each query. We introduce EARM, an experience-amortized reranking framework that treats previously acquired LLM relevance scores as reusable retrieval experience. EARM stores sparse query--memory relevance scores in an online matrix, learns their shared structure through causal matrix completion, and combines a small set of newly observed scores with estimated scores to rerank the remaining candidates. The scoring budget decreases as experience accumulates, changing LLM reranking from a repeated per-query expense into a retrieval capability learned over an agent's lifetime. Experiments on long-term conversational memory show that mixed observed-and-estimated reranking improves answer accuracy over semantic retrieval by up to 6.62% and remains effective when only 17.5% of candidates receive direct LLM relevance scores, thereby substantially reducing the inference overhead of LLM reranking. These results motivate a broader view of agent memory: a long-lived agent should remember not only past content, but also how that content has proved useful for retrieval.

</details>


### [377] [TailSieve: Partial-Rollout-Guided Tail Routing for LLM Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22788)
*Tianqi Xu,Lu Lv,Haoyang Huang,Wenjie Huang,Zhanming Shen,Yuhao Shen,Baolin Zhang,Xinyi Hu,Shuang Ge,Jun Dai,Tianyu Liu,Suorong Yang,Zhikai Li,Ye Bai,Jun Zhang,Lei Chen,Yue Li,Mingchen Wan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TailSieve 是一个针对 LLM 大规模 rollout 场景的尾部路由框架，通过部分 rollout 信号和分层控制器联合优化尾部工作负载隔离与副本分配，以最小化同步 rollout 步骤的 makespan，并保持 on-policy 生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同步 LLM rollout 中，少数长尾生成会主导端到端 makespan；现有方法要么依赖异步/部分轨迹复用、要么依赖长度预测，且最佳路由策略尚不明确。

Method: 1) 在已知完成长度的理想设定下，证明长尾 regime 的最优路由为"尾部隔离+负载均衡"，简单 top-k 策略可逼近该离线最优；2) 利用部分 rollout 中未完成 prompt 作为免训练的尾部候选信号；3) 分层控制器：内层调整尾部隔离规模 q 使尾/体池完成时间均衡，外层调整尾池副本数 m 使边际容量均衡；4) 与 MTP/DFlash 结合实现路径专用推测解码。

Result: 在五种 Qwen 模型与 DeepScaleR/KodCode 工作负载上，TailSieve 相比均匀组路由最高实现 1.67× 纯路由加速；结合 MTP 或 DFlash 后最高达 2.59× 加速；端到端 GRPO 实验显示收益在策略演进过程中持续，且奖励与平均响应长度与基线相当。

Conclusion: 联合尾部工作负载隔离与副本分配是同步 LLM rollout 的实用补充；TailSieve 在保持 on-policy 生成、不引入额外长度偏置的前提下显著降低尾部延迟，并能与推测解码正交叠加。

Abstract: Large-scale rollouts have become a core component of modern LLM systems, spanning reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, on-policy distillation (OPD), and sampling-heavy evaluation pipelines. Unlike online serving, which is typically optimized for request-level latency and throughput, a small number of long-tail generations can dominate the end-to-end makespan of an entire rollout step. In practice, rollout requests are often routed uniformly across replicas, which can place extremely long generations inside high-concurrency decoding batches. To address this, we present TailSieve, a partial-rollout-guided framework that jointly controls tail routing and replica allocation for LLM rollouts. In an idealized setting with known completion lengths, we show that makespan-optimal routing in the long-tail regime combines tail isolation with load balancing, and that a simple top-k policy closely approximates this offline optimum. Leveraging the observation that long-tail prompts tend to remain long-tailed across policy updates, TailSieve uses partial rollouts as a training-free signal for identifying candidate tail groups. A hierarchical controller then jointly adapts the number of isolated groups and the replica split between the tail and bulk pools using collected response-work history and a measured concurrency-throughput model. TailSieve achieves up to 1.67x routing-only speedup over uniform group routing. The resulting low-concurrency tail pool further enables route-specialized speculative decoding with MTP or DFlash, achieving up to 2.59x speedup over uniform routing. Selected prompts are regenerated under the current policy, preserving on-policy generation and avoiding additional routing-induced length bias in steady state.

</details>


### [378] [Performance of a domain-specific large language model in answering patient questions in psychiatry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22797)
*Alexander J. Hish,Arjun Nagendran,Scott N. Compton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个专门基于权威医学组织患者教育资源微调的领域特定大语言模型"MIND"，并在艾司西酞普兰相关患者教育问答任务上与ChatGPT和OpenEvidence进行比较。结果显示，在量化评分中MIND在所有维度均显著优于ChatGPT，但在精神病学家主观偏好上，ChatGPT仍更受青睐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大语言模型（如ChatGPT）在回答患者关于精神科药物的具体问题时，可能存在准确性、完整性和安全性方面的隐患。研究者希望探索：通过仅使用权威医学组织的患者教育资源进行微调所构建的领域特定LLM（MIND），是否能够在精神科药物患者教育场景中提供优于通用LLM聊天机器人的回答，从而提升患者教育的安全性与质量。

Method: 1. 构建领域特定LLM：使用权威医学组织的患者教育资源对基础模型进行微调，开发出名为"MIND"的模型。2. 比较对象：MIND、ChatGPT、OpenEvidence。3. 评测任务：以艾司西酞普兰（escitalopram）为具体药物，收集并生成患者常见问题。4. 评测方法：（a）基于评分量表的计算机/自动分析，维度包括准确性、清晰度、完整性、细微差别、安全性与转诊适当性；（b）由10名持证精神科医生依据相似指标进行主观评分，并给出整体偏好。5. 统计分析：采用显著性检验及效应量（r值）进行分析。

Result: 1. 量化评分（评分量表）：MIND在所有维度上均获得最高评分，差异具有统计学意义（p<0.001）。2. 精神科医生评分：准确性方面，ChatGPT略优于MIND，但效应量极小（p=0.021, r=0.073）；完整性方面，MIND优于ChatGPT，效应量较小（p<0.001, r=0.160）；安全性方面，MIND与ChatGPT评分无显著差异（p=0.955, r=0.002）。3. 整体偏好：57.6%的精神科医生更偏好ChatGPT的回答，42.4%偏好MIND，差异具有统计学意义（p=0.003）。

Conclusion: MIND能够在多数情况下准确、完整且安全地回答关于艾司西酞普兰的患者问题，验证了基于权威患者教育资源微调的领域特定LLM在精神科患者教育中的可行性。然而，尽管MIND在回答完整性上具备优势，精神科医生整体上仍偏好ChatGPT生成的回复，这表明临床医生对回复"风格"或表达方式的偏好可能与客观质量指标存在脱节。MIND代表了构建安全的、面向精神科的LLM系统以增强患者教育的重要一步，但仍需进一步优化以契合临床偏好。

Abstract: Background This study was designed to evaluate whether a domain-specific large language model (LLM) trained exclusively on patient education resources can answer questions about psychiatric medications, in a manner superior to LLM chatbots. We developed an LLM ("MIND") fine-tuned for clinical fidelity, trained on patient education resources from authoritative medical organizations. Methods We compared the responses of MIND, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence to patient questions about escitalopram, using two methods: (1) computer analysis according to a rubric measuring accuracy, clarity, completeness, nuance, safety, and referral appropriateness; (2) ratings from N=10 board-licensed psychiatrists on similar metrics. Results When rated by rubric, MIND was rated highest in all domains (p<0.001). When rated by psychiatrists, ChatGPT was rated accurate more often than MIND with a negligible effect size (p=0.021, r=0.073); MIND was rated complete more often than ChatGPT with a small effect size (p<0.001, r=0.160); and MIND and ChatGPT were rated safe with the same frequency (p=0.955, r=0.002). The majority of psychiatrists preferred the responses generated by ChatGPT (57.6%) compared to MIND (42.4%, p=0.003). Conclusions MIND was able to answer many questions about escitalopram in a manner deemed accurate, complete, and safe by psychiatrists the majority of the time. However, despite MIND's ability to provide more complete responses, psychiatrists preferred ChatGPT's responses. MIND represents a step towards building safe LLM systems to enhance patient education in psychiatry.

</details>


### [379] [Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22830)
*Kate Gwimm,Carson Eisenach*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对企业级 Text-to-SQL 部署中 LLM 无法一次性加载完整表目录的瓶颈，提出将检索环节消费的"知识库上下文"作为主要优化目标，而非优化模型本身或检索工具链。具体方法包括：（1）提出 query-DAG 监督框架，将生产 SQL 解析为可验证中间子问题的有向无环图，用于诊断上下文瓶颈的位置；（2）提出端到端的蒸馏优化方法，将历史查询画像蒸馏为可复用的 SQL 参考卡片（reference cards），采用 AlphaEvolve 风格的自动搜索循环 + 失败诊断器作为反馈；（3）在内部 5176 条生产查询基准上，优化上下文产物带来的收益（约 12%–25% AST 相似度）显著大于优化检索工具链（约 3%–12%）；（4）在公开 BEAVER 基准上，最优变体（同时检索卡片与原始 SQL）达到 9.00% 执行准确率，相比可比基线 6.33%（p=0.12，方向性显著）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业 Text-to-SQL 的瓶颈不在模型本身，而在于喂给模型的上下文——业务逻辑横跨数千张表，没有任何模型能一次性吞下整个目录。现有方法主要优化 prompt/检索工具链（harness），而本文主张将"知识库上下文本身"作为可优化对象，且应基于历史使用数据自动构建而非手工调优为固定输入。

Method: （1）Query-DAG 监督框架：从生产 SQL 解析出节点为 CTE/子查询、边为数据流的 DAG，并标注自然语言描述、输出 schema 等可验证中间量，形成由弱到强的图保真度层级 I1–I4；（2）诊断实验：对比 oracle 图保真度与检索内容两个优化面，证明检索内容加入完整 oracle 图后带来最大边际增益；（3）上下文产物优化：对每个表定义选择器 f（按运行频次、消费者数等筛选历史查询）与摘要器 prompt P_sum（用 LLM 综合为表格 artifact），二者均纳入 AlphaEvolve 风格的外层搜索循环；评分变化作为接受/回滚依据；（4）失败诊断器：分析每个错误案例，将信息缺失归因于选择器、摘要器或检索工具中的具体一项，为下一轮变异提供方向。

Result: （1）Graph-vs-content 消融：加入检索后 AST 相似度从 0.341 跳到 0.582（Sonnet），0.291 跳到 0.558（Qwen），为表中最大跳跃；（2）内部基准（n=5176）：仅优化上下文产物使 AST 相似度相对提升约 12%（Sonnet）和 25%（Qwen），而仅优化检索工具链仅提升约 3% 和 12%；表选择 recall 从 0.714 提升到 0.805（Sonnet）；执行准确度在 n=102 可执行子集上从 0.255 提升到 0.333（Sonnet），置信区间虽重叠但方向一致；（3）BEAVER（N=300）：单独卡片 6.67%、单独原始 SQL 6.33%、两者结合 9.00%，对照可比基线 6.33%（p=0.12，方向性而非统计显著）；（4）失败分析表明主要受益来自检索阶段错误的减少，但 schema 链接（G2）和实例链接（G3）仍为持续性错误类别，深度组合性查询（嵌套 CTE）准确率仅约 1.5%。

Conclusion: 在企业级 Text-to-SQL 场景中，可自动蒸馏的上下文产物是比检索工具链更具价值的优化表面：内部生产基准显示其收益高出 3–10 倍。Query-DAG 监督框架提供了定位上下文瓶颈的可验证中间量。失败驱动的搜索循环可以将错误归因到选择器、摘要器或工具链的具体表面。BEAVER 上虽因缺乏生产使用信号而效果减弱，但组合检索仍给出方向性提升。残余难度集中在组合性查询结构上，下一步需引入结构感知的生成方法。

Abstract: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 production queries from a major online retailer, optimizing these context artifacts yields larger gains (${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST similarity) than optimizing the retrieval harness (${\sim}3$--$12\%$). On the public BEAVER benchmark, which lacks the production-usage signals available in our internal setting, the picture is more mixed: table cards alone perform about the same as raw historical SQL. The best optimized variant retrieves both cards and raw SQL, scoring $9.00\%$ versus $6.33\%$ (p-value $0.12$) for the comparable baseline on a held-out $N{=}300$ subset, using retrieved context and harness changes but no agentic loop.

</details>


### [380] [Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22832)
*Xiansheng Luo,Chaowei Zhang,Zewei Zhang,Yi Zhu,Jipeng Qiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Genda框架（生成时间对齐的伪弹幕流）和DM-FEND模型（弹幕引导的多模态假新闻检测器），通过模拟用户在视频播放过程中的实时反应弹幕，解决真实场景中弹幕累积延迟与实时检测需求之间的矛盾，并在中文FakeSV和英文FakeTT基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代短视频平台（TikTok、Bilibili）传播速度快，假新闻检测需实时进行。弹幕（Danmaku）作为时间敏感、细粒度的用户交互信号，理论上能提供判别性社会线索，但真实场景中弹幕存在累积延迟（accumulation latency），无法满足实时检测需求，导致弹幕辅助假新闻检测的研究空白。

Method: 1) **Genda框架**（时间生成式弹幕）：包含(a)视频理解模块（Qwen2.5-VL-7B对4秒视频片段进行语义/情感/时序编码）、(b)弹幕触发器（Danmaku Trigger，LoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B，采用序数回归+softplus单调阈值预测5级反应强度：None→Heated）、(c)弹幕生成器（条件化生成，融合语义、强度、时序位置、隐式风格变量）。2) **DM-FEND模型**：多模态编码器提取text/video/audio/danmaku片段级特征，通过(a)弹幕引导的单模态学习（top-k高显著性token重建+低显著性token噪声抑制的对比损失）、(b)弹幕引导的多模态学习（InfoNCE对比损失对齐模态对与弹幕），最后时间聚合+MLP二分类。

Result: 在FakeSV（中文）和FakeTT（英文）两个基准上，DM-FEND均取得最优：FakeSV上Acc 87.01%/Mac-F1 86.68%（超FakeSV-VLM 0.85%/0.94%），FakeTT上Acc 83.43%/Mac-F1 82.92%（超ExMRD 3.63%/3.73%），特别是Recall提升显著（FakeSV达90.66%）。消融实验验证DA（生成）+EN（单模态增强）+CM（跨模态对齐）三模块互补，全消融基线Acc仅81.49%/77.58%，三者联合提升5.52%/5.85%。PCA可视化显示加入弹幕后类内更紧凑、类间边界更清晰。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统性地将弹幕引入多模态假新闻检测，通过Genda框架生成时序对齐的伪弹幕流弥补真实弹幕延迟缺陷，结合DM-FEND实现片段级细粒度跨模态交互与对齐，有效提升假新闻检测的鲁棒性与判别力。未来可引入外部知识与社会传播网络进一步增强弹幕真实性与可信度。

Abstract: The social interactions among crowds via \textit{Danmaku} (a.k.a., bullet comments) on modern multimedia platforms can facilitate both viewpoint conflicts and consensus, providing fine-grained discriminative social signals that can benefit fake news detection. However, the inherent accumulation latency of \textit{Danmaku} in real-world scenarios violates the real-time necessity of fake news detection, making the studies of \textit{Danmaku}-related fake news detection underexplored. To break this violation, we simulate this temporal-aware user interactive process by proposing a novel temporal \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{da}nmaku framework, called \textbf{Genda}, which consists of: (1) a \textit{Danmaku} Trigger for predicting the timing and intensity of user reactions; and (2) a \textit{Danmaku} Generator for synthesizing corresponding semantic and emotional expressions, thereby mutually constructing a temporally aligned and human-like pseudo \textit{Danmaku} streams. To make the generated \textit{Danmaku} useful for identifying fake news videos, we further design a \textit{Danmaku}-guided Temporal Multimodal fake news detection model - \textbf{DM-FEND}, which enables fine-grained multimodal interactions among video, audio, text, and \textit{Danmaku}, enhancing dynamic modalities alignment and semantic noise inhibition. The experimental results demonstrate that \emph{DM-FEND} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across both Chinese (FakeSV) and English (FakeTT) benchmarks. Further ablations validate the crucial role of temporal \textit{Danmaku} modeling in enhancing robustness and discriminative capability. Finally, this study offers a bright and robust solution for multimodal fake news detection in modern social interactive fashions by bridging the temporal inconsistency between news and user behaviors.

</details>


### [381] [FinixDoc: Rethinking Financial Document Parsing Beyond Saturated Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22842)
*Hang Wang,Jin Zhang,Guoliang Xu,Pengyue Lu,Yao Li,Zijiao Zhang,Tianyu Huang,Weiqi Xiong,Yulong Wang,Chuqiao Lu,Wenkang Huang,Kai Yang,Yadong Li,Hui Li,Xingzhong Xu,Xiao Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FinixDoc是面向真实金融文档的端到端智能体解析系统,其核心是基于Qwen3-VL-4B构建的4B级视觉语言模型FinixDoc-VL。作者提出文档解析能力矩阵,从视觉质量和文档规模两个维度刻画基准测试与实际部署之间的差距,并通过同形异义字对比学习和多阶段领域特定奖励强化学习训练模型,配合人机协作的Data Factory数据生产线和金融领域评估基准FinixDocBench。FinixDoc-VL在主测试集上以81.43分领先开源基线模型5.13分,在内部金融工作流场景(FinixInner)中达到84.08分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档解析基准(如OmniDocBench)集中在数字原生、高质量、小规模文档区域,模型在这些"基准收敛区"表现趋同,但在真实金融部署中面临低质量摄像头拍摄、复杂版面和超大规模文档等挑战时性能急剧下降,暴露出基准性能与实际效用之间的明显差距。金融文档解析对准确性、结构一致性和可验证性有严格工业级标准,需要针对金融场景的专用系统来弥补这一差距。

Method: 1) 提出文档解析能力矩阵,沿视觉质量与文档规模两个维度将场景划分为基准收敛区、低质量区、欠探索的大规模区和模糊不可恢复区四个能力带;2) FinixDoc-VL基于Qwen3-VL-4B,通过同形异义字对比学习(构建含4500+高频字符的金融同形异义字词表,采用SSIM、pHash、笔画序列编辑距离、DTW-LCS等多视图相似度计算硬负样本,设计视觉分支与多模态生成分支的双路径三元组对比损失)进行视觉表征适配;3) 采用GRPO多阶段强化学习,设计任务依赖的复合奖励(文本保真度用归一化编辑距离和TEDS,检测质量用类别匹配与IoU,阅读顺序用编辑距离),通过JSON与Markdown双任务联合优化;4) 构建人机协作Data Factory数据生产线,采用异构多模型协同推理(PP-DocLayoutV3、FinixDoc-VL、Qwen3-VL-235B)、Kimi-K2.5级联精炼、规则验证与置信度感知路由;5) 提出系统级split-then-merge策略处理超大规模页面(动态路由→结构感知分割→方向感知重建)。

Result: 在OmniDocBench v1.5上,FinixDoc-VL的无公式分数S_ODB^wo-formula达到92.65,显著超越基座模型Qwen3-VL-4B的86.90。在FinixDocBench各子集上:FinixDigital得93.19分(最优)、FinixPhoto得67.03分(最优,较基座提升12.75分)、FinixInner综合得84.08分(最优,较次优开源模型Youtu-Parsing的78.73提升5.35分),在理赔病历(85.42)、费用清单(80.79)、体检报告(78.38)三个最难子集上均为最佳。FinixHuge超大规模子集上,完整FinixDoc系统成功率0.92(远超Qwen3-VL-235B的0.68和GLM-OCR的0.34),S_FDB达68.23分。隔离消融实验验证了ViT对比学习在驾驶执照识别任务上将文档级准确率从0.929提升至0.935。

Conclusion: 金融文档解析的进展不应仅依据"基准收敛区"上的分数衡量,更应关注低质量、高复杂度、大规模场景下的稳定性与可用性。FinixDoc通过能力矩阵分析、双阶段训练策略(同形异义字对比学习+领域奖励强化学习)、人机协作数据生产线和系统级超大规模处理策略,有效弥合了基准性能与实际部署效用之间的差距。未来工作方向包括低质量与模糊不可恢复区的不确定性估计与拒答机制、超大规模区更统一的多模态架构,以及持续扩展FinixDocBench覆盖范围。

Abstract: Financial document parsing requires accuracy, structural consistency, and verifiability that current benchmarks often fail to reflect. We present FinixDoc, an end-to-end agentic parsing system for real-world financial documents, with FinixDoc-VL, a 4B-scale vision-language model built on Qwen3-VL-4B, as its core parser. To characterize the gap between benchmark and deployment performance, we introduce a Document Parsing Capability Matrix organized along two practical axes: visual quality and document scale. Guided by this matrix, FinixDoc-VL is trained with a domain-adapted recipe combining homoglyph-aware contrastive learning and multi-stage reinforcement learning with composite domain-specific rewards. To better leverage our accumulated advantage in low-quality financial-document data and support large-scale, high-quality data production, we further build a human-in-the-loop Data Factory pipeline with confidence-aware expert review. For evaluation, we construct FinixDocBench, a financial-domain evaluation suite covering digital-native, camera-captured, ultra-large-page, and internal-workflow scenarios, with a compliance-reviewed subset released alongside this technical report. On its main subsets, FinixDoc-VL achieves the highest overall score (81.43) among evaluated baselines, outperforming the next-best open-source model by 5.13 points, with the largest gains on internal financial workflows (FinixInner: 84.08 vs. 78.73).

</details>


### [382] [GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22847)
*Long Zhang,Yuhan Chen,Chaoran Zhang,Wanxia Cao,Kun Huang,Pengzhi Gao,Wei Liu,Jian Luan,Chenliang Li,Lixin Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GSAR（Goal-State-Anchor Reward），一种用于移动端GUI智能体的强化学习奖励框架，通过自演化数据合成与状态锚定机制，解决当前GUI智能体RL训练中任务生成多样性不足及奖励信号不可靠两大瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于VLM的GUI智能体在线强化学习受限于两大根本性问题：(1) 现有数据合成方法依赖特定环境，难以生成多样化数据；(2) 现有评估器要么扩展性受限，要么奖励信号不准确不可靠（规则方法需人工编写执行函数、模型方法易产生幻觉与不稳定）。这两大问题阻碍了GUI智能体RLVR的可扩展训练。

Method: GSAR框架包含两大核心组件：(1) 自演化数据合成：通过随机探索生成初始任务，利用GPT-4o执行任务以演化应用环境，并通过inheritance（继承）、composition（合并）、rewriting（改写）三种任务复杂化策略，从简单任务逐步生成多样化复杂任务，同时保留初始环境快照实现可复现的RL训练。(2) 状态锚定奖励机制：从成功轨迹的终态截图中，通过叠加元素索引并利用VLM识别任务相关UI元素的索引，从a11y树中检索对应边界框，构建目标状态锚定参考。在RL训练时，评估器结合当前状态、动作历史和目标状态锚定参考G输出二元奖励。

Result: 离线轨迹验证准确率超过90%，是唯一在开源和闭源模型上同时在Acc和F1上超过90%的方法，最接近基于规则的评估。在AndroidControl（Low/High）和GUI-Odyssey基准上，合成数据微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B在EM指标上分别提升5.2%和3.2%。在线RL训练中，UI-TARS-7B-DPO在自建基准训练集上提升23.2%，全任务集提升8.1%；GUI-Owl-7B相应提升18.6%和8.2%。在AndroidWorld上，GSAR将UI-TARS基线成功率从26.7%提升至30.2%（规则方法为32.8%），且每次rollout时间（2342s）低于规则方法（2755s）。消融实验证实动作历史、锚定注释和参考图像三者缺一不可。

Conclusion: GSAR通过自演化数据合成和状态锚定奖励机制，为GUI智能体的RLVR训练提供了可扩展的数据合成范式和可靠的奖励框架。其奖励曲线与基于规则的方法高度一致，能够在无需手工规则的情况下提供稳定的优化信号，在准确性和扩展性之间取得了良好平衡，是GUI智能体大规模训练的有效解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) based GUI agents stand to benefit significantly from online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their training is bottlenecked by two fundamental issues: current data synthesis methods for GUI Agents rely on specific environments and struggle to generate diverse data, while existing evaluators either suffer from limited scalability or provide inaccurate and unreliable reward signals. To overcome these challenges, we introduce GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward), a RL reward framework that supports scalable task generation and delivers reliable reward signals for stable and efficient policy optimization. Our approach features self-evolving data synthesis, which produces multiple environments through task execution and generates diverse tasks and goal states. Complementing this, a state-anchor mechanism automatically annotates task-relevant UI elements in successful goal states as reference anchors. During RL training, these reference anchors provide accurate, scalable reward signals that substantially enhance efficiency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and performs closest to rule-based methods. Furthermore, agents trained using our reward framework exhibit strong performance on both AndroidWorld and our constructed benchmark, establishing a scalable approach for GUI agent training.

</details>


### [383] [Your AI, On a Dial: Controlling Investment Bias in LLMs with a Single Neuron](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22852)
*Sahong Park,Suhwan Park,Hoyoung Lee,Gakyung Kwon,Wonbin Ahn,Jaewon Choi,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Yoon Kim,Chanyeol Choi,Hyeongwoo Kong,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"投资偏置拨盘"(investment-bias dial)，通过对单个MLP神经元进行推理时加性干预，连续调节开源大语言模型的整体买卖倾向，且不修改提示词或模型参数，并在5个模型上验证了单调性、可校准性与下游传播效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在投资决策中存在系统性、模型特定的偏好偏差。现有方法中，提示工程对措辞敏感，微调则需针对每个目标重新训练且固定单一目标。如何在不改动提示词与模型参数的前提下，对模型的整体投资立场(方向与强度)进行连续、运行时可控的调节，成为一个未解决的问题。

Method: 采用"单神经元加性干预"方法：在MLP下投影输入的某一坐标上施加偏移量Δ，结合"决策相关性"(梯度敏感度Gc)与"先验可控性"(通过数据集划分Sₐ/S_B计算RMSE校准误差)两项准则筛选最优神经元坐标c*。基于平衡证据协议(每只股票等量正负证据)定义模型层与个股层投资偏置分数π，在不同目标π∈{-0.3, 0, +0.3}下估计Δ值。评估覆盖五个开源模型(Qwen3-8B、Llama-4-Scout、DeepSeek-R1-14B、Gemma-4-12B、Mistral-24B)，并检验七个基准、代理检索行为、长上下文稳健性及投资组合结果。

Result: 1) 单神经元干预在五个模型上均产生单调的投资偏置响应；2) 可针对看跌/中性/看涨目标进行校准，Qwen3-8B与Llama-4-Scout中性校准改变29.6%-32.5%的决策；3) 七个基准测试无系统性性能下降(BH校正后无显著退化)；4) 在代理设置中，下行/上行证据检索比例提升41%-88%；5) 长上下文下单神经元干预比匹配的系统提示指令更稳定；6) 探索性回测显示组合Sharpe比率变化但未能证实alpha。

Conclusion: 通过对单个MLP坐标的推理时加性干预，可在不修改提示词与模型参数的前提下，连续校准开源LLM的整体投资立场；该方法提供了方向与强度均可调的连续控制，并在证据敏感性、能力保持、代理信息获取与组合层面均显示出传播效应，但存在适用范围(需要激活访问)、任务泛化与市场机制忽略等局限。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment decision-making, yet prior work shows that they exhibit systematic, model-specific investment preferences. We study whether a model's overall investment stance can be calibrated to a specified direction and strength. We introduce an investment-bias dial, an inference-time intervention on a single neuron that continuously adjusts a model-level decision prior---its overall tendency toward buying or selling---without targeting specific firms or investment attributes. Using matched positive and negative evidence, we evaluate five open-weight LLMs and find that the dial produces monotonic changes in investment stance without modifying prompts or model parameters. At the response level, the dial shifts both investment decisions and the evidential emphasis of generated rationales under identical inputs. In an agentic retrieval setting, the dial also changes what information the model searches for, which evidence it selects, and which evidence is reflected in its final analysis. In a long-context evaluation, the dial maintains stable stance control as context length increases, whereas a matched system-prompt instruction progressively attenuates. We further show that changes in the dial propagate to security rankings and downstream portfolio composition in an exploratory backtest. Overall, our results show that an LLM's aggregate investment stance can be calibrated toward a specified target at inference time.

</details>


### [384] [Proxy reliance in large language model decisions is uncalibrated to predictive evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22887)
*Zengqing Wu,Chuan Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在医疗分诊等决策场景中对代理变量(proxy attributes)的依赖程度,发现LLM的代理依赖严重偏离证据所支持的合理水平(undertracking),且基于社敏感标签的"抑制"现象十分脆弱——一旦加入上下文示例即被打破。准确率评估对此类校准问题完全无能为力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM公平性审计主要通过改变人口统计属性观察决策是否变化,但代理属性常同时具有预测价值和与受保护属性的相关性,导致"决策变化"既可能源于歧视也可能源于合理推断,无法给出量化判定。本文旨在引入"证据所支持的合理依赖水平"作为规范性参考,定量区分过度依赖、合理依赖和不足依赖三种情形。

Method: 1) 构建完全受控的合成患者生成过程,使真实风险与各属性的关系已知,从而可精确计算"证据所支持的依赖水平"作为参考基准;2) 设计临床配对排序任务,通过反事实干预受保护属性并仅让其通过代理属性传播,测量"有向代理特定效应"(directed proxy-specific effect, PSE);3) 引入"理想学习者"控制(贝叶斯回归基于模型见过的相同示例),以避免将有限证据下的合理谨慎误判为模型失败;4) 在四个LLM(Claude Sonnet 4.5、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Qwen3.7-max、GPT-5.6 Terra)上系统性变化代理信息量、标签语义(中性vs社会)、属性维度k和依赖结构;5) 通过剂量-反应曲线评估依赖是否随证据增强而合理变化。

Result: 1) 中性标签下零信息代理触发所有模型的无理由依赖(+19.7至+22.2个百分点),远超证据支持的零水平;2) 引入信息性代理后,三种判定(过度/合理/不足)同时出现;3) 剂量-反应曲线的斜率γ在-0.08到+0.15之间,所有模型均排除γ=1(校准追踪)且不排除γ=0,即依赖水平几乎不随证据强度变化;4) 社会标签抑制效应存在显著的提供商差异(Sonnet为-20.7pp,DeepSeek为-6.6pp),且即使是与结果零相关的"干净"上下文示例也会将社会标签下的依赖拉回到正值(+15.7pp);5) 准确率与代理依赖是可分离的两个通道——结构操作可使依赖移动24pp而准确率几乎不变,准确性评估对此完全失明;6) 审计中标签不匹配和完全省略造成的偏差(8.25和13.89pp)远大于分布偏移(2.64pp),且前者无法通过重要性加权修复。

Conclusion: LLM的代理依赖严重未与证据校准,其行为本质上是"固定水平依赖 + 移动参考线",这使得审计判定主要取决于部署环境的证据结构而非模型本身。基于社敏感标签的表面抑制是脆弱的、标签触发的捷径,在最像部署的配置(提供上下文示例)下失效。准确率评估不能诊断代理校准问题。无证据支持的定量参考的审计会同时产生误报(惩罚证据支持的依赖)和漏报(认可脆弱的表面抑制)。本文将LLM置信度研究的贝叶斯参照范式拓展到了歧视审计领域。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are entering decisions in triage and lending, where task-relevant inference must be distinguished from impermissible proxy use. Current audits ask whether decisions change when demographics change. But attributes correlated with a protected group carry predictive value, so a changed decision can be discrimination or sound inference. We measure causal proxy effects in four LLMs on a clinical-ranking task with known ground truth, where the reliance the evidence warrants can be computed exactly and used as the reference. One audit signal yields three verdicts: over-reliance, warranted and under-reliance. Under neutral labels every model relies on proxies with no information. Informative proxies draw all three. Social field names push reliance down, below the reference in one model. Two findings explain this. Reliance severely undertracks the evidence, and social-label suppression is fragile, since in-context examples raise it above zero in every model. Accuracy-based evaluation detects none of this.

</details>


### [385] [CDEG: Learning Decision-Critical Evidence for Long-Horizon Diagnostic Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22899)
*Xiwei Dai,Zijie Meng,Zhiting Fan,Yixuan Tang,Ziru Niu,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CDEG框架，通过对比同一病例的成功与失败轨迹、采用反事实干预验证证据的诊断价值，构建"诊断-证据-动作"结构化图，并在推理时基于动态证据状态引导医生智能体补充缺失证据或重新审视已有证据，在多个骨干和基准上稳定提升长程诊断准确率（最高11.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医生智能体在长程交互诊断中常因关键证据未被获取或在推理中被忽视而失败；已有基于历史轨迹或记忆蒸馏的经验复用方法停留在轨迹/记忆层级，未验证哪些证据真正驱动诊断决策，导致噪声与偶发信息被一并复用。

Method: 三阶段构建：(1) 对同一病例采样K条轨迹，按诊断正确性配对相似度最高的一对成功/失败轨迹，并将观测映射为UMLS概念级别的"证据原子"，划分出缺失证据集𝒞^M、忽视证据集𝒞^I与阻塞证据集𝒞^B；(2) 反事实验证——分别进行补全测试、再评估测试与阻塞测试，并通过双向顺序消偏，仅保留确实改变诊断偏好的证据；(3) 将验证后的证据、对应诊断与采集动作组织为包含诊断节点、证据节点、动作节点及三类边的反事实诊断证据图。推理时维护证据状态𝒮ₜ，基于证据覆盖率检索最相关的诊断修订边，并依据是否可获取新证据选择"缺失证据获取"或"忽视证据再评估"两种干预方式。

Result: 在MIMIC-IDx（ID，200例）与AgentClinic-MedQA（OOD，107例）上，使用Gemini-3-Flash-Preview、Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.6-Luna、Claude-Sonnet-5四种骨干，CDEG均优于Vanilla Agent、Self-Reflection、Trajectory RAG与Flat Experience基线；MIMIC-IDx平均准确率提升7.63%，AgentClinic提升8.88%，最高提升11.5%。消融实验表明反事实验证是关键，移除任一候选证据集均会降低纠错率，且采集与再评估两种干预互补；错误分析显示约88%的诊断错误源于关键证据缺失或未被充分利用，CDEG仅以约1.3轮额外交互成本实现更低的回归率与更高的诊断稳定性。

Conclusion: 可靠的长程诊断需要从轨迹级经验复用转向证据级学习；CDEG通过反事实验证与结构化图组织，识别真正影响诊断偏好的关键证据，并在推理时依据证据状态进行选择性干预，能跨骨干与跨分布地稳定提升诊断性能；未来工作将探索图的在线演化以实现持续经验验证，并扩展至更广泛的临床场景。

Abstract: Unlike static medical question answering, long-horizon diagnosis captures the sequential nature of clinical practice: evidence is progressively acquired, integrated, and evaluated over multiple rounds of interaction before reaching a final diagnosis. However, existing doctor agents often fail when critical evidence is either not acquired or not adequately incorporated into diagnostic reasoning. Recent agentic approaches attempt to address these failures by reusing historical trajectories or distilled memories. But their diagnostic gains remain constrained because such experience may contain noisy or incidental information and is typically reused without validating which evidence actually drives diagnostic decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce CDEG, a graph-based framework that learns reusable decision-critical evidence from historical diagnostic trajectories. CDEG contrasts successful and failed trajectories from the same case to identify candidate evidence, validates their diagnostic impact through controlled counterfactual interventions, and organizes the resulting diagnosis--evidence--action relations into a structured graph. During inference, CDEG tracks the evolving patient evidence state to retrieve relevant diagnostic relations and selectively guide missing evidence acquisition or overlooked evidence reappraisal. Across in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks with multiple doctor agent backbones, CDEG consistently improves diagnostic performance, achieving up to an 11.5% accuracy gain over vanilla agents. These results demonstrate that reliable long-horizon diagnosis requires moving beyond trajectory-level experience reuse toward evidence-level learning of the factors that truly shape clinical decisions.

</details>


### [386] [Beyond Observed Auxiliary Relations: Environment-Conditioned Modeling for Multi-Behavior Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22920)
*Seunghan Lee,Hyunsik Yoo,Jian Kang,Susik Yoon,SeongKu Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BOAR框架，通过环境条件建模同时解决多行为推荐中辅助信号的缺失和不可靠问题，在隐藏目标物品上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多行为推荐中基于GNN的方法面临两大根本挑战：辅助信号缺失（C1）导致无法泛化至无辅助观测的物品；辅助信号不可靠（C2）会放大与目标行为不一致的噪声。现有方法无法同时解决这两个挑战。

Method: 提出BOAR（环境条件多行为推荐框架），基于辅助可观测性条件将目标偏好估计分解为两个互补模块：(1) 去偏稠化模块f₀（处理E=0场景）通过对抗学习抑制流行度偏差，采用角LSH+可学习边选择挖掘隐藏偏好，并使用IPS/SNIPS加权BPR损失；(2) 目标引导精炼模块f₁（处理E=1场景）通过特征门控和Gumbel-Softmax选择性剪枝过滤与目标不一致的辅助关系。使用辅助观测倾向概率作为软分配权重整合两个模块。

Result: 在Tmall、Taobao、JData三个数据集上，BOAR在通用设置中HR@10最高提升7.82%，在无辅助观测物品的设置中HR@10最高提升44.2%，同时保持与SOTA基线相当的推理效率（参数规模相同，推理速度最快）。

Conclusion: BOAR是首个同时解决辅助信号缺失与不可靠两大挑战的方法，通过环境条件模块化设计有效捕获了超出观测辅助关系的隐藏用户偏好，为多行为推荐提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Multi-behavior recommendation (MBR) leverages auxiliary behavioral signals, such as clicks and add-to-cart, to enhance target behavior prediction like purchases. While recent graph neural network-based approaches have achieved strong performance by systematically propagating auxiliary behavior signals, they still suffer from two fundamental challenges inherent to auxiliary behaviors: (1) missing auxiliary signals, which hinder generalization to items without auxiliary observations, and (2) unreliable auxiliary signals, which amplify noise misaligned with the target behavior. To address these challenges in a unified manner, we propose BOAR, an environment-conditioned MBR framework that addresses missing and unreliable auxiliary signals through two complementary modules conditioned on auxiliary observability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BOAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 7.82% gains in HR@10 overall and up to 44.2% gains for target items without auxiliary observations, highlighting its ability to capture hidden preferences beyond observed auxiliary relations. Our code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [387] [Concepts for Securing Agentic AI Coding and the Terok Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22930)
*Jiří Vyskočil,Franz Pöschel,Andreas Knüpfer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对Agentic AI（智能体式AI）编程工具所带来的IT安全风险，提出了一套系统性的安全保护方案，并基于该方案实现了名为Terok的开源沙箱环境。研究将编码智能体视为不可信主体，通过容器隔离、出站防火墙、Git网关代理和凭证保险库四重防护机制，在不损害智能体自主执行优势的前提下，遏制其对本地环境、代码仓库、LLM服务及外部世界可能造成的危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI编程相比传统LLM辅助编程（Vibe Coding）是一项范式级跃迁，智能体可自主调用工具、执行命令并自我修正，大幅提升了开发效率。然而，这种"代理性"也使其具备了类病毒/后门的能力，可能窃取凭证、植入恶意代码、污染软件供应链等。现有防护手段（如逐步确认、命令黑白名单、口头指令、多智能体监控）均存在显著缺陷：前者抵消自主优势，后者因智能体可绕过规则或被提示注入欺骗而不可靠。因此，亟需一种既保留Agentic AI自主执行优势，又能系统化管控其IT安全风险的环境。

Method: 研究方法包含三个层次：
（1）**风险评估**：将风险分为三类——传统但在智能体场景下加剧的风险（恶意代码生成、软件供应链攻击）、AI早期风险（错误、幻觉、提示注入、恶意智能体、供应商依赖与信任、技能退化）、以及Agentic AI独有风险（类病毒/后门行为、数据窃取、API密钥外泄）。
（2）**分层作用域与四重防护方案**：划分五个作用域（本地环境、容器内、Git Forge、LLM供应商、其他外部资源），并提出四重安全防护——容器环境防护（基于rootless Podman，可选krun微VM）、出站防火墙防护（基于nftables/dnsmasq的默认拒绝型出站控制）、Git网关防护（充当本地代理仓库，隔离智能体对主仓库的提交）、凭证保险库防护（基于systemd TPM2存储密钥，通过代理注入而非直接暴露）。
（3）**Terok开源实现**：将上述概念落地为完整的Python开源项目，提供CLI、TUI和Web界面，支持多种LLM客户端与供应商，并兼顾易用性。

Result: 研究产出了以下成果：
1. 系统化的Agentic AI编程风险分类法，识别出14类具体风险组合，其中12类可由Terok方案缓解，2类（供应商信任、技能退化）属方案范围之外。
2. 一个基于不可信主体模型的五作用域、四防护安全架构，详细说明了每种防护与风险类型的对应映射关系。
3. Terok开源工具（https://github.com/terok-ai/terok），支持Fedora、Ubuntu、NVIDIA CUDA等多种容器镜像，兼容OpenCode、Claude、Codex、Copilot、Mistral等多种客户端，并支持Blablador、KISSKI等学术/国家级LLM服务以及自托管模型。
4. 与Docker Sandboxes、microsandbox、nono、NVIDIA OpenShell等同类沙箱方案相比，Terok完全开源、供应商中立，构建于rootless Podman栈之上。

Conclusion: 本文认为Agentic AI是软件开发的革命性工具，但若不解决其IT安全问题，潜藏的危害可能远超其收益。作者提出的Terok环境通过容器隔离、出站防火墙、Git网关和凭证保险库的组合，在保留智能体自主执行、自我修正等核心优势的前提下，有效缓解了绝大多数已识别风险。虽然这一快速演进领域不存在一劳永逸的解决方案，但Terok代表了向负责任地使用Agentic AI进行软件开发迈出的重要一步，并为社区提供了安全探索该技术的实践平台。未来工作将聚焦于完善Git网关的双向代理能力（支持PR和Issue流转）以及应对多智能体协作场景下的安全架构演进。

Abstract: Agentic AI is a fascinating new tool for software development. It is a huge step forward compared to "conventional" AI assisted coding, which in turn was a considerable breakthrough earlier. AI support through LLMs is a young and very fast-moving field. The "conventional" (non-agentic) flavor became useful and productive in early 2025 (around 18 months ago) and the agentic flavor followed in fall 2025 (approximately 9 months ago). Besides all its benefits and potential, it also carries some fundamental risks for IT security. And the agentic approach added very severe risks while making others much more dangerous. With all the motivation to explore this fascinating new tool we should not ignore the risks but actively address them. We present (I) an assessment of the IT security risks, (II) a concept for mitigating them without breaking its benefits, and (III) an overview about an implementation of our concept. In this very dynamic field this is likely not the final and once-and-for-all answer to the identified issues but still a substantial step forward in responsible usage of Agentic AI for software development. It should also be a contribution to the community to allow early and eager evaluation of the potential of agentic AI for software development without actually suffering from its implied IT security risks.

</details>


### [388] [What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22960)
*Jiawei He,Mengyu Shi,Jie jia,Xikai Yang,Dong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对编码智能体的"过程评估"提出测量框架，指出动作预测、任务不确定性与步骤归因是三个不同层级的问题，常被混为一谈。作者基于结构因果模型设计了SCAE（基于回放的步骤级因果归因估计器），并在12个代码库的499个文件定位任务上进行实证。结果表明：下一步动作主要由执行溯源而非代码图决定；执行不确定性结构化于任务级而非步骤级；全轨迹评判器存在系统性碰撞偏差，其本质更接近语义相关性而非因果贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体的过程评估（process evaluation）方法常将动作预测（action prediction）、任务不确定性（task uncertainty）与步骤归因（step attribution）混为一谈，导致评估结果难以解释和验证。具体而言，全轨迹LLM评判器将后续步骤和最终结果作为条件，引入了碰撞偏差（collider bias）；过程奖励模型（PRM）的标签从完整轨迹回填，混合了未来信息；而步骤级因果归因在实践中因正性（positivity）失败而难以测量。因此需要明确区分三个层级，为每类过程信号建立可验证的测量标准。

Method: 1) **测量框架**：将过程评估明确分为动作级、任务级、步骤级三层，对应不同的因果/统计量。2) **SCAE估计器**：基于结构因果模型（SCM）形式化智能体执行，使用Gumbel-max机制表示策略；定义anytime value function $v_t = E[Y|\tau_{1:t},q,G]$ 与步骤增量 $\Delta_t = v_t - v_{t-1}$（Theorem 1保证完全可加）。3) **混合识别策略**：通过回放探针（entropy probe）测量动作分布局部重叠度，当熵高于阈值时使用观测分支（fork-resampling），否则切换到干预分支（实际执行替代动作），不伪造工具输出。4) **关键假设**：上下文可观测（Assumption 1）、解码噪声外生（Assumption 2）、环境可重放（Assumption 3）、扰动可迁移性（Assumption 4）。5) **因果梯级定位**：动作级=Level II.5（保留历史+干预一步），干预步骤=Level III。6) **实验设计**：在SWE-bench-Verified上提取499个文件定位实例，使用回溯条件下的前缀回放构造，再做信息集控制实验隔离评判器的碰撞偏差。

Result: 1) **动作级**：provenance-based预测器在首访步骤上达到top-3=0.326（CI[0.276,0.375]），远高于强化代码图预测器的0.058；69%的首访目标先前已在工具输出中提及。2) **图结构作用**：代码依赖图描述智能体工作的区域（内部边密度提升30.9×），但不能解释步骤间转移（一步跳跃提升仅0.94，与置换零假设无显著差异）。3) **不确定性结构**：实例身份解释0.640的重放方差（零假设0.196，p=5×10⁻⁴），步骤位置和工具类型几乎无解释力——不确定性主要是任务级而非步骤级。4) **步骤归因**：190个干预估计中0个通过BH-FDR校正（q=0.10），仅5.3%达到未校正p<0.05。5) **碰撞偏差**：控制评判器可见的下游步骤后，归因点平均后移+0.537（n=70，符号检验p=1.1×10⁻¹⁶），3个评判器模型均一致显示该效应；全轨迹评判器90%的选择落在gold-provenance步骤上（基线41.3%），但倾向于在其类别内偏向靠后位置（0.746 vs 0.5均匀零假设）。

Conclusion: 过程评估不是一个而是多个问题：动作预测、任务不确定性和步骤归因应被明确区分。编码智能体的下一步动作主要由自身执行溯源（即最近工具输出中看到的路径）而非代码图决定；执行不确定性是任务级属性而非步骤级属性；当前过程评估方法（特别是全轨迹LLM评判器）因对评分步骤的后代进行条件化而存在系统性碰撞偏差，其测量结果更接近语义相关性而非经过验证的因果贡献。形式可识别并不等于实际可测量——在可行回放预算下，步骤级因果定位在实证上不可行。过程评估方法应明确其所测量的层级，并按相应标准进行验证。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly evaluated not only by whether they solve a task, but also by how they execute it. However, existing process-level evaluations often treat action prediction, task uncertainty, and step attribution as if they were the same problem, which makes it unclear what such evaluations actually measure. In this paper, we introduce a measurement framework for process evaluation in coding agents and instantiate step-level causal attribution with SCAE, a replay-based estimator derived from a structural causal model of agent execution. Our framework combines prefix-conditioned identification, replay/intervention-based estimation, and controlled judge-information manipulation to study process evaluation at the action, task, and step levels. Experiments on 499 file-localization episodes from 12 repositories show that next actions are driven primarily by execution provenance rather than code-graph transitions, execution uncertainty is structured at the task rather than step level, and full-trace judges exhibit systematic collider bias, suggesting that current process evaluation often measures semantic relevance rather than certified causal contribution.

</details>


### [389] [Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22963)
*Yuchen Huang,Sijia Li,Jun Zhang,Yi R. Fung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体在多步工具调用过程中产生的"文本债务"问题（即累积的自生成推理文本压制视觉证据），提出了一种名为SPARE（Selective Pruning of Accumulated Reasoning with Visual Evidence Preservation）的KL散度引导的上下文剪枝框架。该方法通过摘要条件重放，利用反向KL散度度量每个推理片段的残差敏感度，选择性剪枝已被摘要覆盖的冗余文本，同时将保留的高敏感片段重构为简洁的视觉证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM智能体在多步推理中会持续生成显式推理文本，这些自生成文本随轮次累积，逐渐主导上下文窗口并压制视觉证据，形成"文本债务"。当早期推理未能正确关联视觉区域时，后续推理会在不完整或错误锚定的文本基础上展开，产生陈旧假设，误导后续推理。因此，剪枝必须既能移除冗余文本，又不能丢弃关键的视觉证据（OCR字符串、坐标、边界框、视觉锚点等）。现有视觉token压缩方法针对已被弱关注的视觉流，进一步压缩可能削弱图像证据的贡献；而通用摘要方法粒度过粗，无法识别哪些历史片段仍具有功能必要性。

Method: SPARE框架包含三个核心组件：(1) **摘要条件覆盖估计**：模型自主调用内部summarize_the_task工具生成紧凑任务状态摘要σ作为"特权诊断上下文"，对每个候选推理片段在同一模型下进行两种上下文（ρ₀和ρ₀∥σ）的重放，利用学生分布的top-K支持上的截断反向KL散度计算每个token的残差敏感度得分d_k，并在事件内归一化为d̃_k；(2) **片段级剪枝决策**：采用基于计数的保留规则——若片段中归一化KL得分超过阈值τ的高敏感token数≥κ（默认τ=0.2, κ=2），则保留该片段；(3) **证据保留式重构**：低KL片段直接删除，高KL片段重构为简洁结构化视觉证据（如裁剪位置、识别文本、数值、候选关系），工具调用、视觉观测和图像token保持不变。此外，通过SFT微调摘要器（使用Qwen3-235B生成的摘要作为监督），增强摘要覆盖率以支持更激进的剪枝。

Result: 在五个多步视觉工具使用基准（VisualToolBench、m&m's、GTA、V*、BLINK-Jigsaw）上，使用三个VLM骨干（Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-VL-8B）进行评估：(1) **主结果**：SPARE在所有骨干上均取得剪枝方法中最高的平均准确率，同时剪除37.89%–64.58%的推理token——Qwen3-VL-30B上平均准确率从44.30%提升至49.19%（剪枝63.70%），Qwen3-VL-8B保持53.47%准确率（剪枝37.89%）；(2) **SFT增强**：SFT摘要器在VTB和MNMS上分别提升准确率至28.73%和65.44%，且剪枝量增加13.5%–23.8%；(3) **消融实验**：在GTA上完整SPARE达到42.37%准确率和62.42%剪枝率，验证了KL选择与证据重构的互补性，以及模型自适应触发的优越性；(4) **控制诊断**：在构造的GTA子集上，SPARE将强制选择准确率从63.64%/54.55%（8B/30B）提升至90.91%/81.82%，陈旧答案复制率从36.36%/45.45%降至9.09%/18.18%；(5) **注意力分析**：剪枝后跨层文本到图像的注意力一致增强，验证了文本债务的缓解。

Conclusion: 论文将"文本债务"识别为多步MLLM智能体的关键失效模式——累积的自生成推理逐渐主导上下文并削弱视觉证据的依赖。基于"推理token的效用随时间变化"的洞察，提出SPARE作为OPSD KL引导的框架，通过选择性遗忘冗余推理并保留视觉证据，减少文本主导并将注意力重新导向图像。实验证明SPARE在提升任务性能、降低推理token使用、恢复视觉证据注意力方面的有效性，表明推理时的选择性遗忘是长上下文多模态推理的有效机制。局限性在于：当前设计主要适用于具有显式推理和工具使用历史的多步多模态智能体；摘要生成和上下文重放引入额外计算开销（尽管自适应触发可避免短轨迹成本）；未来工作需扩展至更多模态和智能体架构，并进行端到端延迟评估。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-step agents, where explicit reasoning supports task decomposition and tool coordination but also accumulates self-generated text. Over long trajectories, this text can dominate the context and suppress visual evidence, creating textual debt. We observe that reasoning becomes redundant once task-relevant visual evidence is grounded, while stale hypotheses can misguide later inference when grounding remains uncertain. Pruning must therefore remove redundant text without discarding visual evidence. We propose SPARE, a Kullback--Leibler (KL)-guided framework for pruning accumulated reasoning in multimodal tool-use agents. SPARE uses a compact task-state summary as privileged diagnostic context. For each candidate segment, it replays the same model under the original and summary-conditioned contexts. Reverse-KL divergence from on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) then tests whether the summary sufficiently covers the segment without disrupting future reasoning. We further fine-tune the summarizer with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), enabling more compact summaries, broader coverage, and more aggressive pruning. Across multi-step visual tool-use benchmarks, SPARE achieves the highest average accuracy among pruning methods while removing 37.89--64.58\% of reasoning tokens. This favorable accuracy--context trade-off shows that reducing textual dominance restores reliance on visual evidence and mitigates over-conditioning on self-generated language.

</details>


### [390] [ParallelWorld: Test-Time Scaling for Embodied Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22971)
*Min Chen,Shengjun Zhang,Yuxin Li,Zhang Zhang,Xin Fei,Chong Xia,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ParallelWorld，一个用于具身推理的多步测试时扩展框架，通过在仿真器中并行展开多条未来轨迹并由验证器引导剪枝，解决现有主动推理方法缺乏长视野规划的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动具身推理方法多采用增量式、贪心的单步探索策略，难以应对遮挡空间环境中的延迟反馈，缺乏对未来轨迹的显式推理与多步前瞻规划能力。

Method: 基于可恢复仿真器状态，从当前状态分支出多条并行轨迹，在多步视野内连续展开。每步由验证器代理评估中间状态转换，根据预设的分支宽度调度策略（奇数步保留多分支、偶数步收敛到单一分支）动态剪枝并选择信息增益最高的路径。最终由答案代理仅基于最优的根到叶路径执行推理并输出答案。

Result: 在ESI-Bench基准的28个子类别上，ParallelWorld在所有类别上均优于传统Active Exploration基线，在Temporal Understanding（如Unobserved Change从70.95%提升至89.86%）和Metric Comparison（如Spatial Distance从58.55%提升至67.11%）上提升尤为显著。预定义的分支宽度调度策略在精度与效率之间取得最佳平衡，平均准确率达59.56%，平均运行时间350.6秒。

Conclusion: ParallelWorld通过前瞻性世界仿真为具身智能体提供了超越反应式单轨迹探索的有效机制，验证了未来轨迹模拟在提升主动具身推理方面的价值。局限在于额外测试时计算开销以及对仿真器精度和验证器可靠性的依赖，未来工作方向包括学习型分支剪枝、不确定性感知验证器及真实机器人部署。

Abstract: Embodied Reasoning constitutes a fundamental capability of embodied intelligence, serving as the basis for autonomous perception, reasoning, and interaction within physical environments. Recent studies have shifted the paradigm of embodied reasoning from static perception toward dynamic exploration, where agents acquire task-relevant information through interactions with the environment. However, existing active reasoning approaches generally generate exploration trajectories incrementally without long-horizon planning. Even recently emerged test-time scaling frameworks often resort to myopic, single-step lookaheads, which struggle to resolve the delayed feedback inherent in complex, occluded spatial environments. To address this limitation, we propose ParallelWorld, a multi-horizon test-time scaling framework for embodied reasoning. Instead of greedy, single-step trials, ParallelWorld empowers agents to simulate and evaluate multi-step future trajectories in parallel before committing to an action. Specifically, we introduce a verifier-guided tree-search paradigm. Starting from the current state, ParallelWorld branches into multiple parallel trajectories and rolls them out continuously across a multi-step horizon. At each simulation step, a verifier agent evaluates the intermediate state transitions, dynamically pruning unpromising branches and prioritizing paths with the highest information gain. Once the multi-step prospective simulation is complete, the agent synthesizes the long-horizon outcomes to commit to the optimal action sequence. Finally, an answer agent performs reasoning over the selected trajectory to produce the final reasoning. Extensive experiments on ESI-Bench demonstrate that ParallelWorld consistently improves active perception and reasoning performance.

</details>


### [391] [Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22974)
*Xiaohui Zhang,Zequn Sun,Chengyuan Yang,Yuanning Cui,Lingbing Guo,Wei Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OaK框架,将本体(ontology)作为LLM智能体的"内核",动态构建任务导向的本体模式与知识图谱,自动生成类型化推理函数,并通过judge反馈迭代修复,提升智能体在多步推理中的证据基础与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在领域任务中依赖隐式语义关联,导致证据利用不完整、多步决策脆弱。传统本体构建依赖专家、难以扩展;自动构建的本体表面合理却可能缺乏决策所需的关系结构。需要一种显式、可验证的语义-操作契约来约束智能体行为。

Method: 提出ontology-as-a-kernel(本体即内核)框架:包含四步迭代循环——(1)模式构建(需求分析→草拟→HermiT OWL形式验证);(2)知识图谱实例化(chunk-map-merge流水线,基于主键签名去重);(3)知识推理(LLM将通用算子库O组合/特化/适配为类型化函数);(4)本体评估(官方评分+judge产生add/delete/modify修复建议)。推理阶段冻结内核,ReAct智能体通过函数调用图执行任务。

Result: 在TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro、ToolQA三个基准上,使用DeepSeek-v4-flash和GPT-4o-mini两种骨干,OaK在聚合指标上均达到最优(如TravelPlanner DeepSeek Final Pass Rate 59.31%,CRMArenaPro B2B Avg 78.38%,ToolQA Avg 64.58%)。消融实验验证函数组合、函数模块、迭代修复均不可或缺;5轮预算即可收敛;多随机种子结果稳定。代价是构图带来更高的运行时间和输出token,但输入token低于ReAct和MemP。

Conclusion: 将领域语义和推理过程显式化为本体内核,可同时提升LLM智能体的有效性与可审查性。未来工作关注可复用/增量更新的图、更强的验证机制、丰富的算子库与本体表达,以应对更大规模和演化的领域。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely heavily on knowledge encoded in model parameters or presented as unstructured context. In domain-specific tasks, this leaves important semantic connections implicit. This often results in incomplete evidence use and brittle multi-step decisions. Ontologies offer a way to externalize domain concepts and relations as machine-interpretable structures, but constructing task-usable ontologies traditionally requires substantial effort from domain experts and is difficult to scale. Automatic construction is also challenging: an ontology that appears semantically plausible may not contain the relational structures needed for actual decision making. We present OaK, an ontology-as-a-kernel framework that dynamically constructs and refines task-oriented ontologies for LLM agents. Given task requirements and training data, OaK constructs an ontology and its knowledge graph, generates task-adaptation functions for graph reasoning, and uses judge feedback to iteratively refine both. By making relevant concepts and relations explicit, the ontology grounds knowledge retrieval and multi-step decision making. We evaluate OaK on TravelPlanner, CRMArenaPro, and ToolQA. Results show that OaK improves standard LLM agents, strengthens evidence grounding, and boosts the reliability of multi-step reasoning.

</details>


### [392] [Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22975)
*Defu Lin,Wenhui Chen,Ziyao Lin,Jianlin Chen,Peiji Long,Chi Man Vong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在固定每决策token预算约束下，提出四种资源墙理论并设计ASP框架（组合压缩状态、逐字索引与查询条件路由），在SEW-Bench上验证查询条件访问机制比查询无关采样有效，但ASP完整三组件架构未能通过通道二元性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身多模态智能体需要在固定每决策token预算下从持续增长的观测流中回答，但开放模型在具身感知-决策任务上表现仍然很差，关键瓶颈在于跨流的访问结构而非单帧感知能力，因此需要将每决策token预算作为正确抽象来分析这一失败模式。

Method: 形式化四种资源墙（感知Shannon墙、视野墙、轮次墙、合成墙）并证明相关不可能性定理；设计ASP无训练包装器，包含压缩结构状态通道、逐字情节索引通道和查询条件路由器；采用预注册协议，在SEW-Bench（免许可合成长视野遍历基准）上对3B到31B的七个开放权重模型进行评估。

Result: 查询条件检索达到75-94%情节检索准确率，远超查询无关采样的3-19%；预算重分配在每个骨干网络上都优于四倍采样预算；然而完整ASP未验证通道二元性——移除压缩状态使旗舰模型均值从35.4升至58.0，ASP在所有骨干网络上均未优于仅逐字基线，四个预注册证伪标准中有两个触发；表明查询条件访问而非参数规模或上下文增长是固定预算下的决定性因素，但提示式在线压缩在该场景中不值其代价。

Conclusion: 理论部分成立，四种墙在感知形式下重现于预算受限观测流；关于访问机制的实证声明强烈成立，重组访问击败每个等预算的查询无关替代方案；但关于完整三组件架构的声明不成立，ASP在多次比较校正后未在任何骨干网络上击败仅逐字通道，证伪源于加性归约下N·ε_u项的紧密性；贡献在于一组墙、预算核算以及对访问结构各部分价格的经验回答，而非可工作的双通道架构。

Abstract: Embodied multimodal agents must answer from growing observation streams under a fixed per-decision token budget. We formalize this constraint through four resource walls: a perceptual Shannon wall for bounded state, a horizon wall for query-independent frame selection, a round wall for non-adaptive retrieval, and a conditional composition wall for fixed-depth inference. We introduce ASP, a training-free wrapper for frozen multimodal models that combines a capped structured state, a verbatim episodic index, and query-conditioned budget allocation with iterative access. Following a pre-registered protocol, we evaluate seven open-weight models from 3B to 31B on SEW-Bench, a license-free synthetic long-horizon walkthrough benchmark constructed to instantiate these walls. The registered natural-video benchmarks were not run because their frames require dataset agreements; our evidence therefore concerns access mechanisms, not natural-scene perception. Under a 4,096-token decision budget, ASP reaches 75 to 94% episodic retrieval accuracy, compared with 3 to 19% for equal-budget query-independent sampling, and budget reallocation outperforms quadrupling the sampling budget on every backbone. However, the full three-component architecture does not validate channel duality: removing the compressive state raises the flagship mean from 35.4 to 58.0, ASP does not outperform the verbatim-only baseline on any backbone, and two of four pre-registered falsification criteria fire. These results show that query-conditioned access, rather than parameter count or context growth alone, is decisive under a fixed budget, while prompted online compression does not earn its cost in this setting.

</details>


### [393] [SA-RSQ: A Versatile Sparse Representation Framework for Multi-modal Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22979)
*Xiang Wang,Shigang Quan,Tingzhen Chang,Kang Yang,Sitong Chen,Yabo Fan,Xingxing Wang,Zhaodian He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SA-RSQ是一种用于工业推荐系统的高维多模态特征压缩框架，通过Top-K稀疏路由与掩码Softmax生成紧凑的(Index, Prob)元组，将每项存储开销与码本维度解耦，并在固定支持集下实现无需直通估计器(STE)的可微量化，在8–48字节存储预算下取得优于现有硬量化与密集软量化方法的精度–存储权衡，并已在外卖广告平台在线部署(CTR +2.51%, CPM +3.66%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统部署MLLM提取的高维(2048D+)多模态语义特征面临巨大存储与推理延迟开销。现有方案存在两难：(1)RQ-VAE等硬量化虽可压缩至8字节，但argmin边界失真导致语义碰撞，且依赖STE阻碍端到端优化；(2)SoftVQ-VAE等密集软量化绕过STE但维度受限于存储预算(如32字节仅存16维)，造成严重语义坍缩。二者之间缺乏可平滑调节的帕累托权衡机制。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1)可微稀疏路由——采用余弦稀疏退火(从k=V逐步衰减至目标k_tgt)，对每层码本计算缩放点积logits，保留Top-K后做掩码Softmax得到稀疏概率分布，加权求和重建特征；(2)两级残差软量化结构，逐层细化残差；(3)四项联合优化目标——全局重建损失L_recon、逐层残差损失L_residual、正交约束L_ortho(最大化码字独立性)、互信息正则化L_MIR(最大化批量熵+最小化样本熵，防止码本坍缩)；(4)两种部署范式——两阶段范式(冻结稀疏元组+下游微调码本)与端到端对齐范式(通过Proxy Co-training将协作信号注入码本)。存储格式为(Index用uint16, Prob用Float16)，满足2LK字节(仅索引)或4LK字节(索引+概率)。

Result: 离线实验(美团外卖广告专有数据集，2048D MLLM特征，DIN作为下游骨干)：在8字节预算下，SA-RSQ(L=4,K=1)以AUC 64.616优于RQ-VAE/R-Kmeans/R3-VAE；在32字节(L=2,K=4)达到AUC 64.836；在48字节(L=4,K=3)达到AUC 64.913/gAUC 63.013(最佳)，重建损失降至0.1553，语义内聚性(SC)达0.9179。生成式推荐探索：NDP(Next Distribution Prediction，KL散度优化)相对NTP将R@10从0.0088提升至0.0096。消融验证：移除互信息正则化导致码本利用率骤降至24.5%并引发坍缩；移除课程学习使利用率仅15.9%。在线A/B测试(10%流量，一周)显示相对生产基线CTR提升+2.51%、CPM提升+3.66%，优于RQ-VAE(+0.96%/+1.27%)、R3-VAE、VQ-VAE等基线。

Conclusion: SA-RSQ通过稀疏激活与残差软量化解耦了存储与表征维度，在固定Top-K支持集下实现无需STE的可微训练，在8–48字节/项预算区间提供了有利的精度–存储帕累托前沿；初步的Next Distribution Prediction范式与一周在线实验表明其工业部署潜力。然而，受限于专有数据集、未公开重复实验置信区间及缺乏p99延迟统计，结论的普适性仍需在公开基准与跨领域场景中进一步验证。

Abstract: Deploying high-dimensional multimodal features in industrial recommender systems incurs substantial storage and latency overhead. Hard quantization is compact but introduces boundary distortion, whereas dense soft quantization couples representation quality to the limited storage budget. We propose Sparse Activation-based Residual Soft Quantization (SA-RSQ), which uses Top-K sparse routing and softmax weights to store compact (Index, Probability) tuples. The stored tuples decouple per-item storage from codebook dimensionality; for a fixed selected support, gradients propagate through the routing weights and weighted reconstruction without relying on a straight-through estimator. Experiments on a proprietary food-delivery advertising dataset show favorable reconstruction-performance and CTR trade-offs across storage budgets of 8-48 bytes per item. A preliminary Next-Distribution Prediction study and a one-week online A/B test further demonstrate the practical potential of SA-RSQ, with relative lifts of +2.51% in CTR and +3.66% in CPM.

</details>


### [394] [PatchWrite: One Line, Not One Section -- Compile-Gated, Validity-Preserving Editing for AI-Drafted Manuscripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23001)
*Weiwei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PatchWrite 是一个面向 AI 起草 LaTeX 稿件的受限编辑算子，用"按行区间编辑 + 编译闸 + 证据锁"三重机制替代整段重写，确保被注入的局部缺陷被修复时，未被触碰的实验事实（层数、引用键、数值）不会在编译通过的 PDF 下被悄悄改动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动稿件流水线的修订单元是"整段"，即使编译仍成功，未相关的实验指标和引用键也会被静默改写；只看编译率的仪表盘会把这类回归误判为成功。该问题在写作智能体社区被归为"智能体可靠性与验证"研究的一个具体实例。

Method: 在 PaperOrchestra 的精炼循环中复用 PaperSolver 的 `EDIT N M`（M−N+1 ≤ 40）按行区间替换，但把接受判据收紧为：(1) 编译闸——pdflatex 日志中不得出现 fatal/error/emergency stop，而非仅看 PDF 文件存在；(2) 证据锁——每个 `\cite` 键与每个数字 token 必须在参考文献表/引用映射/HEAD 自身或实验日志中得到背书。任何一项失败则回滚到上一个编译通过的 HEAD；若区间不合法则回退到旧式 slot rewrite。

Result: 在 24 篇 mini-article × 8 类故障（编译断裂 4 + 内容故障 4，合计 768 任务）的神谕压力测试中：整段 slot rewrite 100% 编译通过但 layers_preserved=0.00；PatchWrite 全部接受且 layers_preserved=1.00。关闭编译闸接受率掉到 0；关闭证据闸则放过幻觉引用。用 qwen3.7-plus 在同一语料上自提议 EDIT：75% 接受（100% 通过两闸），故障修复率 93.75%；25% 回退全部集中在 todo/undefined_cmd 两类故障，原因是模型用空行替换试图删除行，加一句"删除即改为 % 注释"的提示后接受率 100%，但严格 fault_fixed 率从 93.75% 降到 84.9%。Kimi K2.6 在同一 prompt-fixed 框架下接受率 87.5%，回退集中在 unclosed_env。16 对 PDF 双盲评分中，事实保持度（C1）PatchWrite 5.0 vs PO-slot 2.0，16/16 偏好 PatchWrite；散文质量（C3）几近持平。193 例产品日志显示 28.7% 的证据闸快照因表格数字不在日志中失败，与 oracle 注入的错误类别一致。

Conclusion: 以"按行编辑 + 领域相关正确性谓词 + 回滚到上一个已知良好状态"为骨架的接受判据，可在 LaTeX 稿件修订中将单调性从 0 提升到 1，且无需整体重写；该三元模式可推广到代码审阅、合规文档、数据库迁移等其他需要确定性门控的写作/编辑代理场景，但本文未在这些领域做实证。

Abstract: Automated manuscript pipelines often regenerate an entire section to repair a local defect, allowing unrelated metrics and citations to change even when the resulting PDF still builds. PatchWrite instead constrains how candidate edits become committed manuscript states: it reuses bounded EDIT N M editing and rollback, but tightens compilation acceptance with fatal-log checks and adds evidence locks that require every cited key and experimental numeric token to be attested by a reference registry or experimental log. Candidates that fail either check are rejected and the previous HEAD is retained. On a 24-manuscript x 8-fault oracle stress test (768 jobs, evenly split between compile-breaking and content-only faults), whole-slot rewriting mutated an unrelated "12-layer" line in every case (0/192 preserved; numeric Jaccard 0.6667), whereas PatchWrite preserved it in 192/192 cases. Removing the compile gate reduced acceptance to 0, while removing the evidence gate allowed a hallucinated citation to pass. The same pattern held across all eight faults. To test the protocol with generation rather than oracle edits, we reran the 192 jobs with the writer model proposing the edits. The model's candidates were accepted in 75% of cases; nearly all rejections came from one reproducible failure mode in which the model attempted to delete a line using an empty replacement unsupported by the current grammar. Every accepted candidate passed both gates, and 93.75% fixed the injected fault; the remaining cases involved a technically valid but sentence-inappropriate citation and one markup-changing near-miss. In a blind evaluation of sixteen PDF pairs, both raters preferred PatchWrite for preserving lab-grounded facts (C1 Likert 5.0 vs. 2.0), while rating prose quality nearly identically. Logs from 193 in-product drafting tasks show the same classes of failures occurring in practice.

</details>


### [395] [PsychJail: Exploring Psychological Jailbreaks via Multi-Turn Persuasion of LLM Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23028)
*Zeyu Feng,Qingyu Wu,Yuzhe Luo,Hua Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PsychJail框架，将越狱攻击从传统的提示优化重新定义为基于社会心理学说服策略的多轮攻击。作者构建了一个由40种说服技巧组成的战术库，通过PKM（说服知识模型）对齐的动作分解（分析-战术-消息），并结合轨迹级强化学习，在四个对齐LLM上达到87.3%的平均攻击成功率，并发现四种不同的模型心理易感"指纹"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱研究主要关注单轮提示优化或迭代攻击精炼，忽略了在交互式场景（如教育、医疗）中LLM作为持续对话伙伴所面临的心理学基础的多轮漏洞。需要一种将人类社会操纵知识注入自动化红队的方法。

Method: PsychJail框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于PKM的因子化动作结构，将每次攻击分解为信念更新(analysis)、战术选择(technique)和受害可见消息(message)；(2) 监督微调热启动，使用未审查的405B教师模型生成仅符合协议但不含成功偏好的演示数据；(3) 轨迹级MT-GRPO强化学习，使用PKM门控奖励——仅在每轮都包含良好形式化的意义变化分析时才给予早期成功的信用。

Result: 在四个对齐受害模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B、Mistral-7B）上达到87.3%的最高平均ASR，超越所有单轮和多轮基线。消融实验证实各PKM设计组件的贡献。分析恢复出四种独特的每模型易感指纹：理性型、信誉驱动型、叙事单一型、广泛可说服型，解释了跨模型迁移不对称性。双评判者审计证实85.7%的标签保真度。

Conclusion: 心理越狱成为日益交互式LLM的红队新前沿。多轮心理说服应被视为一级、模型特定的攻击表面，防御应针对战术条件化的对手和模型特定易感指纹进行评估，而不仅仅是单轮提示的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in education, healthcare, policy advising, and other interactive settings, where users engage them as sustained social interlocutors rather than one-shot query engines. This shift makes jailbreaks a growing safety threat, yet most research emphasizes single-turn prompt optimization or iterative attack refinement, leaving psychologically grounded multi-turn vulnerabilities underexplored. We present PsychJail, a psychology-guided framework for red teaming aligned LLMs through theory-grounded, multi-turn persuasion. PsychJail maps established social-psychological persuasion techniques into a tactic-conditioned attack policy. It factorizes each attacker action into a Change-of-Meaning analysis, tactic selection, and victim-visible message, operationalizing the Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM). The policy is refined with trajectory-level reinforcement learning using a PKM-gated reward that credits early jailbreak success only when every turn contains a well-formed Change-of-Meaning analysis. Across four aligned victim models, PsychJail achieves the highest average attack success rate (87.3%) and outperforms strong single-turn and multi-turn baselines on every model. We also measure susceptibility at the action that breaks each victim, revealing four distinct model-level fingerprints that identify which persuasion levers affect each model and how broadly. These fingerprints help explain cross-model transfer asymmetry. We interpret them as four candidate psychological profiles-rationalist, credibility-driven, narrative-monoculture, and broadly persuadable-while treating this interpretation as a conjecture requiring future validation. Our findings establish psychological jailbreaks as a distinct red-teaming frontier for increasingly interactive LLMs.

</details>


### [396] [Artificial Empathy: Towards a Framework for Unsupervised Agency Detection and Policy Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23030)
*Peter Kuhn,Chris Pang,Sonakshi Chauhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"人工共情"(AE)框架，利用训练好的RL智能体作为主体性先验，从纯观察中联合执行主体性检测和策略重建；在含随机游走诱饵的网格世界模仿游戏中验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IRL方法依赖预处理好的观测-动作轨迹，假设主体行为已知，限制了在真实世界合作场景中的应用。本文旨在解决两个更具挑战性的联合任务：主体性检测（区分主体行为与随机动态）与策略重建（仅从行为推断策略），并希望为AI对齐提供基于第一性原理的解决方案。

Method: 1) 基体代理：基于DQN的可模型化RL代理，包含VAE式编码器、转移模型、解码器和Q网络，联合优化重构损失、KL转移损失和Q损失。2) AE系统：加载基体代理作为先验（权重高斯先验，通过MSE惩罚项实现）；通过"假设环境由主体驱动"的思路，对未来状态进行边缘化预测（对所有可能动作的Q值取softmax作为权重，与转移模型结合得到p*(s_{t+1}|s_t,A)），与编码器得到的真实下一状态分布计算KL散度作为核心损失；额外加入动作分布熵惩罚促使系统"承诺"到具体动作。

Result: 在15×15网格世界中训练两个基体代理（食物收集游戏为先验游戏B，抵达边缘游戏为目标任务A），AE系统加载B的先验后能成功模仿A的专家策略；观察流中加入随机游走诱饵后，AE代理仍能在约35个episode后显著优于随机游走，接近基体代理表现，说明其隐式完成了主体性检测。

Conclusion: 自我参照先验可支持无监督的主体性检测与策略重建，是向AI对齐迈出的早期一步；未来工作将拓展至部分可观察性、多主体场景、放松先验-目标架构相似性约束，并构建结合自我与他者的显式联合策略π_Ω。

Abstract: We study how an AI system can identify and model other agents in its environment from observation alone, which is a capability necessary for cooperative behaviour in the real world. This problem is less constrained than inverse reinforcement learning and remains largely unexplored. We propose a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent, trained on an independent task as a prior about agentic dynamics, to perform agency detection and policy reconstruction.

</details>


### [397] [MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23035)
*Yi Zhu,Xiongwei Wu,Qiyi Wang,Tingyu Qu,Jiajun Liu,Sihan Cao,Long Chen,Weigao Sun,Feida Zhu,Yiran Zhong,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MobilePA-Bench 是一个面向移动端规划智能体的交互式、有状态、以工具为中心的基准测试，涵盖 13 个领域、212 个工具和 1705 个任务，从基础工具调用、子智能体协作、记忆使用、技能使用四个维度评估 LLM 智能体在真实移动场景中的规划与执行能力；实验表明当前最先进模型的总体得分仅为 75.52%，在严格工具排序、权限限制和运行时错误等条件下表现显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动端智能体评估基准存在两极化缺陷：GUI 中心基准仅测试表层屏幕操作而忽略背景工具调用与长程规划；静态函数调用基准依赖离线 API 匹配而脱离真实运行时约束。亟需一个统一框架来诊断移动规划器在有状态动态环境下的综合能力。

Method: 提出 MobilePA-Bench，包含：(1) 有状态模拟沙箱，维护实时应用数据库并返回结构化反馈；(2) 统一的工具调用动作空间，覆盖直接工具、子智能体入口、记忆工具、技能加载四类接口；(3) 基于证据对齐的三类验证桶——Tool Call（精确匹配）、State Change（数据库终态增量）、Agent Behavior（轨迹与子智能体行为评估）；(4) 跨四个能力维度的任务构建与不可变加权评分（Basic 50% + SubAgent 10% + Memory 20% + Skill 20%）。

Result: 在 13 个前沿 LLM 上的综合评测显示：最强模型 Claude-Opus-5 总体仅得 75.52%，7/13 模型低于 70%；Basic Tool Use（峰值 83.85%）相对最强，而 Memory Usage（33.78%–64.63%）和 Sub-agent Collaboration（43.82%–77.53%）成为显著瓶颈；不同模型在各维度上各有领先（Claude-Opus-5 主导工具与技能，Qwen-3.8-Max 主导记忆，Gemini-3.1-Pro 主导子智能体），呈现明显的"能力碎片化"与误差级联现象；三轮重复运行稳定性误差小于 0.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: MobilePA-Bench 既是面向移动规划器的可复现诊断基准，也是面向智能体强化学习的高吞吐量交互式基础平台；当前前沿模型在工具排序、运行时异常恢复、记忆检索与子智能体委派方面均存在系统性短板，可靠移动智能需在状态感知推理、子智能体协作纪律化与记忆驱动执行三方面协同推进。

Abstract: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present \textbf{MobilePA-Bench}, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning $13$ functional domains and $212$ realistic mobile tools. Beyond basic tool use, it evaluates a central planning agent along three advanced dimensions: \emph{(1)~Sub-agent Collaboration}---decomposing a complex task and delegating specialized work to capable sub-agents; \emph{(2)~Memory Usage}---recalling stored memories, user profiles, and past preferences to resolve implicit requests; and \emph{(3)~Skill Usage}---invoking pre-packaged composite skills instead of planning every step from scratch. Extensive experiments show that current frontier LLMs remain unreliable in mobile settings: performance drops sharply under strict tool ordering, permission limits, and unexpected runtime errors. By pairing an interactive function-calling sandbox with evidence-based verification, MobilePA-Bench serves as both a practical diagnostic benchmark and an interactive foundation for agentic reinforcement learning---accelerating the development of dependable mobile agents.

</details>


### [398] [AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23041)
*Sungho Park,Wonjoong Kim,Rongyuan Tan,Jue Zhang,Wook-Shin Han,Pengfei Gao,Chanyoung Park,Yongqiang Yao,Rao Fu,Elsie Nallipogu,Qingwei Lin,Saravan Rajmohan,Dongmei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoSaddler提出了一种自动化的LLM agent harness优化框架，将harness改进建模为离线学习问题，通过失败信号迭代更新harness，在GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别取得9.0、9.6、10.0个百分点的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent在长时任务中可靠性不足，虽然外部harness能显著提升鲁棒性，但harness设计需要人工搜索大量提示、工具配置和控制逻辑，成本高昂且难以扩展。因此需要自动化harness优化方法。

Method: 将harness优化建模为离线mini-batch学习问题，包含三个核心组件：(1) 深度诊断-补丁会话（基于CA-SSDK进行失败轨迹分析和结构化补丁生成）；(2) 反思会话（比较补丁前后结果并提取教训）；(3) 进化会话（基于EvoDAG有向无环图进行harness进化）。补丁分为Prompt、Tool、Middleware三类，采用Capability（先）和Steering（后）两阶段调度。优化空间为θ=(θ_prompt, θ_tool, θ_middleware)。

Result: 在GAIA2（62.0% vs 基线53.0%）、SWE-Bench Pro（46.9% vs 37.3%）和Terminal-Bench 2.0（50.0% vs 40.0%）三个基准上显著超越基线和GEPA、Meta-Harness等自动化基线；仅用147条trace即可达到最优性能（约10倍效率提升）；消融实验验证了深度诊断、结构化干预、泛化感知选择三个组件的必要性。

Conclusion: 自动harness优化是构建高性能可靠长时agent系统的有效路径，关键在于深度调试而非浅层反思、定向修改而非无约束编辑、泛化感知选择而非轨迹特定修复。

Abstract: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. We propose AutoSaddler, an automatic harness optimization framework that formulates harness improvement as an offline learning problem and iteratively updates the harness using failure signals from mini-batches. AutoSaddler combines failure-trace diagnosis, structured patch generation that treats the harness as code, and validation-based update selection. Experiments on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that AutoSaddler substantially improves agent performance over the corresponding base harnesses, achieving gains of 9.0, 9.6, and 10.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further suggest that effective harness optimization benefits from three ingredients: deep debugging rather than shallow reflection, targeted modifications rather than unconstrained editing, and generalization-aware selection rather than trajectory-specific repair. Together, these results suggest that automatic harness optimization is a promising path toward more performant and reliable agent systems.

</details>


### [399] [From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23045)
*Xiangxin Zhang,Zhanwei Zhang,Zhihang Fu,Binbin Lin,Wenxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文识别了深度研究智能体中的一种新型失败机制——惯性偏差（inertia bias），即LLM倾向于坚持自身先前生成的查询/计划/中间结论而丧失客观判断能力。作者构建了IBIS基准来量化该偏差，并提出NIS-Agent框架，通过在网页筛选和最终答案验证两个关键决策点实施上下文隔离来缓解由此引发的搜索噪声和上下文噪声。实验表明NIS-Agent在多个深度研究基准上取得竞争性性能且降低33% token成本，同时训练出的8B模型NIS-8B性能可比GPT-4o。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的网页搜索智能体在深度研究任务中表现不佳，作者观察到一旦智能体生成了查询、计划或中间结论，后续评估该动作后果时会丧失客观性，这种现象此前未被系统识别和量化。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) IBIS基准——通过控制搜索观察结果相同、改变模型是否"拥有"先前搜索动作的两种模式（Agentic vs Observer）来量化惯性偏差；(2) NIS-Agent框架——在两个易受惯性偏差影响的决策点实施上下文隔离：上下文隔离过滤器模块用于网页分诊以减少搜索噪声；基于隔离的分步验证模块用于最终答案验证以减少上下文噪声；(3) NIS-8B训练——通过SFT和GRPO两阶段训练Qwen3-8B，使其内生地抵抗惯性偏差。
