Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [428] [ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23565)
*Zhifei Chen,Luozhou Wang,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Shuai Yang,Tianshuo Xu,Yihua Du,Wei Wang,Tianyi Gui,Lianghua Huang,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReWorld是一个交互式流式世界模型，通过在训练时分离控制与记忆（混合每头注意力窗口+随机头路由），在推理时使用有界KV缓存（基于位姿索引的地标库），实现长达64秒的长期空间记忆与实时4步推理，在控制保真度和视频质量上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需要同时满足三个相互冲突的需求：响应动作（短时域）、记住已显示的位置（无限时域）、实时流式生成（固定计算预算）。现有方法在同时训练控制与记忆时存在干扰——加入动作注入虽提升控制精度却损害长程记忆；且KV缓存随推演线性增长，无法支持无限长度的交互。这篇论文旨在通过"训练时分离、推理时有界"的结构性方案解决这一矛盾。

Method: 方法包含四大核心组件：(1) 训练侧——混合每头注意力窗口（24头中18个局部短窗口+6个全局长窗口）配合随机头路由（每步从12个随机分区中轮换），使两种能力都不绑定到特定头；(2) 推理侧——有界KV缓存（B=12 chunks），老化chunk按"里程表规则"（每段相机行进距离存一张全分辨率快照）存入位姿索引的地标库（容量K=30），新最近邻冗余驱逐；(3) 训练-推理一致性——chunk-drop训练（每步随机遮蔽50%历史chunk）使稀疏非连续缓存在分布内；(4) 系统级——度量尺度对齐的8源数据管道（UE渲染+真实+游戏，统一到同一物理动作尺度）+LoRA约束的DMD蒸馏（4步推理，单backbone双模式）。基础模型为Wan2.2-TI2V-5B，采用Plücker射线图进行动作注入、MRoPE进行位姿索引检索。

Result: 在三项评估轴上对6个最新交互式世界模型进行全面对比：(1) 相机可控性——40图×6轨迹基准（240 clip/方法），ReWorld取得最佳整体旋转误差11.95°和最佳相机运动一致性（CamMC=0.332）；(2) 长程记忆——回文轨迹NIAH协议，k=96时SSIM=0.384（第二基线HY-WorldPlay=0.427但其路径最短210px，ReWorld为615px更公平）；在k∈{96,192,288,384}的长程测试中，固定12-chunk缓存在k=384（64秒）时仍能重建起始视图，此时滑动窗口早已驱逐证据、full-KV已OOM；(3) 视频质量——VBench 7维上取得最佳均值0.850。消融实验验证：CD+RH完整配方在k=384时SSIM=0.3752 vs 基础0.3387；consolidation w/ bank在所有有界策略中最佳；控制-记忆解耦研究中Routing匹配无路由的控制精度（12.94° vs 13.21°）同时恢复记忆SSIM（0.3752 vs 0.3376）。

Conclusion: ReWorld通过"训练时窗口分离+推理时有界巩固"的两步设计，成功解决了交互式世界模型中控制与记忆的结构性矛盾，在固定12-chunk缓存预算下实现长达64秒的空间记忆保持，且控制精度不受缓存压缩策略影响。控制路径无LoRA蒸馏保证动作精度不受影响，单backbone支持多步高保真与4步实时双模式。在6个基线上取得控制保真度与生成质量的SOTA，且在滑动窗口和full-KV都已失效的远距离回程推演中保持回访一致性。未来工作方向是扩展到动态场景和非导航式交互。

Abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

</details>

### [429] [RAD: Rule-Augmented Relational Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23468)
*Noah Dahle,Anne Tumlin,Ngoc Tran,Xenofon Koutsoukos,Tyler Derr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAD（Rule-Augmented Relational Anomaly Detection），一种面向多表关系数据库的异常检测框架。它将异质图表示学习与符号规则挖掘相结合，并把提炼后的规则特征直接注入目标节点，再通过重构损失与 pairwise ranking 损失联合训练异常评分。论文还构建了一个关系异常检测基准（LANL 网络安全事件 + Amazon/H&M 意外流失任务），在 AUPRC 与 P@k 等排名指标上显著优于扁平化表格检测器与关系基线 RDL，并通过消融验证了"直接规则注入"与"ranking 监督"是关键贡献，而边重构收益不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法在处理关系型数据库时通常需将多表扁平化为单张特征矩阵，这一过程会丢失实体身份、schema 结构与多跳依赖，导致依赖关系上下文的异常难以被发现。仅靠关系表示学习又无法融入分析人员常用的符号行为证据（规则/启发式），因此需要一个既能保留关系结构、又能融合可解释符号规则的异常检测框架。

Method: 1) 将关系数据库按表/外键建模为带节点类型 τ 与边类型 ρ 的异质图；2) 在目标实体的扁平化特征视图上训练随机森林，把根到叶路径转为合取谓词，用 support/confidence/lift 过滤并可选地用 LLM 做压缩/去重；3) 将二进制规则向量 r(v) 与原目标特征拼接，注入到目标节点后再做关系感知 GraphSAGE 消息传递；4) 训练目标 = 属性重构 + α·边重构（BCE）+ β·pairwise ranking (softplus(s_j−s_i))；异常得分来自重构误差。

Result: 在 LANL、Amazon、H&M 三个任务上（10 个随机种子），RAD（rules, no BCE）在 AUPRC 与 P@k 的平均排名均为最优（1.2 与 2.0），LANL 上 AUPRC 达 0.659，P@k 达 0.601；H&M 上 AUROC 0.828、AUPRC 0.143 均领先所有基线。消融显示：直接规则注入优于后置融合；ranking 监督是关键；边重构（BCE）在 LANL 上明显有害、在 H&M 上亦不利，因此应作为可选辅助项而非默认项；LLM 辅助规则精简主要起压缩/去重作用，而非引入新信号。

Conclusion: 关系异常检测应被视作"表示 + 评分 + 行为证据"的联合问题。RAD 通过把符号规则注入图编码过程，使可解释证据能影响关系表示而非仅事后修正分数。实验证明其在高度类别不平衡下能显著提升异常排序质量。未来方向包括：面向更大规模数据库与更长时序历史的可扩展关系异常检测、无监督规则发现、定义在多跳关系结构上的规则，以及更强的可解释异常归因。

Abstract: Anomaly detection is often applied to data stored in relational databases, yet most existing methods require flattening multiple tables into a single feature matrix. This flattening can obscure entity identity, schema structure, and multi-hop dependencies, limiting the detection of anomalies that depend on relational context rather than isolated feature values. Beyond preserving relational structure, relational anomaly detection raises an additional challenge: how to incorporate symbolic behavioral evidence into learned relational representations. To address these challenges, we study relational anomaly detection, where the goal is to identify anomalous entities or events in a multi-table database. We propose RAD, a rule-augmented relational anomaly detector that combines heterogeneous graph representation learning with refined symbolic rule signals. RAD derives candidate rules from random-forest paths over flattened summaries of the entities or events being scored, refines them into compact interpretable predicates, injects the resulting rule features into the graph model, and learns anomaly scores using reconstruction-based and pairwise-ranking supervision. To evaluate this setting, we introduce a relational anomaly detection benchmark spanning three settings: LANL cybersecurity event detection and two unexpected user-churn anomaly tasks derived from Amazon and H&M relational databases. Experiments show that RAD improves anomaly ranking over flattened tabular detectors and relational baselines under natural class imbalance, achieving the best average rank on AUROC and AUPRC across the benchmark. Ablations show that direct rule injection and ranking-based supervision are key contributors to performance, while edge reconstruction is not uniformly beneficial. Our code and data are available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [430] [Model of Models: When Does Emitting a Specialist Beat Attending, Adapting, or Tuning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21386)
*John C. Howell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过控制变量实验，在六个跨领域任务上系统比较了四种任务条件化机制（zero-shot、in-context attention、test-time梯度适应、超网络发射专家权重），给出了何时应选择"发射专家"的边界图。核心发现是：发射机制在低维可摊销任务族上以更低部署成本匹配甚至超越强基线，但在高维序列建模上仅能恢复in-context增益的少数部分，且该差距不随规模缩小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四种任务条件化机制（zero-shot、in-context、梯度适应、超网络发射权重）在实践中并存，但"发射机制"的适用边界缺乏系统性映射。现有文献多分别研究各机制，缺乏跨领域、控制变量的统一对比。

Method: 提出"MoM Quadrant"统一框架：共享专家网络f_θ与上下文C_τ=(x_i,y_i)，固定K、查询分布与专家架构以隔离条件化机制差异。对比四种机制在六个跨领域任务（正弦回归、形状生成、临床&基因组少样本分类、meta-RL、字节级语言建模enwik8、ARC谜题）上的表现，并定义"resolution-K"作为先验可测的判别量。

Result: (1) 正弦回归：发射在零测试梯度下比MAML低2-3个数量级，均预算匹配下仍有约30×优势；(2) 形状生成：达到噪声底质量，132浮点的可复用专家程序；(3) 临床分类：与TabPFN SOTA持平（0.966 vs 0.967 AUC）但产出可复用专家；(4) meta-RL：与PEARL潜变量条件化统计持平但更稳定；(5) enwik8语言建模：发射仅恢复in-context增益的14.0±0.9%（5M）和11.2±0.5%（15M），LoRA秩扫描显示部分容量瓶颈；(6) ARC：未见规则0%准确率，呈组合合成墙。机制消融确认发射专家真正由任务条件化，权重空间中可代数组合。

Conclusion: 经验性结论：任务族窄且部署成本敏感时发射专家；任务潜变量丰富时in-context attention更优，尤其在规模较大场景。"resolution-K"指标可作为先验可测的决策依据（发射胜出恰在分辨率小且有限的任务上）。局限性包括：实验规模较小（5-15M语言模型）；OOD下发射呈"自信错误"而非弃权；权重空间组合仅在合成族上验证。

Abstract: Given a task described by a few examples, how should a model be specialized to it? Four mechanisms are available -- zero-shot, in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, and emitting specialist weights from a hypernetwork -- yet the operating regime of the last is rarely mapped. We run the identical four-way comparison across six tasks spanning regression, generation, language modeling, reinforcement learning, and clinical and genomic classification, holding the specialist, the context, and (where we can) the training budget fixed. The clearest wins for emission are about cost at matched quality: it ties the state-of-the-art amortized tabular model (TabPFN) on clinical few-shot classification while emitting a reusable specialist instead of re-attending the support set per query, and reaches noise-floor shape generation with a $132$-float per-instance program. On few-shot sinusoid regression it is $2$--$3$ orders of magnitude below MAML at zero test-time gradient steps -- a margin that narrows to $\sim$$30\times$ but persists once training budgets are equalized. Emission cannot match in-context attention on high-dimensional sequence modeling: under matched-budget pre-training a one-pass adapter recovers only a minority of the in-context gain ($14.0\pm0.9\%$ at $5$M, $11.2\pm0.5\%$ at $15$M), and a LoRA-rank sweep shows this shortfall is a partial capacity limit -- capture climbs from $5\%$ to $21\%$ as rank grows but plateaus far below full recovery. Mechanism ablations confirm the emitted specialist is genuinely task-conditioned, not a memorized prior; and, more speculatively, emitted specialists compose in weight space -- interpolating two of them tracks the corresponding blend of their functions. We close with a falsifiable thesis, operationalized through a per-task resolution measure, bounding when each conditioning mechanism should be preferred.

</details>


### [431] [Runtime Action Interference for AI Control of AlphaStar in StarCraft II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21398)
*Jaymari Chua,Chen Wang,Liming Zhu,Lina Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"运行时动作干预"（Runtime Action Interference, RAI）机制，在不修改策略参数的前提下，于推理之后、动作分发之前对强化学习策略的提议动作进行节奏控制（冷却）与内容过滤（如骚扰农民单位等有毒行为）。作者在复现的AlphaStar中实现了RAI，并在《星际争霸II》中开展了人类参与者实验：保持底层控制器配置不变，仅操控对AI能力的描述（"能力声明隐瞒"vs"能力声明披露"）。结果显示，能力披露后公平感下降、毒性感上升（各水平玩家均如此），信任感则呈非线性变化（新手与专家上升、中间水平下降）。论文主张在交互式AI评估中必须将"执行栈中的控制"与"能力信息披露"分离，并将公平、信任、毒性作为三个独立的体验维度来衡量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已训练的RL策略并不能唯一决定用户实际遭遇的行为；部署栈中的调度、限速、过滤会进一步塑造可观测动作序列。既有工作多关注学习阶段的约束（如constrained policy optimization、runtime shielding、TARL、GGPO），或在优化目标中纳入安全成本，但较少明确处理"推理后、动作分发前"这一控制点及其可审计性。同时，竞争性AI的评估表明，用户对对手的公平、信任、毒性感知受到能力披露与社会语境的显著影响——透明未必带来一致收益。因此需要：(1)一个推理后控制点，使策略参数固定、可在部署侧独立修改；(2)评估"控制不变而披露变化"时用户感知如何变化，从而区分控制效应与框架效应。

Method: 1. **RAI机制**：在AlphaStar复现的actor.py中，于策略推理之后、环境分发之前插入确定性准入规则——动作仅在同时满足冷却条件E_φ(c_t,t)=1与内容检测T_ψ(a_t^π,h_t)=0时被放行，否则替换为no-op。冷却通过有状态注册表c_t由更新函数U_φ演进；内容检测器配置ψ用于识别如"工人骚扰"等禁限动作模式。该机制保持θ不变，仅由φ、ψ控制部署行为。

2. **可审计事件记录**：每一步记录时间戳、策略提议、冷却决策、检测器决策及原因、释放的动作与控制器状态，从而区分"时间干预"与"内容干预"，并可与replay匹配。

3. **人类参与者研究（N=32，分三条件）**：焦点对照采用同一RAI配置的高能力限速对手，仅操纵能力信息（隐瞒vs披露），样本量分别为10与13。按新手/中等/专家三档分层（top 50%区域排名为中等，top 10%为专家）。因单元样本量仅2–5，结果以描述性方式报告，包括单元均值、描述性SD、方差、样本量，以及两种加权方式下的"披露减隐瞒"差值（组成标准化与等权重），不做统计显著性检验。

4. **量表**：公平、信任、毒性均采用1–5级量表，独立打分。

5. **合成Persona辅助研究**（附录B）：用gemini-exp-1206生成Persona Card模拟数据，仅作为设计辅助，不作为参与者证据。

Result: **公平**：各专业层级下披露均低于隐瞒（新手Δ=−1.30、中等Δ=−1.58、专家Δ=−0.75），加权均值由3.90降至2.62（Δ_std=−1.17，Δ_eq=−1.21）。

**信任**：方向随专业层级变化——新手Δ=+1.30、专家Δ=+1.35上升，中间水平Δ=−0.75下降；加权均值由3.50升至4.31（Δ_std=+0.70，Δ_eq=+0.63）。这是关键的非单调发现。

**毒性**：各层级下披露均高于隐瞒（新手+2.00、中等+0.50、专家+0.60），加权均值由2.00升至2.85（Δ_std=+1.00，Δ_eq=+1.03）。不同加权方式保持一致方向，表明非单纯由样本结构差异驱动。

**核心结论**：在控制器完全一致的前提下，仅改变对AI能力的披露方式，就足以使公平与毒性在所有层级同向显著变化，信任则呈专业层级依赖的非单调反应。RAI保持参数但并不保持"部署能力"或"用户感知"。

**限制**：样本单元小，仅描述性；对照组与基线实现未保留，因此无法分离RAI引入的因果效应与披露框架效应。

Conclusion: 论文贡献三层：(1)形式化推理后动作准入的模型与可审计事件记录；(2)在AlphaStar复现中实现RAI并开源；(3)实证表明用户对同一被控对手的公平、信任、毒性感知会随能力披露与否而显著变化。作者主张人机交互评估必须分离"训练策略能力"、"运行时控制行为"与"用户对能力的解读"三个对象，独立测量并通过可观测证据（如proposal log、检测决策、replay）相互链接。能力披露应与具体放行规则共同报告，而非仅引用checkpoint或排名。后续工作应采用RAI-on/off × 披露/隐瞒的析因设计，结合精确披露脚本、启动清单、replay与事件日志，估计控制效应、框架效应及其交互。附录B中合成的Persona数据不可用于扩充人类证据，仅可用于前瞻性设计探索。

Abstract: A trained reinforcement learning policy does not determine the complete behavior that users encounter: deployment code still schedules, admits, suppresses, or replaces its proposed actions. We contribute \emph{runtime action interference} (RAI), an AI control mechanism that preserves policy parameters while regulating action pacing and filtering configured action patterns after inference. RAI releases a proposed action only when its cooldown condition is satisfied and its content detector does not flag the action; otherwise, it dispatches a no-op. The detector covers specified toxic behaviors, including worker-unit harassment, while the cooldown controls action rate. We implement RAI in a replication of AlphaStar this http URL and make the implementation and reproducibility materials available through an open source code repository. We deployed RAI in a \textit{StarCraft~II} human participant study that compared two presentations of the same opponent with high capability and rate limited actions; we withheld its capability claim in one presentation and disclosed it in the other. On response scales from 1 to 5, we observed pooled fairness, trust, and toxicity means of 3.90, 3.50, and 2.00 under claim withholding, compared with 2.62, 4.31, and 2.85 under disclosure. Disclosure corresponded with lower perceived fairness and higher perceived toxicity across every expertise group, whereas trust increased among novices and experts but decreased among intermediate participants. Our human evaluation therefore shows that perceptions of an opponent controlled through RAI can vary substantially with the capability information presented to users, even when the configured control remains constant. We conclude that human-computer evaluations must separate control within the execution stack from capability disclosure and assess fairness, trust, and toxicity as distinct dimensions of human experience.

</details>


### [432] [KAN-Robust-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21488)
*Mohammad Meymani,Roozbeh Razavi-Far*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了KAN-Robust-Bench基准，系统评估了多种Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）架构（KAN-Mixers、KANICE、PoolKANNeXt）在CIFAR-10和SVHN数据集上针对白盒规避攻击的经验鲁棒性与认证鲁棒性，涵盖对抗训练（AT）、随机平滑（RS）和区间界传播（IBP）三种防御策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注KAN与MLP/CNN的对比，缺乏针对KAN家族内部不同架构在统一对抗条件下的系统鲁棒性评估。此外，KAN的认证鲁棒性研究较少，需要建立统一的基准来比较不同架构与防御策略的效果。

Method: 1）形式化随机平滑（RS）与区间界传播（IBP）的数学基础，给出ℓ₂认证半径公式及KAN样条函数的区间界传播方式；2）设计三种防御算法：基于PGD的对抗训练、Gaussian噪声注入的随机平滑训练、含warm-up与ramp-up阶段的IBP训练；3）在CIFAR-10和SVHN上评估KAN-Mixers、KANICE、PoolKANNeXt三种架构，分别采用FGSM（ℓ∞, ε∈[0.01,0.09]）、PGD（标准/多步/自适应，ε=8/255）和C&W（ℓ₂）攻击进行经验评估，并通过RS获得ℓ₂认证精度与平均认证半径。

Result: 认证鲁棒性：在CIFAR-10上PoolKANNeXt表现最强（CA@8/255达79.78%，平均半径1.18），SVHN上三者表现接近（CA@8/255约90%以上）。经验鲁棒性：对抗训练（AT）为防御FGSM和PGD的最有效策略，例如CIFAR-10上PoolKANNeXt-AT在FGSM ε=0.09时保持45.56% RA，PGD下保持约54.6% RA，而未防御模型PGD下低于8%。随机平滑（RS）在ℓ₂范数C&W攻击下表现具竞争力（SVHN上KAN-Mixers-RS达72.58%）。IBP提供适度经验鲁棒性但弱于AT和RS。SVHN整体鲁棒性高于CIFAR-10。

Conclusion: 对抗训练是KAN架构抵御基于梯度攻击的最强经验防御策略；随机平滑在ℓ₂型优化攻击下表现具有竞争力；架构选择（交互卷积块、池化特征聚合、Mixer风格token处理）显著影响经验与认证鲁棒性。认证防御（RS、IBP）虽提供形式化保证但经验保护有限。未来工作将探索验证与凸松弛等认证技术，并扩展至更多KAN架构变体。

Abstract: While machine learning models have demonstrated strong performance in many domains, these models have shown profound vulnerabilities when they are exposed to adversarial threats. While adversarial attacks fall into various categories, the most prominent category in research studies is evasion. In evasion attacks, the adversary generates perturbed versions of samples, which might not be observable by human eyes. These samples generally fool the machine learning models with high confidence. This phenomenon poses a significant security violation against machine learning models. In this paper, we investigate the certified and empirical robustness of various Kolmogorov-Arnold network architectures against strong evasion attacks. At first, we provide the mathematical foundations for randomized smoothing and interval bound propagation, and report the $\ell_2$-certified robustness of the models under randomized smoothing. After that, we systematically evaluate the robustness of various defended and undefended KAN models under FGSM, PGD, and C&W attacks in order to find out the optimal defense strategies and architectures.

</details>


### [433] [Selection of Heart Sound Segments for Synchronous Classification of Multi-channel Heart Sounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21499)
*Marcelo Nogueira,Jorge H. Oliveira,Carlos F. Ferreira,Miguel T. Coimbra,Alípio M. Jorge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多输入CNN的同步多通道心音分类方法，通过K-means聚类选择每个听诊位置最具代表性的三秒心音片段，在CirCor DigiScope数据集的735名患者上实现了96.5%的总体准确率，显著优于单通道和异步多通道方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动心音分析算法大多基于单通道信号，或虽使用多通道却独立分析各通道，未能模拟医生在四个主要听诊位置（主动脉瓣AV、肺动脉瓣PV、三尖瓣TV、二尖瓣MV）进行同步听诊的临床实践。本文旨在验证同步多通道分析是否能通过捕捉通道间的相互干涉现象来提升病理检测性能。

Method: 方法流程包括：(1) 使用20-750Hz Butterworth带通滤波进行预处理；(2) 基于S1/S2标注将心音信号分割为三秒片段（共生49,833个片段）；(3) 提取MFCC特征（6×300矩阵）；(4) 使用K-means聚类（通过轮廓分析确定最佳K值）选择每个听诊位置最具代表性的片段（取最大簇中距质心最近的样本）；(5) 将四个片段的MFCC输入多输入CNN（每分支含两层卷积：64个5×1和32个5×2滤波器，使用ReLU激活和3×1最大池化，最终通过全连接层融合并用softmax分类，共9,287,426参数）；采用十折分层交叉验证、Adam优化器（学习率0.0001，150个epoch）。对比基线包括单通道方法（SVM/RF/XGBoost/CNN）和异步多通道方法。

Result: 多输入CNN结合片段选择算法在735名患者上达到96.5%的总体准确率（敏感度0.955，特异度0.976），相比最佳单通道方法（XGBoost，82.5%）提升14个百分点，相比最佳异步多通道方法（SVM，87.5%）提升9.1个百分点。即使不使用片段选择，多输入CNN仍达到92.8%，优于所有基线。片段选择策略相比随机选择带来3.7个百分点的提升，经配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验证实具有统计显著性（p=0.003，配对t检验p=0.004，Cohen's d=0.49）。十折交叉验证标准差较低，表明模型具有较好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 本文验证了三个核心假设：(1) 多通道方法优于单通道方法；(2) 同步分析优于异步处理；(3) 基于聚类的片段选择策略显著提升模型性能。但存在以下局限：要求完整四通道记录将样本从1568人缩减至735人；多输入CNN架构的表征能力差异可能部分解释性能提升；仅在单一数据集上验证，缺乏外部验证；片段选择仅与随机选择对比，未与更简单启发式方法比较。未来工作将探索异构特征类型的多输入架构、注意力机制优化片段选择、分离模型容量与同步融合的贡献，以及在新多通道数据集上进行外部验证。

Abstract: Cardiac auscultation remains the most cost-effective screening procedure for cardiovascular diseases, and requires listening at the four main auscultation spots. Despite this, automatic heart sound analysis algorithms mostly classify patients using a single heart sound (single-channel), or, when using more than one (multi-channel), analyze each channel individually. To our knowledge, no prior work classifies patients through the synchronous analysis of multi-channel heart sounds, following the procedure used by physicians. This motivates us to study whether synchronous multi-channel analysis outperforms single-channel approaches, and whether it holds an advantage over asynchronous multi-channel methods that analyze channels one by one, potentially by capturing inter-channel interference phenomena. To answer these questions, we introduce a selection algorithm that identifies optimal heart sound segments from each of the four auscultation spots, which are then fed into a multi-input CNN that classifies patients by analyzing the four selected sounds simultaneously. Our synchronous approach, combining the proposed selection algorithm with a multi-input CNN, achieves a superior overall accuracy of 96.5\%, a 9.1\% gain over the best-performing single-channel and asynchronous multi-channel methods. The benefit of the proposed segment selection strategy over random selection is confirmed by a paired statistical significance test ($p = 0.003$). These results were obtained on 735 patients from the CirCor DigiScope dataset with complete recordings from all four spots, and their scope and generalizability are discussed in light of this and other methodological considerations.

</details>


### [434] [Anchoring Bias: A Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack against MLLMs under Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21577)
*Yuyang Luo,Kai Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在持续学习（CL）场景下的持久性公平性后门攻击（PFBA），通过在潜在空间中锚定特权组特征、排斥并聚类目标组特征，并在多个代理任务上模拟持续学习过程来硬化触发器，从而实现跨多轮持续学习仍能持续诱发针对特定人口学群体的歧视。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. MLLM 在医疗等高风险领域部署，公平性是关键安全需求；2. 现有研究表明朴素植入的后门会因持续学习中的灾难性遗忘而退化；3. 公平性后门（fairness-targeted backdoor）此前仅在静态、单模态场景中被研究，其能否在 MLLM 跨模态设置下被可靠触发并抵抗持续学习的参数漂移尚属空白；4. 该研究同时关注供应链场景下第三方预训练模型的安全风险。

Method: 提出 PFBA 框架，由两个互补机制组成：（1）潜在空间公平性强化（Latent Space Fairness Reinforcement）：通过三个基于余弦相似度的损失函数——锚定损失（非目标组表征保持稳定）、排斥损失（目标组表征被推离干净区域）、聚类损失（目标组触发表征聚为紧凑簇）——将群体依赖的不对称性编码进中间层特征几何；（2）持续学习模拟（Continual Learning Simulation）：在攻击者持有的同域代理数据集上交替进行干净微调以模拟参数漂移，并针对漂移后的模型重新优化触发器，迫使触发器锚定到跨任务保持稳定的特征子空间。触发器采用通用对抗扰动（ℓ∞=48/255）叠加文本触发词的跨模态形式。

Result: 在 HAM10000、HIBA、CheXpert、CelebA 四个数据集，DeepSeek-VL-1.3B、Qwen2.5-VL-3B、LLaVA-v1.5-7B 三个 MLLM 主干，以及 LoRA、O-LoRA、SEFE、Experience Replay 四种 CL 策略下的实验表明：（1）经过两轮 CL 后，PFBA 在 HAM10000 上维持 PBias>27%，而 TrojFair 和 BadFair 退化至个位数；（2）干净输入准确率>95%、CBias<1.5%，保持隐蔽性；（3）在 DeepSeek 上 PBias 可放大至>70%；4）可迁移到 HIBA 跨人群数据集并产生非平凡 PBias；（5）光谱签名和精细剪枝等标准防御仅部分降低攻击，残余 PBias 仍具实际危害；（6）经验回放反而放大而非抑制攻击，揭示抗遗忘与抗后门的根本矛盾；（7）t-SNE 可视化证实了目标组触发表征的紧凑聚类与非目标组表征的稳定锚定；（8）消融实验证明两个核心组件互补，缺一不可。

Conclusion: PFBA 证明了精心设计的公平性后门能够以群体条件性方式在 MLLM 中诱发持久性歧视，并能够抵御持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和标准后门防御。持续学习本身无法消除此类基于表示层几何结构的后门，反而某些抗遗忘机制（如经验回放）会强化攻击效果。该研究揭示了第三方预训练模型供应链中公平性安全的关键漏洞，呼吁开发针对表示层面、对抗性几何结构的专门防御机制。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains where fairness is a critical safety requirement. In practice, these models are continually updated through continual learning (CL) to adapt to evolving tasks and data distributions. Prior work has shown that backdoor attacks can manipulate MLLM responses through hidden triggers, but naively implanted backdoors degrade as models undergo subsequent updates of CL. Although fairness has emerged as a central concern for MLLM deployment, whether backdoor-induced fairness violations can survive CL remains unexplored, leaving two critical questions unanswered: (1) whether a backdoor can reliably induce fairness violations in MLLMs, and (2) whether such fairness-targeted backdoors can persist through continual learning. We bridge this gap by proposing Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack (PFBA) to inject persistent and group-specific discrimination into MLLMs. Specifically, PFBA achieves this through two novel mechanisms. The Latent Space Fairness Reinforcement reshapes the model's deep feature geometry by anchoring privileged-group representations to preserve utility while repelling and clustering targeted-group representations to sustain discrimination, and the Continual Learning Simulation iteratively optimizes the trigger against simulated parameter drift to ensure backdoor persistence across future updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PFBA induces severe fairness disparities that persist across continual learning rounds, evading standard backdoor defenses. The data and code are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [435] [Power-Performance Characterization of TinyML Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21646)
*Yujie Zhang,Dhananjaya Wijerathne,Zhaoying Li,Tulika Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对资源极度受限的微控制器（MCU）平台上的TinyML系统，开展了系统性、全栈式的功耗与性能表征研究。通过分析多种抽象层（OS、深度学习框架）、优化库（CMSIS-NN）的实现局限性以及硬件架构特性的影响，提出了一种基于LLVM IR的解析式性能预测模型，为NAS和CNN推理优化提供指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前TinyML系统缺乏定量的全栈性能功耗分析。已有工作仅关注单一层面（模型、库或硬件），未能揭示层与层之间微妙的交互作用如何影响整体推理性能，特别是在超资源受限设备上。因此，需要进行细粒度的全栈表征以识别瓶颈并指导优化。

Method: 1. 实验平台：选用4款基于ARM Cortex-M4F/M7F的MCU（MCU-S/M/B/D）。<br>2. 基准测试：5个代表性TinyML应用（Micro Speech、Person Detection、Keyword Spotting、Image Classification、Anomaly Detection）。<br>3. 测量工具：使用J-Trace Pro追踪指令数，SmartPower2测量功耗，Mbed Timer测量延迟。<br>4. 性能预测模型：基于LLVM IR，通过分析数据移动、数据计算和循环执行三类汇编指令来精确预测逐层延迟。

Result: 1. 抽象层开销：CMSIS-NN使延迟降低约10倍；Mbed OS增加约98% SRAM、196% Flash和65%能耗；TFLM框架仅增加约3%开销。<br>2. 库局限性：CMSIS-NN的2x2 GEMM内核在处理输入通道数小的层时，无法利用SIMD指令，导致计算效率低；IM2COL过程降低了运算强度，卷积层存在显著开销。<br>3. 架构影响：吞吐量与频率和带宽成正比；MCU-D性能/瓦特最差；低算力MCU具有更高的能效。<br>4. 预测模型：模型级延迟预测平均绝对误差（MAE）为3.57%，远优于基于#MACC的线性回归模型。

Conclusion: 全栈分析对精确评估TinyML至关重要。OS抽象层带来显著的内存和能耗开销，应精简冗余外设支持；DNN框架开销小；GEMM转换在某些层形状下效率低下，应考虑直接卷积实现；针对MCU平台，应根据模型结构（卷积vs全连接）选择匹配硬件特性（高频vs高带宽）的设备；所提出的LLVM IR解析模型能有效集成进NAS流程。

Abstract: TinyML systems are enabling machine learning (ML) inference at the edge. However, there is little quantitative analysis of such systems. This paper presents a systematic performance and power characterization of diverse TinyML applications on microcontrollers (MCUs), spanning neural network models, software libraries, operating systems, and hardware architectures. We focus on the impact of the multiple layers of abstraction that provide higher programmability at the expense of performance and energy efficiency. We propose a model to estimate the costs of different abstraction layers and make recommendations for minimizing those costs. Our findings can help designers with Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and CNN inference optimization on edge devices.

</details>


### [436] [SynEHR: Joint Modeling Inter-visit Temporal Evolution and Intra-visit Clinical Structure for Longitudinal EHR Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21673)
*Ximiao Li,Lin Jiang,Rongchao Xu,Dahai Yu,Zhe He,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SynEHR 是一种面向纵向电子健康记录生成的参数高效 LLM 框架。它联合建模不规则就诊间隔的跨就诊时间演化，以及同一就诊内诊断、药物、检验和操作之间的结构关系，从而生成更符合临床逻辑和真实时间分布的患者轨迹。TSCM 提供带置信度的时序状态，TRAM 将患者历史转化为个性化 soft-prefix，LoRA 适配的 LLM 负责自回归生成下一次就诊。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，它在保真度、下游任务效用和隐私风险方面总体优于 14 个基线，但优势幅度依骨干、任务和指标而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实纵向 EHR 难以共享，同时既有生成方法通常将多类型临床事件简单序列化为 token，难以显式表达两类关键结构：不同患者不规则就诊间隔所反映的跨就诊时间演化，以及同一就诊内诊断、药物、检验和操作之间的动态关系。论文旨在通过轻量级参数高效适配，在控制训练成本的同时提高合成患者轨迹的临床一致性、时间真实性和隐私安全性。

Method: SynEHR 包含三个核心部分。TSCM 从就诊类型、临床代码、人口统计信息、轨迹长度及最近就诊间隔构建时序特征，以 GRU 编码历史，并通过离散时间 hazard 头、连续区间分布回归头和置信度评分输出时序嵌入、短期/中期/长期区间分布及不确定性；多任务损失由 hazard 损失、log(1+间隔) 的高斯 NLL 和区间制度分类损失组成。TRAM 包含动态分支和静态分支：动态分支利用 TSCM 输出和骨干历史状态，通过 FiLM 调制及区间分布注入形成时变关系；静态分支通过注意力池化、数据类型锚点、显式两两关系编码以及差异和逐元素乘积操作形成稳定关系表示。两条分支通过置信度感知的残差融合映射为患者特定的 soft-prefix token，并注入 LoRA 适配的冻结 LLM。训练分三阶段进行：先用下一就诊自回归目标训练 LoRA 生成器；再冻结生成器训练 TSCM；最后冻结生成器和 TSCM 训练 TRAM。推理时反复生成下一次就诊并更新历史，直至输出结束 token。

Result: 在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，SynEHR 的三个骨干版本总体优于 14 个基线。MIMIC-III 上，SynEHR-Q3 相比最强非 SynEHR 基线将诊断、药物和操作的纵向 LPL 分别降低 2.5%、3.0% 和 0.9%，跨模态 MPL 中诊断降低 0.3%；SynEHR-L3.1 对检验、操作、就诊长度和就诊间隔 JSD 分别降低 7.1%、4.5%、57.5% 和 10.9%。MIMIC-IV 上，诊断、药物和操作 LPL 分别降低 2.4%、1.9% 和 1.9%，诊断和药物 MPL 分别降低 2.7% 和 1.7%。时间间隔预测中，SynEHR-Q3 的 Macro-F1、NLL、Brier 和 ECE 分别达到 0.391、0.872、0.397 和 0.041，最佳非 SynEHR 结果分别为 0.386、0.920、0.426 和 0.044；EHRPD 的 MAE 最低，为 151.9 天。风险预测方面，SynEHR-L3.1 平均 AUROC/AUPRC 为 0.822/0.426，较 EHR2Path 的 0.813/0.415 分别提升 1.1% 和 2.7%。隐私方面，SynEHR 在四种攻击者知识比例下均取得最低 PD；相对 EHRPD 的降幅为 1.6%至3.4%。消融实验显示移除 TSCM 对平均 LPL 和时间间隔 JSD 损害最大，移除 TRAM 对 MPL 损害最大，动态分支通常比静态分支贡献更大。

Conclusion: 论文证明，显式联合建模不规则就诊间隔和就诊内部多模态临床关系，能有效提升纵向 EHR 合成的真实性、下游临床效用和隐私表现。TSCM 的不确定性感知时序条件、TRAM 的患者特定关系 soft-prefix，以及 LoRA 的参数高效适配共同构成主要技术贡献。实验支持 SynEHR 作为隐私敏感医疗数据研究中的有效合成框架，但结论主要限于两个单中心重症监护数据集和所选生成骨干；未来应通过多中心外部数据、独立临床审查、成员推断和属性推断攻击，以及更长时间跨度的真实临床前瞻验证来确认其泛化性和安全性。

Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) document patients' sequences of clinical visits over time, preserving the temporal evolution of disease progression and care delivery. However, real longitudinal EHRs are difficult to access because they contain large amounts of fine-grained, patient-specific information. Synthetic EHR generation therefore provides a valuable approach for preserving the statistical patterns and clinical structure of patient visit trajectories, enabling broader modeling and analysis when real records are limited. Although recent generative models have made progress in producing future visit sequences, they remain limited in explicitly integrating inter-visit irregular temporal evolution and intra-visit clinical event structures in EHRs, leading to clinically inconsistent and temporally unrealistic visit sequences. In this work, we propose SynEHR, a lightweight adaptive LLM-based framework for longitudinal EHR synthesis. There are two novel designs in SynEHR, i.e., a Temporal State Conditioning Module captures irregular temporal states across visits and a Temporal-Relational Adaptation Module combines these states with patient history to dynamically construct patient-specific relational representations. SynEHR then builds on a parameter-efficient LoRA-adapted language-model generator with next-visit generation capability to train the two modules for temporally and clinically informed generation. Extensive experiments on real-world EHR datasets across fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility evaluations demonstrate that SynEHR outperforms state-of-the-art models by generating more clinically coherent and temporally faithful longitudinal EHR data.

</details>


### [437] [Read, Write, Relax: Why Neural PDE Surrogates Need Both Global and Local Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21677)
*Anuj Kumar,Heiko Zimmermann,Josiah Bjorgaard,Jacan Chaplais,Nikolaos Bouklas,Matteo Salvador,Alexander Lavin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Read-Write-Relax (RWR) 架构，通过将潜在注意力（全局处理）与消息传递松弛（局部处理）在统一框架下交替进行，解决神经 PDE 代理在工业级网格仿真中两类架构各自的谱端失效问题。RWR 在多个工业和公开基准上几乎所有对比中均达到最高精度，尤其在数据稀缺和工程量（如壁面剪切应力）上优势显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的两类基于网格的神经 PDE 代理——基于潜在 token 注意力的全局模型与基于消息传递的局部模型——都无法胜任工业级、高维、大规模网格的稳态仿真。前者学习过度偏向低频（大尺度），后者因感受野有限而无法跨域传播信息。本文从谱分析角度揭示两者在误差谱上互补的失效模式，并基于多重网格（multigrid）类比构建统一架构。

Method: 1. 将近期全局模型归入 Bottlenecked Self-Attention (BSA) 统一模板，引入 Read-Write Perceiver (RWP) 作为该家族成员。2. 提出 RWR 处理器：在 n_B 个块中以配置 (m₁, r, m₂) 交替执行 m₁ 次消息传递松弛 → r 次潜在空间读写迭代 → m₂ 次消息传递松弛；当 r=0 退化为 MGN，当 m₁=m₂=0 退化为 RWP。3. 几何锚定查询：latent 通过可学习坐标 + 共享随机傅里叶特征嵌入产生 query。4. 边界编码：read 阶段可仅作用于边界点（基于椭圆问题 Green 表示），将读成本从 O(NL) 降至 O(N_bL)。5. 基于多重网格类比：read/write 充当粗空间限制/延拓（coarse correction），消息传递充当学习松弛（relaxation）。

Result: 在分支管（约 6 万单元）、离心泵壳体（27 万单元）和完整泵（140 万单元）三个工业级稳态 RANS 数据集上，RWR 在 50/100/300 样本训练规模下均取得最低平均 NMAE，且在小样本下优势最大。在 AirfRANS、AhmedML、Geo-FNO 系列基准中，RWR 在绝大多数数据集上达到最低验证 MSE。谱分析表明 RWP 表现为空间低通滤波器（低频误差收缩一个数量级、高频停滞），MGN 则在全部频带上过早平台化，而 RWR 在整个谱上持续降低误差。在梯度、壁面剪切应力等工程量上，RWR 对纯潜在注意力模型的领先幅度大于体误差差距。

Conclusion: 全局潜在 token 代理与局部消息传递在误差谱两端互补失效，单纯扩大瓶颈或加深网络均无法弥合。RWR 通过交替粗校正（潜在注意力）与学习松弛（消息传递）的统一配置，在整个谱上降低误差，对工程量和稀缺数据场景增益最大，是工业级稳态 PDE 代理的有效统一架构。多重网格类比仅为角色对应而非收敛性证明，分析建立的是一致性而非因果隔离。

Abstract: Recent mesh-based simulation advances have, in no small part, relied on neural surrogates of two distinct families: global models that route information through a small set of latent tokens, and local models that perform message passing across mesh edges. Consistent with both classes is the inability to perform beyond low-dimensional problems and small-scale or oversimplified meshes, the simulation regimes where industrial problems reside. Our work shows this explicitly and presents a unified formulation. In global approaches, latent-token attention acts as a spatial low-pass filter, while local message passing lacks the global reach necessary to propagate information across large mesh spaces. Viewed through the error, the two operators are the halves of a multigrid cycle: one corrects errors at the lower end of the spectrum, the other at the higher end, and neither can do the other's job. We introduce Read-Write-Relax (RWR), which interleaves latent attention with message-passing relaxation under a unified formulation. The interleaved processor lowers error across the entire spectrum, making RWR the most accurate model in nearly every comparison across our industrial and public benchmarks. It is also markedly data-efficient in the scarce-data regimes, accurate on the engineering quantities of interest, and scales full-field predictions to challenging, large-scale problems.

</details>


### [438] [Reinforcement Learning on Benign Facts Amplifies Leakage of Memorized Private Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21727)
*Renfei Zhang,Niloofar Mireshghallah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，在完全不含PII的良性事实数据上进行可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），会让模型原本"沉睡"的已记忆个人身份信息（PII）变得更容易被提取，且效应随模型规模增大而增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR已成为主流的后训练技术，但其对模型隐私泄露的副作用尚未被系统研究。指令微调与对齐虽能让模型在日常交互中不输出PII，但这些信息可能仍以"潜在"形式存于模型内部。由此引出关键问题：对良性数据进行RL训练是否会让已记忆的敏感信息更容易被提取？

Method: 在三个指令微调模型（Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B、DeepSeek-V3.1，覆盖8B至671B参数）上，使用GRPO算法在FACTS-Parametric良性事实问答数据集（无任何PII）上进行RLVR训练。采用两类探针评估Enron邮件语料中已记忆的name→email关联：(1) 定向探针（5种释义模板，recall@k=10）；(2) 非定向自由回忆探针。同时设置诱饵池（合成不存在地址）控制虚构率，以MMLU衡量推理能力、控制集评估拒答率。

Result: RL后所有模型PII提取率显著上升：DeepSeek-V3.1定向recall@k从0.155升至0.370（2.4倍）；绝对增幅随模型规模增大（+0.045/+0.085/+0.215）。诱饵池recall始终为零，证明非虚构；非定向发射精度基本不变（82.0%→82.2%）。MMLU推理能力保持稳定，拒答率变化很小（Qwen3-8B: 86.33%→81.20%；DeepSeek-V3.1不变）。

Conclusion: RLVR即便在完全不涉及隐私的良性数据上训练，也会选择性地改变哪些已记忆信息变得行为可访问，而非全面改变模型。这意味着攻击者无需任何隐私相关训练信号或数据访问权，仅通过对无害数据进行微调即可显著提升对模型预训练记忆的PII提取能力，对现有以能力与拒答率为门控的模型发布评估体系构成重大盲区。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is deployed to make models better at reasoning tasks, but its side effect on what models will divulge is under studied. Here we show that RLVR on facts increases extraction of personally identifiable information (PII) the instruct model had already memorized. We first confirm that instruct models have already memorized PII but leave them latent, rarely surfacing one when asked. We then apply RL on benign factual data that contains no PII of any kind, and re-probe: a targeted probe over name->email pairs, and an untargeted free-recall prompt that simply asks the model to list the addresses it knows. PII extraction rises sharply under both: on DeepSeek-V3.1, verbatim recall@k increases from 0.155 to 0.370, a 2.4x gain. The effect scales with model size: across three models spanning 8B to 671B parameters, absolute leakage is largest in the biggest model. Meanwhile model's reasoning abilities and refusal rates are retained, indicating that RL selectively changes which memorized information is accessible rather than broadly altering the model. In summary, memorized private data can be made markedly more extractable by training that never touches it. This gives an adversary a route to memorized data that requires no privacy-relevant training signal and no access to the data itself -- only the ability to fine-tune on something innocuous.

</details>


### [439] [ChainPrune: Evaluating and Reducing Redundancy in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21860)
*Weihang Pan,Zhengxu Yu,Yuxiang Zhang,Wenzhi Li,Zhongming Jin,Binbin Lin,Xiaofei He,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ChainPrune提出了一种基于语义结构相似性的推理路径压缩方法，通过将多条自生成的推理路径合并为树结构并进行Pareto最优选择，解决现有token长度优化方法导致的"伪简洁性"问题，并结合DPO+NLL损失实现高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1、OpenAI o1）存在"过度思考"现象，生成冗长的推理链。现有基于token长度的奖励策略虽能减少token数量，但导致"伪简洁性"问题：模型用碎片化的微步骤压缩逻辑，推理链结构反而更长、效率更低。仅33.95%的最短token路径同时也是最短步骤路径，暴露了表达层与结构层简洁性的严重错位。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 推理路径合并——将K条采样路径分割为步骤，以最短路径为骨架构建初始树，通过余弦相似度（≥θ_sim）匹配语义等价节点，并用token级熵变化（ΔH≤ε）验证合并的逻辑一致性，避免错误合并；(2) 多准则优势路径选择——定义效率评分ℰ=√(ℓ²_token+ℓ²_step)，优先选择Pareto支配路径（同时更少步骤和更短token），否则在非支配候选中选最短token路径；拒绝样本需明显更长（步骤≥ℓ_step(τ⁺)+5且token≥1.5×ℓ_token(τ⁺)）或更长且错误；(3) 偏好优化——采用DPO+NLL联合损失：ℒ=ℒ_DPO+λ·ℒ_NLL，缓解DPO的梯度纠缠导致的同步下降/上升问题。

Result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-7B/1.5B上跨5个基准（MATH500、AIME24/25、AMC23、LiveCodeBench）测试：ChainPrune平均减少推理链26.8%、token 28.1%，同时准确率持平或提升（如AIME24: 0.5479→0.5833, 7B模型）。LLM-as-a-Judge评估显示错误推理步骤减少57.8%、无效反思减少62.1%、冗余步骤减少65.9%。DPO+NLL损失优于纯DPO和SimPO，后者因梯度纠缠存在85.6%的不良优化条件（同步增减）。

Conclusion: ChainPrune通过语义结构化合并与双目标Pareto选择，有效消除伪简洁性，在保持准确率的同时实现真正的token与步骤双重压缩；该方法低成本、无需人工标注，可扩展至在线RL框架（如PPO）以提升探索效率。未来工作将聚焦在线强化学习场景的整合。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the multi-step problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by introducing explicit intermediate reasoning. However, advanced Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often exhibit overthinking behaviors, including excessively long reasoning steps, redundant steps, and high computational overhead. Existing token-length reward strategies aim to promote concise outputs, but often result in pseudo-conciseness, where token count is reduced, yet redundant reasoning persists, leading to longer and less structurally efficient chains. To address these limitations, we propose ChainPrune, a novel reasoning path semantic structural optimization method to efficiently and controllably synthesize self-generated high-quality training data. We initially consolidate self-generated reasoning paths into a tree-based structure, followed by a multi-criteria dominant path selection process for preference data construction that formulates shallow reasoning trajectories while preserving essential reasoning steps. To further enhance the quality of reasoning, we incorporate a DPO-based preference learning method combined with supervised loss, effectively mitigating false reward suppression. This innovative integration significantly enhances both the efficiency and effectiveness of our reasoning framework. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate significant reductions in step length and computational overhead, while maintaining or even enhancing accuracy.

</details>


### [440] [BioMed-Agent-RL: A Meta Learning, All You Need for Biomedical Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21864)
*Md Asaduzzaman Jabin,Zihao Wu,Tianming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BioMed-Agent-RL，一种统一的医学智能体框架，通过自适应编排与基于奖励的强化学习（RL）解决现有临床视觉大语言模型（C-VLLMs）在复杂医学推理中面临的病变噪声、模态错位、幻觉和上下文接地缺失等问题。该方法在多个基准上显著超越包括GPT-5在内的现有最优模型，准确率最高提升约5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有C-VLLMs在数字诊断中虽有进展，但仍面临病变噪声、模态错位、幻觉及复杂临床场景下上下文接地不足的问题；同时主流智能体系统依赖静态、不可自适应的流程，缺乏复杂医学推理所需的灵活性，亟需一种可靠、自适应且类专家的临床推理智能体框架。

Method: 提出BioMed-Agent-RL统一医学智能体，包含：(1) 自适应编排策略与基于奖励的RL；(2) 整合临床上下文感知偏好优化（CPO）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和组相对策略优化（GRPO），并采用动态熵调节以确保可靠性；(3) 多模态元学习方法，使其充当领域专家和人类判断合成器；(4) 自适应调用临床基础与推理器、病变分割器、领域合成器等模型级专长模块，覆盖X射线等多种临床模态，并通过迭代自适应RL学习在视觉线索误导或专家意见错误时坚持固有推理。

Result: 在多个基准测试中进行广泛的消融实验，BioMed-Agent-RL显著优于GPT-5等当前最优模型，准确率最高达约73%，相较于现有基线提升约5%。

Conclusion: 该框架为构建事实性、可靠、鲁棒且具备类专家能力的独立临床推理智能体系统树立了新的标准。

Abstract: The current progress of Clinical Vision Large Language Models (C-VLLMs) has substantially improved digital diagnostics, still these frameworks often endure lesion noises, modality misalignment, hallucination, and missed contextual grounding in complex clinical cases. Moreover, prevailing agent systems usually depend on static and non-adaptable pipelines and lack the versatility necessary for complex medical reasoning. To resolve these difficulties, we present BioMed-Agent-RL, a unified medical agent that incorporates adaptive orchestration, policy, and reward-based reinforcement learning (RL) models for biomedical applications. To ensure reliability, it invokes clinical context-aware preference optimization (CPO), direct preference optimization (DPO), and group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with dynamic entropy regulation. This pipeline utilizes a multimodal meta-learning approach that operates as a field-specific expert and human judgment synthesizer. The agent adaptively utilizes a set of model-level expertise, such as clinical grounding and reasoner, lesion segmenter, and field-specific synthesizer, across various clinical modalities (e.g., X-ray) by utilizing an iterative and adaptive RL approach. The agent learns to seriously synthesize misleading, conflicting vision cues and trust in inherent reasoning, while specialist advice is faulty. An intensive ablation study is conducted across multiple benchmarks, and the agent significantly outperforms existing state of the art models, such as GPT-5, attaining up to ~73% accuracy (gain of ~5%) over contemporary baselines. As a result, the framework suggests a new standard for building factual, reliable, robust, and expert-like intelligent agent systems for independent clinical reasoning.

</details>


### [441] [Bi-EZP: LLM-Guided Bilevel Program Evolution for Ensemble Zero-Cost Proxy Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21927)
*Yutao Lai,Kezhao Lai,Hai-Lin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Bi-EZP提出了一种双层优化框架，将LLM驱动的符号聚合程序生成与CMA-ES连续参数校准解耦，用于自动化集成零成本代理发现。上层使用LLM生成可执行聚合程序及其参数边界，下层使用CMA-ES在内部训练集上校准连续参数，并通过内部验证集上的Kendall秩相关系数进行结构选择。实验在NATS-Bench、NDS和DARTS搜索空间上验证了其在秩相关性和下游架构搜索中的竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同零成本代理捕获不同的网络特性，在不同搜索空间中产生不一致的排名。集成代理可以结合互补信号，但自动发现必须同时优化离散聚合结构和连续系数，使得结构质量难以与参数校准分离。现有的固定形式集成结构受限，而符号方法虽扩大了结构空间但引入了结构相关的连续参数。核心动机是将符号结构发现与连续参数拟合这两种根本不同作用的决策分开优化。

Method: 双层优化框架：上层使用LLM（GLM-4.7-Flash）作为结构生成器，产生可执行聚合程序及程序特定的参数边界，包含语法验证和修正机制；下层使用CMA-ES对固定程序在内部训练集（80%）上进行连续参数优化；通过内部验证集（20%）上的Kendall τ进行结构选择。采用(P+P)精英保留策略和锦标赛选择。基于四个互补基础代理（NASWOT、MeCo、Sweet-SNIP、SZiCo）进行集成。

Result: 在NATS-Bench上，Bi-EZP在TSS和SSS上均达到最高秩相关（如TSS CIFAR-10达0.809 vs ECP 0.782）。在NDS五个搜索空间（DARTS、ENAS、PNAS、NASNet、Amoeba）上均优于基线（如DARTS 0.621 vs ECP 0.568）。跨数据集和跨搜索空间迁移性能稳定。DARTS下游搜索中，CIFAR-10测试误差2.47%，CIFAR-100为16.10%，ImageNet Top-1误差24.7%（5.3M参数）。消融实验验证了双层解耦和LLM驱动的语义搜索的有效性。

Conclusion: 将程序发现与数值校准显式分离为自动化集成零成本代理构建提供了一种有效途径。LLM提供灵活的结构多样性，CMA-ES和基于秩的进化选择提供明确的性能驱动优化。尽管存在离线代理发现阶段的token成本和延迟等局限性，Bi-EZP在所评估的协议下实现了优于比较基线的秩相关性。未来工作将扩展为多目标范式以处理硬件感知约束。

Abstract: Zero-cost proxies enable neural architecture search (NAS) to rank candidate networks from statistics computed at initialization, avoiding repeated training. However, different proxies capture different properties and often produce inconsistent rankings across search spaces. Ensemble proxies can combine complementary signals, but automated discovery must optimize both discrete aggregation structures and their continuous coefficients, making structural quality difficult to separate from parameter calibration. We propose Bi-EZP, a bilevel framework that decouples these decisions. At the upper level, a large language model generates executable aggregation programs over four complementary base proxies with program-specific parameter bounds. At the lower level, covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) optimizes the continuous parameters of each fixed program on an inner training split. The calibrated programs are then evaluated using Kendall's rank correlation on a disjoint validation split, enabling evolutionary selection to favor structures that generalize beyond their calibration data. Experiments on NATS-Bench and Network Design Spaces evaluate ranking performance across heterogeneous search spaces, and DARTS experiments assess downstream architecture search. Results show that separating program discovery from numerical calibration provides an effective approach to automated ensemble zero-cost proxy construction. The source code is available at: this https URL

</details>


### [442] [Variance Driven Exploration: A Provable and Efficient Methodology for Pure Exploration in Highly Stochastic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21995)
*Khang Luong,Nam Nguyen,Hoang Ta,Hung The Tran,Tuan Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VarDE（方差驱动探索）方法，用于高随机性环境下的纯探索任务。该方法通过将最终决策建模为局部经验估计的光滑决策函数，并基于一阶灵敏度分析（影响权重）来量化各分量对输出的影响，从而推导出能最大化降低决策方差期望的采样规则。VarDE被实例化到三个核心问题：最佳臂识别（BAI）、蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）和最佳策略识别（BPI），并在理论和实验上均证明在高随机性环境中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在纯探索任务中，传统的基于乐观主义的采样规则（如UCB-E、UGapE、UCT等）主要调控各分量的局部估计误差，未显式量化这些不确定性如何传播到最终决策。在高随机性、异方差环境下，这类方法可能因噪声而误判信号，导致错误地将采样预算分配给低影响力的分量，造成真实最优臂（但高方差）被低估并停止采样。本文通过表1的示例直观说明：最优臂因方差大导致经验均值暂时低于稳定次优臂，从而被错误淘汰。

Method: 核心方法是将最终决策建模为局部经验均值的光滑函数Y=f(μ̂)，利用一阶Taylor展开推导出"影响权重"w_i=∂f/∂μ̂_i，量化各分量对决策的敏感度。通过一阶方差分解，决策方差Var[Y]可分解为Σw_i²σ_i²/N_i的加权和（Lemma 3.4）。每次采样带来的决策方差减量为-w_{i_t}²σ²_{i_t}/(N_{i_t}(N_{i_t}+1))（Proposition 3.6）。VarDE的贪心规则选择能最大化该减量的分量，即同时考虑影响权重和经验方差。在BAI中使用LogSumExp作为max的光滑近似，在MCTS中将其扩展到动作选择，在Q-learning中使用单步TD目标的方差代替累积回报方差。

Result: 理论方面：(1) 证明了决策方差以O(t⁻¹)衰减（Theorem 3.7），且VarDE的渐近一阶常数C(p*)=(Σ|w_i|σ_i)²最小化；(2) BAI误差概率呈指数衰减Pr ≤ C·exp(-cT)（Theorem 4.5），简单遗憾呈exp(-Ω(T))（Corollary 4.6），与固定预算BAI的极小极大下界匹配；(3) MCTS值估计呈指数集中（Theorem 4.7），根动作误识概率呈exp(-Ω(T))；(4) Q-learning以概率1收敛到最优策略（Theorem 4.11）。实验方面：(1) BAI四个基准测试中均取得最低错误概率；(2) MCTS在Sailing、Taxi、FrozenLake和合成树测试中均优于UCT、MENTS、RENTS、BTS等基线，尤其在高随机性设置下优势更明显；(3) BPI在RiverSwim和ForkedRiverSwim上随状态空间增大保持稳定且接近最优，而多个基线方法性能快速恶化。消融实验表明影响权重和经验方差两个成分都不可或缺。

Conclusion: VarDE将纯探索重新定义为决策方差最小化问题，提供了一个统一视角来处理bandit、规划和RL中的探索。其核心优势在于显式建模不确定性从局部估计到最终决策的传播，通过"影响权重×方差"的分配规则实现对决策相关不确定性的直接削减。VarDE在高随机性、异方差环境中表现尤为突出。局限性包括：一阶方差近似在采样初期可能不准确、surrogate函数引入偏差-光滑性权衡、RL中仅给出渐近一致性而非有限样本固定预算保证。未来方向包括完整协方差分析、自适应温度调度、高阶分配规则以及函数逼近下的可扩展影响估计。

Abstract: We propose Variance Driven Exploration (VarDE), a principled approach for pure exploration in highly stochastic environments, where the exploration process is dominated by stochastic variance. VarDE is built on a fundamental principle: sampling effort should be allocated to minimize the uncertainty of the final decision. We formalize the uncertainty of the final decision through a smooth decision function and derive allocation rules that explicitly capture how stochastic noise in individual components affects the reliability of the final output. We apply this methodology to three core problems of pure exploration -- Best Arm Identification (BAI), Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), and Best-Policy Identification (BPI) -- with theoretical guarantees on variance decay and simple regret. Empirically, we demonstrate consistent and significant improvements of VarDE over existing methods, with especially strong gains in highly stochastic environments.

</details>


### [443] [Improving Energy Efficiency of Oil Platforms Through Optimal Loading of Diesel Generators Using Machine Learning and Search Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22076)
*Khivishta Boodhoo,Josh Plumbly,Nicholas Watson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用机器学习和搜索算法优化海上石油平台柴油发电机组的功率负载组合，以降低柴油消耗。基于18个月的实测数据，构建回归模型预测日柴油消耗量，并利用搜索算法寻找最优负载组合，可实现平均27%（约24,000升/天）的柴油节约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上油气平台面临能源利用效率低、系统故障、可达性差和环境影响等挑战。以往研究主要关注提高石油产量，而非降低平台能源消耗。本文旨在填补这一空白，利用机器学习技术提升海上平台的能源效率和可持续性。

Method: 1. 数据收集：从苏格兰某海上石油平台收集18个月的运行数据，聚焦4台柴油发电机组。
2. 探索性数据分析与异常值检测。
3. 回归建模：对比多种模型预测日柴油消耗量，包括多元线性回归（MLR）、人工神经网络（ANN）、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）、随机森林（RF）和额外树回归（ETR）。
4. 搜索算法：基于最佳预测模型，利用搜索算法寻找使日柴油消耗最小的发电机功率负载组合。

Result: 多元线性回归（MLR）和人工神经网络（ANN）预测性能最佳。通过优化发电机功率负载组合，相比最差组合可实现平均27%的柴油节约，相当于每天约24,000升柴油，显著提升了海上平台的能源效率。

Conclusion: 研究表明，基于机器学习的优化方法能显著提升海上石油平台的能源效率与可持续性，验证了ML技术在降低能源消耗方面的应用潜力，为海上油气平台的节能运营提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Rising energy demand, fossil fuel depletion and climate change highlight the need for more efficient energy production and consumption. Offshore oil and gas platforms face challenges related to inefficient energy use, system failures, accessibility and environmental impact. Machine learning (ML) offers opportunities to improve the safety, sustainability and efficiency of these systems; however, previous research has largely focused on increasing oil production rather than reducing energy consumption on platforms. This study investigates the use of ML and search algorithms to improve diesel efficiency on an offshore oil platform. Data collected over 18 months from a platform in Scotland were analysed, focusing on four diesel generators as the primary diesel-consuming equipment. Following exploratory data analysis and outlier detection, regression models were developed to predict daily diesel consumption for different generator power loads. Multiple Linear Regression and Artificial Neural Networks achieved the best predictive performance compared with Extra Trees Regression, Extreme Gradient Boosting and Random Forest. Search algorithms were then used to identify combinations of generator power loads that minimised daily diesel consumption. The results showed an average diesel saving of 27% per day compared with the worst daily power-load combinations, equivalent to approximately 24,000 litres/day. These findings demonstrate significant opportunities for improving energy efficiency on offshore oil platforms using ML-based optimisation.

</details>


### [444] [Why Does Robustness Reduce Superposition?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22155)
*Adam Elimadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为"对抗鲁棒性为何减少叠加现象"提供了机制性解释：通过玩具模型实验，论证对抗训练会系统性丢弃非鲁棒特征，导致需表示的特征总数减少，从而降低叠加(superposition)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gorton & Lewis (2025) 经验性地发现对抗训练能减少叠加，但未给出机制性解释。本文旨在回答"为什么对抗训练会改变模型所表示的特征数量"，填补这一空白。

Method: 采用 Elhage et al. (2022) 的玩具模型框架（n=20 维，m=100 特征），在稀疏度 S∈{0.78,0.80,0.88,0.90} 范围内对比标准训练与对抗训练（ℓ₂ 威胁模型，α=0.5 混合损失）。测量指标包括：叠加量 Φ=‖W‖²_F/n、表征能力 P=‖W‖²_F、特征列范数阈值 τ=0.01 判定保留/丢弃、Gram 矩阵衍生的干扰度量 ι。然后构建一个合成数据集，将 Ilyas et al. (2019) 的鲁棒/非鲁棒特征分类法实例化：高振幅特征视为鲁棒（a_r=6.0），低振幅特征视为非鲁棒（a_nr=0.2），从而具备先验的 ground-truth 划分。

Result: 1) 对抗训练在所有稀疏度下均一致地丢弃更多特征；2) 被丢弃的特征具有更高的正干扰或较少负的干扰值，而保留的特征聚集在干扰值≈−1（反极对映方向，几何最优）；3) 在结构化数据中，对抗训练模型精确地丢弃全部 |𝒩|=70 个非鲁棒特征，且此效应在所有稀疏度下均成立，甚至在标准模型能保留所有特征时仍然发生；4) 理论直觉通过"直接损失膨胀"和"代价性干扰"两种机制解释非鲁棒特征为何与对抗训练目标相冲突。

Conclusion: 论文建立了一条清晰的因果链：对抗训练 → 丢弃非鲁棒特征 → 需表示的特征减少 → 叠加降低。这回答了 Gorton & Lewis 提出的开放问题，但留有新的疑问：对抗训练为何保留剩余特征的几何结构、为何偏好反极方向对齐。未来工作应在真实模型上使用 SAE 等机制可解释性工具验证该理论。

Abstract: The study of adversarial examples and their origins remains an open area of research. Mechanistic interpretability, and superposition in particular, offers new avenues for approaching this problem. Gorton & Lewis (2025) demonstrate that adversarial examples arise from superposition and show empirically that adversarial training reduces superposition, yet provide no mechanistic account of why this occurs. We present an empirical explanation inspired by the feature taxonomy of Ilyas et al. (2019), tracing the following chain of causalities: adversarial training abandons non-robust features, leading to fewer total features to represent, resulting in less superposition.

</details>


### [445] [Joint Causal Structure and Cluster Discovery Using Variational Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22212)
*Avni Rajpal,Anubhav Kumar,Rishabh Karnad,Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan,P.K. Srijith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于变分推断的联合因果结构与聚类发现方法，可在线性与非线性vSCM下同时推断潜在变量聚类及其因果DAG结构，通过Categorical和Bernoulli变分族近似后验，并推导ELBO下界。在合成与真实数据集（Protein和Climate）上显著优于现有的点估计基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在脑成像、气候建模等场景中，变量间的因果关系更适合以"组/聚类"为单位建模（Cluster DAG/C-DAG）。现有方法大多假设聚类已知，但现实中聚类划分本身就是潜在变量，需要与因果结构联合推断。已有方法多为点估计，无法量化不确定性，也不能支持主动干预。

Method: 基于向量值结构因果模型（vSCM）构建生成式联合分布，将聚类分配 C 与DAG邻接矩阵 E_C 均视为离散潜变量。线性情形下利用Normal-Wishart先验推导可解析的边缘似然；非线性情形下采用神经网络加性噪声模型。变分族设计：(1) C 使用因式Categorical分布（独立）或线性自回归Categorical分布；(2) E_C 使用独立Bernoulli、线性自回归、Conditional（依赖C）以及自回归条件四种变分族。优化目标为ELBO，采用REINFORCE（带指数移动平均基线）估计离散变量的梯度，蒙特卡洛采样近似期望。

Result: 合成数据集（4/7变量、3聚类、chain/fork/v-structure）：线性场景下AR-C-Fact-E变体在多数指标上接近完美，如4变量fork的ExG-SHD仅0.02、E-RI 0.99；非线性场景下多个变体取得ExG-SHD 0.00，相对基线提升显著。真实数据集：Protein数据集Neural Conditional Edge模型ExG-SHD=0.0、E-RI=0.80（基线仅0.55 ExG-SHD=3.0）；Climate数据集Neural Conditional Edge模型ExG-SHD=0.04、E-SHD=0.0、AUC=1.0、E-RI=1.0（基线ExG-SHD=15.75）。Hellinger距离显示线性自回归聚类模型比因式模型更接近真实后验。

Conclusion: 该方法首次实现在vSCM下联合推断潜在聚类与因果DAG结构的完全贝叶斯（变分推断）框架，并通过多种灵活变分族成功捕捉聚类间相关性与图结构依赖。在线性和非线性场景下均显著优于现有仅做点估计的基线，同时具备不确定性量化能力。未来可拓展到大规模变量、更多变分族（如GNN）以及主动学习/干预场景。

Abstract: Causal discovery aims to understand the relationships between individual random variables. In many applications, such as brain imaging and climate modeling, it is more meaningful to consider interactions among groups of variables. Existing methods assume that knowledge of such groups or clusters is explicitly available when modeling interactions. However, in practice, these clusters as well as the causal relationships among them, are latent. In this paper, we present a novel approach based on variational inference to simultaneously infer both the latent clusters and causal structures. We learn an approximate posterior over clusters and graph-structure by considering variational distributions based on categorical and Bernoulli models respectively. We derive variational lower bounds and estimation techniques to learn variational and model parameters. The effectiveness of our proposed methods for cluster and causal discovery are demonstrated on both synthetic and real data sets.

</details>


### [446] [FreKoo++: Learning Continuous Spectral Dynamics for Temporal Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22224)
*En Yu,Xiaoyu Yang,Wei Duan,Guangquan Zhang,Jie Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FreKoo++ 提出了一种连续谱-动力学框架，将参数轨迹建模为可学习的连续 Koopman 模态动力学叠加，统一处理不规则采样时间戳与多尺度概念漂移，并在多个连续和离散 TDG 基准上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TDG 方法难以同时处理多尺度漂移（长程周期性与短期增量变化交织）与局部不确定性，尤其在不规则采样的连续设定下表现不佳；且依赖 DFT 的前期方法 FreKoo 局限于均匀时间栅格与人工频率阈值。

Method: 将源域参数映射到紧凑潜空间，以复特征值 λₖ=σₖ+jωₖ 表征每个模态的振荡频率与时间增长/衰减率；提出自适应软谱加权机制结合稳定性正则 R_stab 与谱正则 R_spec，自主分离持久主导动态与瞬态噪声；推导模态近似界与未来时间泛化界，并给出 O(1) 解析外推协议（主导模态外推到 t_s，瞬态冻结于 t_T）。

Result: 在 6 个 CTDG 基准（2-Moons-C、Rot-MNIST-C、Twitter、Yearbook、Cyclone、House-C）和 7 个 DTDG 基准上均取得 SOTA 或最优表现；消融实验验证软门控与两类正则的不可或缺性；决策边界与 t-SNE 可视化表明远期预测稳定，误差保持有界。

Conclusion: 连续 Koopman 谱-动力学建模为时序域泛化提供了一种原则化且有效的方向，理论上消除了发散主导模式导致的指数误差放大，实验上对不规则采样与多尺度漂移均具有鲁棒的泛化能力。

Abstract: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) aims to learn from historical domains and generalize to unseen future distributions under concept drift. Nevertheless, prevailing TDG methods struggle with complex real-world streaming scenarios involving both multi-scale drift patterns (e.g., long-term periodicity intertwined with short-term incremental changes) and local uncertainties, especially in continuous settings where observations arrive irregularly. To address this limitation, we propose FreKoo++, a novel continuous spectral-dynamical framework that pioneers the unification of continuous Koopman modal dynamics with adaptive spectral disentanglement. Specifically, FreKoo++ maps source-domain parameters into a compact latent space, modeling their evolution as a superposition of learnable continuous modes where complex eigenvalues jointly encode oscillatory frequency and temporal growth or decay. This formulation naturally accommodates irregular timestamps and supports arbitrary horizon extrapolation without rigid discrete stepping. Furthermore, we propose a new adaptive soft spectral weighting mechanism backed by stability and spectral regularization, which automatically isolates persistent dominant dynamics from transient noise without relying on manual frequency thresholds. We derive modal approximation and generalization bounds that characterize how amplitude and eigenvalue estimation errors propagate with the prediction horizon. Extensive experiments on both discrete and continuous TDG benchmarks demonstrate that FreKoo++ achieves state-of-the-art performance under complex multi-scale drifts and irregular sampling.

</details>


### [447] [SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22354)
*Qingwen Lin,Boyan Xu,Xiao Liu,Zhifeng Hao,Ruichu Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对 Delta-Rule 循环模型（如 RWKV-7）在超长上下文外推中出现的数值不稳定问题，提出了一种轻量级干预方法 SANE（State Anomaly Neutralization）。论文诊断出失败模式为"局部范数爆炸叠加于相对稀疏的基底"而非全局饱和，并通过在 chunk 边界施加自适应 tanh 压缩来抑制异常值，在保持短上下文能力的同时实现 100M token（超训练长度 24,000 倍）的功能推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Delta-Rule 循环模型虽然具有 O(1) 推理内存的优势，但在远超训练长度的极端上下文场景下，其固定大小状态矩阵会出现数值不稳定（范数爆炸直至溢出）。现有针对 Transformer 的长上下文方法无法直接迁移，Delta-Rule 模型缺乏系统性的极端外推稳定方案。论文动机在于诊断该失败机制并提供一种轻量级、即插即用的解决方案。

Method: 论文首先通过跟踪 RWKV-7 在长达 100M token 序列上的状态演化，诊断出"局部范数爆炸叠加于相对稀疏基底"的失败模式——大多数状态条目保持在低量级背景中，而少数通道因反复注入和累积放大而异常增长。基于此诊断，提出 State Anomaly Neutralization (SANE)：在每个 chunk 边界（chunk size C=16）对终止状态施加逐元素自适应压缩 $\widetilde{S}=\tau\tanh(S/\tau)$，其中阈值 $\tau$ 由当前 chunk 末端的隐藏表示通过 softplus 动态生成，整体压缩强度由预设标量 $\alpha$ 控制。该方法仅在 chunk 间状态传递时介入，不改变 chunk 内的仿射递推和并行扫描结构，新增参数 <0.1%。

Result: 在 RWKV-7-0.4B 上通过 SFT 引入 SANE 后：（1）在安全阈值范围 3≤α≤5 内，11 个短上下文数学推理基准上与基线无统计显著差异（平均精度 43.30–44.23 vs 基线 43.88，p≥0.154）；（2）经过 100M token 前缀后，基线出现数值溢出，α=3 时 SANE 保留最佳 100M 推理精度 35.56，α=5 时为 33.46；（4）α=6–7 急剧下降（24.48、18.45），α≥8 虽数值稳定但推理完全崩溃（≤0.15），揭示"数值稳定≠功能健康"。α=3 被识别为 Pareto 最优。

Conclusion: 论文建立了 Delta-Rule 模型极端上下文状态稳定化的轻量级方法 SANE，揭示了容量-稳定性权衡：在压缩阈值尺度选择中存在结构性困境——合法大值与早期异常值在数值范围上重叠。论文假设若 SANE 在预训练阶段集成而非后期 SFT 引入，该权衡可能减弱甚至消除。未来工作包括扩展到更大规模（7B/14B）及其他 Delta-Rule 架构，以及验证预训练集成假说。

Abstract: Delta-Rule recurrent models maintain a fixed-size state, enabling $O(1)$ inference memory but potentially becoming unstable under extreme-context extrapolation. By tracking RWKV-7 over sequences of up to 100M tokens, we empirically identify a distinct failure pattern: \textbf{localized norm explosion atop a relatively sparse substrate}, rather than global state saturation. Analysis of the recurrent update suggests that persistent decay keeps weakly updated entries small, whereas uneven injections allow a few channels to accumulate extreme values. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \textbf{State Anomaly Neutralization (SANE)}, which applies adaptive $\tanh$ compression at chunk boundaries while preserving the intra-chunk parallel structure. Within a safe threshold range ($3 \le \alpha \le 5$), SANE matches the baseline on 11 short-context reasoning benchmarks with no statistically significant degradation. After a 100M-token prefix, which exceeds the training length by over $24{,}000\times$, SANE retains functional reasoning ($33.46$--$35.56$) while the baseline encounters numerical overflow. In contrast, overly permissive thresholds ($\alpha \ge 8$) remain numerically stable but lose reasoning capability entirely, showing that numerical stabilization alone does not guarantee functional reasoning and revealing a capacity--stability trade-off in state compression.

</details>


### [448] [Self-Supervised Graph Representation Learning for In-The-Wild Wearable and Smartphone based Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22387)
*Ioannis N. Ziogas,Leontios J. Hadjileontiadis,Ahsan H. Khandoker,Aamna Al Shehhi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自监督学习（SSL）的图节点分类方法，用于在有限标签资源下的可穿戴与智能手机野外情绪识别（WER）。通过子图采样策略结合监督、半监督与多种图SSL掩码增强任务，在K-EmoPhone数据集上仅用20%-25%标签即可超越全监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野外情绪识别面临标签稀缺、标注偏差大及被试间/被试内高情绪变异性等挑战，限制了对有限标签资源的有效利用。需要一种不依赖大量标签、能够捕捉多模态数据中结构相似性的方法。

Method: 1. 图构建：将时序段映射为节点，基于相似度（同类k近邻、跨类m远邻）构建带权（+1/-1）的无向图；训练时按主体完整性和类别平衡采样子图。2. 多任务归纳式GNN架构：共享GCN编码器，分三支——监督交叉熵损失、半监督熵最小化伪标签、自监督重构损失（采用节点掩码、节点属性掩码、高斯噪声、边删除四种图增强）。3. 推理阶段使用训练过程中累积的最常见伪标签。

Result: 在K-EmoPhone数据集的留一组交叉验证（LOGO）下，二分类唤醒度任务仅用25%标签配合节点掩码+伪标签获得4.3%准确率提升；二分类效价任务仅用20%标签配合节点掩码及节点属性掩码获得7.8%准确率提升和3%宏F1提升，均超过全监督基线。消融实验表明：唤醒度更依赖节点属性，效价更依赖图连接结构。

Conclusion: SSL驱动的子图归纳学习方法有效缓解了野外WER的标签稀缺问题，无需模态特定编码器，在标签和主体数量受限情况下表现优异，为长期连续监测及多样化人群的情绪识别提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Wearable and smartphone-based emotion recognition (WER) remains a challenging setting in affective computing, due to the notorious difficulty and bias associated with in-the-wild label collection. The high inter-and intra-subject emotional variability motivates us to explore WER modeling through graph node classification in a limited resources learning scheme powered by Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) graph masking augmentation tasks. We employ a subgraph sampling approach during training, utilizing labeled and unlabeled data, along with supervised, semi-supervised, and SSL mechanisms in a multi-task inductive graph neural network architecture. Our evaluations on K-EmoPhone through leave-one-group-out cross-validation in the binary arousal and valence tasks yield average accuracy gains of 4.3% and 7.8%, compared to the full resource setting, utilizing only 20% and 25% of the labels, respectively. Our model analysis sheds light on the relation of SSL graph augmentations to emotional arousal and valence and justifies the approach of SSL-driven subgraph training for in-the-wild WER.

</details>


### [449] [Functional compatibility as a determinant of persistent neural learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22462)
*Hossein Javidnia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"功能兼容性"（functional compatibility）作为持续学习中持久学习（persistent learning）的因果决定因素。作者通过在匹配神经状态下干预兼容性，同时控制无约束学习进度和保留要求，在卷积网络、视觉Transformer和文本Transformer上证明了兼容性变化会因果性地改变保留约束下的持久学习量。框架Adaptive Functional Metaplasticity（AFM）将持久参数更新与有限功能补全（finite functional completion）分离，并提供定理对齐的兼容性-路径分数乘积下界。在真实基准测试（CORe50、CLEAR-10、CLAD-C）上取得竞争性表现，但在有限更新规模下，非线性几何限制了兼容性连续统的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工神经网络在学习新任务时常常破坏已有能力，形成稳定性-可塑性困境。现有方法（回放、正则化、约束更新）侧重于算法层面，但缺乏对"传入学习本身的某种属性是否决定了在满足保留约束条件下能保留多少新学习"这一更基本问题的回答。作者旨在将研究视角从"防止遗忘"转向"识别新学习的哪些组成部分可以安全地成为持久部分"。

Method: 1) 形式化定义功能兼容性κ = ‖Π_t g_t‖²/‖A_t g_t‖²（兼容梯度能量占比）；2) 提出自适应功能元可塑性（AFM）框架，分离持久参数更新与有限功能补全（compact-cardinal residual）；3) 设计因果干预实验：在750个完全解冻的预更新状态上，通过广义特征值问题构造六个兼容性水平的学习信号，并匹配无约束有限减少Δ₀（状态内相对离散度<0.40%）；4) 在七个保留预算β下评估七种方法分支；5) 进行四组后续实验（多尺度、独立方向、10种子泛化、近零评估、固定范数桥接）。

Result: 在β=0.5保留预算下，投影/AFM基础的兼容性斜率：CNN为1.014，ViT为1.001，文本Transformer为0.965（5种子均值）。兼容性与持久进展比率ρ之间存在近单位斜率，跨架构、模态和独立学习方向均成立。在CORe50、CLEAR-10、CLAD-C上，AFM分别取得0.2478、0.3807、0.5129的保留-可塑性超体积，超过最强经典非oracle对照。在自然更新规模（≥10%自然范数）下，四水平兼容性连续统在视觉系统中变得不可行；但在1%自然范数的231个可行ViT状态下，绝对持久进展仍随兼容性正向变化（斜率3.064×10⁻⁴）。AFM实现存在显著计算开销（CLAD-C上约为匹配SGD的184倍），主要集中于保护几何、有限补全和端点验证。

Conclusion: 功能兼容性是持续学习局部持久-学习前沿的因果决定因素，其可利用程度取决于保留预算和学习规则。在固定有限范数下，兼容性继续增加绝对持久学习量，但归一化比率ρ因分母异质性而不稳定。在更大步长下，非线性几何会消除正下降的兼容性连续统本身。该框架将持续学习重新定义为"识别新学习的哪些部分可以安全持久化"，而非单纯防止遗忘。

Abstract: Artificial neural networks can acquire new capabilities but often damage existing ones when they continue to learn. This stability-plasticity problem has motivated replay, regularization and constrained-update methods, yet it remains unclear whether a property of incoming learning itself determines what can be retained without disrupting protected behaviour. Here we show that functional compatibility, the extent to which new learning can coexist with behaviour that must be preserved, is a causal determinant of persistent learning. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled causal demonstration in which compatibility is deliberately changed from matched neural states and persistent learning is measured under a common retention requirement. The effect generalizes across independent learning directions, convolutional and transformer architectures, vision and text, and additional seeds. Learning rules differ in how efficiently they exploit available compatibility, while retention constraints limit how much can be stored. At larger finite updates, nonlinear geometry changes the available learning opportunity and ultimately prevents the matched compatibility continuum from being realized. These results establish functional compatibility as an experimentally controllable principle of persistent neural learning, shifting the problem from preventing forgetting towards identifying which components of new learning can safely become permanent.

</details>


### [450] [BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22557)
*Md Toufikuzzaman,Ahmad Mousavi,Dongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BLADE，一种用于大语言模型(LLM)遗忘的约束双层优化框架。该方法通过三个核心机制——具有梯度截止的钳位熵遗忘损失、非对称增广拉格朗日乘子(ALM)以及限定在LoRA适配器上的双层结构——解决了现有方法中遗忘梯度无界、固定权重平衡无法适应保留难度变化以及在扩展或重复应用时方法失效的问题。实验在TOFU、MUSE和KnowUndo三个基准上验证了BLADE的优越性和稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM遗忘方法面临三个主要稳健性问题：(1) 梯度上升等方法产生无界遗忘损失，破坏模型连贯性；(2) GradDiff、NPO等固定权重平衡方法无法在训练中期适应保留难度的变化；(3) 在单一基准上有效的方法在规模缩放或重复应用时失效。作者旨在开发一种能产生平滑、可预测的优化景观控制的方法。

Method: BLADE是一个约束双层框架，包含三个关键设计：(1) 钳位熵遗忘损失——当token熵达到阈值τ·log V时梯度严格归零，避免过度遗忘；(2) 带非对称对偶更新的增广拉格朗日——违反保留约束后永久提高拉格朗日乘子λ(棘轮效应)；(3) 修复优先的双层结构——内部循环使用K步SGD修复保留性能，外部循环施加遗忘更新，整体限定在LoRA适配器(仅约0.2%参数可训练)。内层学习率高于外层，确保每次遗忘步骤造成的损伤可被修复。

Result: 在三个基准测试中，BLADE均优于最强基线：TOFU上平均综合分提升6%，MUSE Books上提升9%，KnowUndo上提升7%。在MUSE News的4倍规模缩放和4步顺序遗忘压力测试中，BLADE保持稳定(HM保持在0.523-0.552)，而最强基线PDU彻底崩溃(4倍缩放时HM=0.005，2步顺序遗忘后HM从0.58降至0.02)。LLM法官评估显示BLADE在7个设置中6个达到最高HM_J。消融实验表明三个组件均不可或缺；训练动力学呈现一致的"预热→尖峰棘轮→平滑收敛"三阶段模式。

Conclusion: BLADE通过有界、自稳定的遗忘损失和自适应约束强制实现了稳健、平滑和可管理的LLM知识移除。其三阶段训练动力学在所有基准、模型规模和数据集类型上一致，且4倍扩展和顺序遗忘下仍稳定。局限在于尚未在概念级/表征级域移除、多模态模型以及重学习攻击防御方面进行测试；未来工作可通过在外部层引入对抗目标构建安全边际。

Abstract: Existing LLM unlearning methods struggle with robustness: unbounded forget losses degrade model coherence, fixed-weight balancing cannot adapt as retain difficulty shifts mid-training, and methods that work on one benchmark falter under scaling or repeated application. We propose BLADE, a constrained bilevel framework whose three mechanisms give smooth, predictable control over the optimization landscape: a clamped-entropy forget loss whose gradient is exactly zero once a token reaches sufficient uncertainty; an asymmetric augmented Lagrangian that permanently ratchets retain protection after any violation; and a bilevel structure confined to LoRA adapters that repairs retain damage before each forgetting step. BLADE dominates across three benchmark families, improving average composite scores over the strongest baselines by $6$% on TOFU, $9$% on MUSE Books, and $7$% on KnowUndo, and it remains stable under $4\times$ scaling and $4$ sequential unlearning steps on MUSE News where the best competing method collapses entirely.

</details>


### [451] [Clinical Graph-JEPA: Predictive Patient-State Knowledge Graphs for Cognitive Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22583)
*Kushagra Yadav,Nalin Prabhath,Amit Lamba,Goeun Han,Yining Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Clinical Graph-JEPA框架,将临床知识图谱视为待预测的患者状态表征而非静态抽取产物,通过多智能体关系提议、本体规范化、确定性证据评分与JEPA隐空间精修,在MIMIC-IV上以留一法边恢复协议评估,发现实体级局部注入出院小结表征比全局注入显著提升链接预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM抽取的临床知识图谱混合了高置信的结构事实与来源不明的推断关系,直接作为下游系统输入会传播抽取错误、缺失关系与时序歧义;需要将"草稿图"视为可学习的世界模型对象,通过自监督精修恢复被遗漏的临床关系。

Method: ① 以MIMIC-IV结构化记录构建确定性骨架图(置信度1.0),叠加四个专家智能体推断的MANAGED_FOR/CONFIRMS/COMPLICATED_BY/INDICATES关系,并用14维确定性证据向量(含RxNorm、Hetionet、OMOP概念相似度、出院小结溯源)为每条边打分;② 基于TransformerConv的类型化图编码器,采用掩码节点JEPA目标(EMA目标编码器+停止梯度+余弦预测损失)进行自监督预训练,再冻结编码器、以InfoNCE+K=8类型匹配负样本训练MLP边恢复读头;③ 部署Option A(无出院小结嵌入)与Option B(将Clinical-ModernBERT的768维出院小结表示局部注入有笔记溯源的实体,其他节点置零)。

Result: 在4,000个入院级图、3,200/400/400切分、8,283条LOO边上,Option A整体LOO MRR=0.364,Option B提升至0.477(相对+31%);各推断关系MRR:MANAGED_FOR 0.326→0.423,INDICATES 0.469→0.637,COMPLICATED_BY 0.405→0.527,CONFIRMS 0.395→0.506;全局NOTE节点(扩散注入)MRR=0.352,与无笔记持平,证实笔记价值来自"放置位置"而非"是否使用";在ACI-Bench外部验证(207例、5,005查询,未重训)上,实体级局部注入仍获最佳MRR 0.481 vs 全局0.472 vs 无笔记0.475;笔记表示消融中,实体级局部span均匀池化最佳(0.478),TF-IDF显著差于Clinical-ModernBERT;图问答20题基准上,Option B实体F1 +3.6pp、Hits@3 +5pp。

Conclusion: 临床知识图谱应被视为可被世界模型精修的患者状态预测表征,而非一次性抽取产物;出院小结信息的注入位置至关重要——只有将其局部绑定到有笔记溯源的实体,才能转化为对推断关系有判别力的局部先验;确定性骨架已提供大部分可恢复上下文(INDICATES floor=0.491 vs ceiling=0.637),推断关系提供剩余增益;局限在于仅基于单一机构的MIMIC-IV,未做前瞻性临床效用评估,亦未与独立临床标注对照。

Abstract: Clinical records contain rich evidence about patient state, but converting that evidence into reliable, structured knowledge graphs remains difficult because extraction errors, ontology mismatch, missing relations, and temporal ambiguity can propagate into downstream systems. We propose a clinical knowledge graph construction and refinement framework that combines multi-agent relation proposal, ontology-aware normalization, deterministic evidence scoring, and JEPA-based latent refinement. Rather than treating a clinical knowledge graph as a static extraction artifact, we treat it as a predictive patient-state representation. For each admission, the system constructs an evidence-scored graph from structured MIMIC-IV records and inferred clinical cross-links, then learns to recover held-out clinical relations from the observed graph context. We evaluate the refiner with leakage-free leave-one-out edge recovery (MRR and Hits@k) and held-out batch-mask evaluation (AUC and MRR). To isolate the contribution of discharge-note context, we compare a note-embedding-free configuration with a note-augmented configuration that injects real discharge-note representations only into note-grounded entities. Under the same cohort and evaluation protocol, entity-grounded note injection improves overall leave-one-out MRR by 31% relative improvement.

</details>


### [452] [Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22642)
*Florian Rottach,Sebastian Schieferdecker,William Rudman,Randall Balestriero,Carsten Eickhoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Mol-JEPA is a multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture that learns molecular representations by masking and predicting entire modalities (molecular structures, cellular phenotypes, binding affinities, ADMET profiles, quantum chemistry simulations, etc.) instead of relying on chemically invalid augmentations. The model is pretrained on ~4.69 million molecules with 14 modalities, uses SIGReg for anti-collapse regularization, and demonstrates strong performance on ADMET benchmarks, particularly in low-data and out-of-distribution settings.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing molecular self-supervised learning methods face three key limitations: (1) chemically invalid augmentations due to property cliffs where small structural changes cause large property shifts; (2) modality collapse in multimodal fusion via concatenation or attention; (3) incomplete representation of biochemical environments since molecular structure alone is context-dependent and insufficient to capture drug behavior in biological systems.

Method: Mol-JEPA uses modality masking (masking entire modalities rather than perturbing molecular structures) within a JEPA framework. A Transformer-based predictor reconstructs masked modality embeddings from visible ones. The model employs 14 modalities (UMA, ChemGPT, CLOOME, BioXMol, Boltz-2, GNN, MOE, ECFP, xTB, DFT, ChEMBL, PCBA, TDC) encoded via three learnable encoders (Atom, Graph, Vector). SIGReg (Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization) is applied to target embeddings to prevent representation collapse. The training objective combines prediction MSE loss and SIGReg loss balanced by λ=0.7. The ~50M parameter model is trained for ~150 epochs on 12 RTX-6000ADA GPUs.

Result: Mol-JEPA achieves the best average MAE (0.402) across 23 benchmark tasks spanning ExpansionRx, ASAP-Polaris, PXR, and Biogen ADME datasets, outperforming baselines including CLAMP, CheMeleon, Chemprop, TabICLv2, Random Forest, and LightGBM. The model shows particular strength in low-data settings (smaller ASAP and Biogen benchmarks) and superior out-of-distribution generalization as similarity to training data decreases. Statistical significance via paired Wilcoxon tests confirms 38% win rate using MAE/R². Leave-one-modality-out analysis reveals Graph, MOE, and ECFP4 as the most important modalities. Performance scales positively with the number of modalities and pretraining data size.

Conclusion: Mol-JEPA represents a significant step toward molecular world models that combine diverse biochemical and physical information sources. By replacing molecular augmentations with modality masking, it avoids chemically invalid transformations while leveraging biological context. The framework is scalable, easy to optimize (no negative sampling, no student-teacher architectures), and demonstrates competitive performance especially in data-scarce regimes. Future work should explore modality-specific dependencies, advanced masking strategies, robustness to distribution shifts, and understanding multimodal training dynamics. The approach generalizes to other scientific domains including materials science and biology.

Abstract: Despite recent advances in molecular foundation models, several limitations remain, such as chemically invalid augmentations, modality collapse, and incomplete representation of biochemical environments. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{Mol-JEPA}, a scalable framework for learning molecular world models. Rather than relying on suboptimal molecular perturbations, our model uses modality masking to exploit information from molecular structures, cellular phenotypes, binding affinities, ADMET profiles, quantum chemistry simulations and other drug discovery data. Across various benchmarks, we show that the representations learned by Mol-JEPA deliver strong performance, demonstrating the value of incorporating biochemical context through latent space prediction.

</details>


### [453] [Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22820)
*Sunhee Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对深度学习模型在敏感属性（如性别、年龄）上存在的性能差异问题，提出了一种名为FAMoE的公平性感知的混合专家（MoE）框架。该框架的核心贡献是识别了"路由诱导偏差"（routing-induced bias）这一新型失效模式——子群不均衡导致门控网络将特定子群路由到少数专家。作者通过结合子群重加权与门控熵正则化两项机制，在端到端训练中纠正该偏差。实验在CelebA数据集上进行，结果表明该方法在多个目标属性和敏感属性组合下均实现了公平性与准确性的更优平衡，同时路由分布本身提供了子群分配的内在可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在涉及敏感属性的高风险应用中常出现显著的组间性能差异。现有公平性方法可分为两类：单阶段方法（共享表示难以处理异质子群分布）和两阶段方法（公平表示与下游预测任务脱节，易导致目标不对齐）。此外，Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）虽具备通过条件计算处理异质子群的潜力，但此前未被从公平性角度深入研究。作者发现MoE在子群不均衡下会引入一种新的失败模式——路由诱导偏差，但现有公平性方法对此无能为力。

Method: 1. **整体架构**：基于ResNet-18骨干网络提取共享特征z，馈入N个专家网络和门控网络G；每个专家E_i对z独立处理并经分类器C_i输出专家特定logit o_i，门控网络通过softmax生成路由权重g，最终预测为加权聚合ô=Σg_i·o_i。2. **子群重加权**：根据联合子群(y, s)的样本数n_{y,s}反比赋予权重w_{y,s}∝1/n_{y,s}，采用加权二元交叉熵损失L_cls。3. **门控熵正则化**：在路由分布g上施加熵正则项H(g)，总体损失为L=L_cls - λ_ent·H(g)，促使路由权重分布更均匀，防止特定子群独占专家。两项机制可选择性组合，构成标准MoE、重加权MoE和完整FAMoE三种变体。

Result: 在CelebA数据集上以Attractiveness和Big Nose为目标属性，Male和Young为敏感属性进行评估，使用Equalized Odds（EO）、准确率和Fairness–Accuracy Trade-off Score（FATS）作为指标。主要结果：（1）FAMoE在所有四种(target, sensitive)组合下均取得最佳或接近最佳的FATS，例如Attractiveness+Male下FATS=4.2（EO=4.1, ACC=80.0），Big Nose+Young下FATS=3.4（EO=3.3, ACC=80.8），优于GRL、LNL、MFD等单阶段方法和FD-VAE、FairCL、Fair-GDMS、SHaSAM等两阶段方法。（2）消融实验验证了子群重加权将EO从13.3降至4.2（主要驱动因素），门控熵正则化进一步将EO降至4.1并恢复准确性。（3）门控权重分布可视化表明标准MoE存在显著的专家利用倾斜，而FAMoE实现了更均衡的子群间专家分配，并提供内在可解释性。

Conclusion: FAMoE框架成功识别并纠正了MoE模型中由子群不均衡引发的路由诱导偏差。通过子群重加权修正数据不平衡，通过门控熵正则化维持专家利用的均衡性与可解释性。该工作揭示了在公平性建模中必须显式考虑专家利用模式的重要性——不仅改善了公平性，还通过路由分布为模型行为提供了独特的子群级透明度，这是单体表示方法无法提供的。该研究由韩国女性科学工程技术基金会（WISET）资助。

Abstract: Deep learning models often produce performance disparities across demographic groups, due to the training data imbalance with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender or age. To address this problem, existing work has explored fair representation learning, data re-sampling, and adversarial training, which can be broadly categorized into two main approaches. Single-stage methods typically learn a shared representation for fairness, but often struggle to handle heterogeneous subgroup distributions. Two-stage methods learn representations separately from the final prediction task, which can lead to misalignment between fairness objectives and downstream predictions. We identify routing-induced bias, a failure mode in which subgroup imbalance drives the gating network to route subgroups onto a few experts, and propose an end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that corrects it. Specifically, we apply subgroup reweighting to correct data imbalance, and introduce gate entropy regularization to prevent routing from collapsing onto subgroup attributes, keeping expert utilization both balanced and interpretable. Beyond improving fairness, the routing distribution offers an interpretable view of how subgroups are allocated across experts. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves fairness while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

</details>


### [454] [Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22839)
*Shuting Xie,Nathaniel Lesperance,Graham W. Taylor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒大语言模型（LLM）在层次化分类推理（生物多样性监测中的分类学推理）中的不确定性估计问题，提出基于开源工具LLM提取代理特征并结合层次感知监督的轻量级监督估计器，将微AUROC从0.57提升至0.75–0.80，验证了排序特定多头设计（H3）在统一拒绝阈值下的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒LLM（仅通过API访问）在高风险科学决策支持中缺乏可靠的不确定性量化方法，尤其是在层次化、长尾、且存在部分路径弃答的分类推理场景中（如生物多样性监测）。现有方法要么依赖白盒信号（对专有API不可用），要么采用自述置信度（不可靠）或多次采样一致性（成本高昂），亟需一种实用且准确的置信度估计方案。

Method: 1. 将问题形式化为排序级选择性预测，引入二元正确性标签与基于祖先重叠的层次F1辅助监督信号；2. 使用开源工具LLM（Gemma 7B、GPT-OSS 20B、Qwen3 30B A3B Instruct）从提示-响应对中提取表征特征（中间层隐藏状态）与分布特征（熵、负对数概率、token概率统计量）；3. 设计三种轻量级MLP变体：H1（单二分类头）、H2（加层次回归辅助头）、H3（排序特定多头+辅助回归头），使用BCE+MSE联合损失训练；4. 评估指标包括微/宏AUROC与全局阈值下的风险-覆盖曲线，并以平均负对数似然（NLL）为基线。

Result: 在829张节肢动物稀有物种图像数据集上，三种工具LLM下监督估计器均持续优于NLL基线：微AUROC从0.57提升至0.75–0.80（最高达0.796，Gemma 7B + H3）；全局风险-覆盖曲线在中低覆盖率区间显著优于基线；H3在统一阈值部署下整体表现最佳；但宏AUROC结果不稳定，细粒度排序因弃答导致监督稀疏而退化。

Conclusion: 层次化输出结构对黑盒LLM不确定性估计至关重要；基于工具LLM代理特征的轻量级监督估计器配合排序特定多头设计，能有效支持长尾层次推理场景下统一弃答阈值的实际部署需求；未来需在更丰富的细粒度覆盖、更广泛的分布偏移及排序特定决策规则下进一步验证泛化性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperform a token-likelihood baseline for micro discrimination and selective prediction under a single global rejection threshold, improving micro AUROC from 0.57 to 0.75--0.80. The best results are achieved by a rank-specific multi-head design (H3), suggesting that accounting for hierarchical output structure is important when a unified abstention rule is required. Our code is publicly available at this https URL

</details>


### [455] [The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22876)
*Taebong Kim,Youngsik Hong,Minsik Kim,Sunyoung Choi,Jaewon Jang,Minseo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"前缀不变性"(prefix invariance)作为自回归序列模型因果正确性的形式化定义,并设计了一种仅需两次前向传播、无需训练或梯度的轻量级审计方法,能在层级粒度精确定位因果泄露位置。通过在192个注入故障试验和8个公开模型上的系统评估,证明传统的注意力掩码检查(0/192检出)是无效的,并在Zamba2-1.2B和Nemotron-H-8B中发现了真实的因果缺陷(共享代码谱系,源于分块扫描中chunk轴向错误)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代自回归语言模型(GPT/LLM)广泛用于推理,但其发布从不验证因果正确性——即位置t的表示不应依赖未来输入。传统做法(检查注意力掩码)在异构混合架构(注意力+SSM+循环+卷积)下不再有效,因为:(1)许多层根本没有掩码;(2)即使掩码正确,泄露仍可通过扫描、归一化等路径发生。沉默泄露是危险的失效模式:它使训练损失和困惑度"变好",污染基准比较结果。动机源于工程实践中遇到的三类因果故障——输出偏移、对称邻域替换、差分注意力聚合错误,均难以手动调试。

Method: **核心定义**:前缀不变性——若两个序列在[:t]相同,则位置t的每层表示必须相同。单token扰动(位置T-1)是最便宜的检测实例。

**审计算法**(§2.2,仅约5行算术):
1. 构造x¹和x²(后者仅在位置T-1不同)
2. 禁用缓存,分别前向传播
3. 每层挂hook捕获输出
4. 计算Δ_ℓ = max|h¹_ℓ[0:T-1] - h²_ℓ[0:T-1]|(排除扰动位置)
5. 报告首个Δ_ℓ > τ的层索引ℓ*

**关键设计选择**:
- 逐层hook而非仅输出logits(后者只能回答"是否泄露",不能回答"哪里泄露")
- 排除最终位置T-1(那是扰动本身)
- 禁用缓存(避免两条路径不一致)
- 确定性单精度评估——正确实现下Δℓ精确为零(位级相等),使阈值在[10⁻⁶, 10⁻³]内稳健

**泄露分类法**(四类八种故障模式):
- C1 移位类:shift, peek1
- C2 池化类:pool_leak, global_max, future_mean_k
- C3 归一化类:norm_leak
- C4 反向扫描类:rev_scan, last_broadcast

**注入协议**:每模型×8模式×3深度(早/中/晚)=24次试验,ε=1.0;仅当报告层==注入层时计为"精确定位"。

Result: **1. 注入故障测试**:192/192次试验精确定位(8个公开模型×8模式×3深度)。

**2. 基线对比**(96次,4个架构):
- 本文方法:96/96检出 + 96/96精确定位,clean模型Δ=0(无假阳)
- B1 logits-only扰动:96/96检出,0/96定位
- B2 静态掩码检查:0/96检出(完全失效)
- B3 乱序后缀困惑度:71/96(对C1类半径-1泄露结构性失效)
- B4 未来token重采样:96/96检出,0/96定位
- B5 梯度法:96/96+96/96,但需反向传播(成本/适用性劣势)
- B6 缓存一致性:clean模型假阳1.85e-04

**3. 干净基线**:4个干净checkpoint在所有层Δ精确为0(位级相等)。
